collocations.example: A hundred years ago, a machine that could translate a hundred languages in a heartbeat would have sounded like pure science fiction; today it sits in every schoolbag. （议论文·科技变迁）

synonyms.example: The young reader devoured every fantasy she could find, entranced by dragons, ancient spells and kingdoms that never were. （读后续写·阅读热爱）
synonyms.usage: fantasy 建立在魔法、神话等超自然设定上，不追求科学解释；science fiction 则以（真实或想象的）科学技术为根基，二者常被并提但分属不同类型

synonyms.example: Modern speculative fiction often asks the unsettling question: if we could do this, should we? （议论文·科技伦理）
synonyms.usage: speculative fiction 是更宽泛的上位概念，涵盖科幻、奇幻、反乌托邦等一切'设想非现实世界'的作品；science fiction 是其中以科技为核心的子类

synonyms.example: 'Another sci-fi movie?' his sister groaned, but twenty minutes in she was leaning forward, as spellbound as everyone else. （读后续写·家庭观影）
synonyms.usage: sci-fi 是 science fiction 的口语化简称，语气随意，多用于日常对话；正式写作、书评、书信中仍应使用完整的 science fiction

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·"科幻"（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: science fiction（正式）= sci-fi（口语）= SF（缩写）；上位概念 speculative fiction
advancedExpressions.example: In casual chat we say sci-fi, but in a review we write science fiction. （口语 sci-fi vs 书面 science fiction）

advancedExpressions.expression: what had once been only science fiction now ...
advancedExpressions.example: What had once been only science fiction to a boy with a torch and a comic book now stood before him, real and gleaming, as the rocket he had helped design rose slowly into the dawn sky. （what从句今昔对照+具象收尾，圆梦时刻升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: whether you are a devoted fan of science fiction or simply curious about ..., ...
advancedExpressions.example: Whether you are a devoted fan of science fiction or simply curious about the future, our film festival promises an evening you will not soon forget. （whether...or 让步涵盖两类受众，倡议/邀请开篇拉近距离）

advancedExpressions.expression: science fiction is not an escape from reality but a rehearsal for it
advancedExpressions.example: Science fiction is not an escape from reality but a rehearsal for it, for the dreams writers dare to imagine today often become the tools engineers dare to build tomorrow. （not...but 对比立论+today/tomorrow 时间呼应，为科幻正名）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He loved science fiction and wanted to be a scientist.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Every science fiction story he devoured was less an escape than a blueprint, and somewhere between the star maps and the daring inventions, the quiet resolve to become a scientist took root in his heart. （读后续写·梦想生根·比喻）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: less...than... 修正比较 + 隐喻(blueprint/take root) + between...and... 意象铺陈 + 抽象决心具象化(quiet resolve...took root)

sentenceUpgrade.original: Science fiction can make us think about the future.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: At its finest, science fiction is a telescope pointed not at the stars but at ourselves, urging us to weigh the consequences of our inventions before, rather than after, they reshape the world. （议论文·科幻的警示价值）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: at its finest 让步限定 + 隐喻(a telescope pointed at ourselves) + not...but... 转折深化 + before rather than after 时间对比强化论点

classPractice.question: 一百年前，一部能在瞬间翻译上百种语言的机器听起来纯属科幻。A hundred years ago, such a machine would have ____ ____ pure science fiction.
classPractice.note: sound like science fiction 听起来像科幻；此处虚拟语气 would have + 过去分词

classPractice.question: 辨析选词（science fiction / fantasy）：A story about robots on Mars is ____, while a tale of wizards and dragons belongs to ____.
classPractice.note: science fiction 以科技为本，fantasy 以魔法/超自然为本

original_sentence: Actually, the film you see on the screen is the product of a huge amount of hard work, most of which takes place behind the scenes.
readingExamples: Actually, the film you see on the screen is the product of a huge amount of hard work, most of which takes place behind the scenes.
definitionEn:
(1) phr. happening or working in private, out of public view, especially in a way that influences a result
(2) phr. in the part of a theatre, film or television production that the audience does not see; backstage
(3) phr. (of people) doing important work quietly without receiving public recognition

posExamples.sentence: While the actors soaked up the thunderous applause, no one thought of the tired hands behind the scenes — the seamstress, the lighting boy, the prompter — whose quiet labour had made every dazzling moment possible. （读后续写·幕后英雄·对比烘托）
On behalf of the organising committee, I would like to thank everyone who worked tirelessly behind the scenes to make our school's charity concert such a resounding success. （应用文·感谢信/致辞）
Every polished performance we admire rests on countless hours of unseen effort behind the scenes; success, in truth, is merely the visible tip of a very deep iceberg. （议论文·努力与成功）
Curtains still drawn, the theatre buzzed behind the scenes: actors mouthing their lines, a director pacing, and a nervous stagehand triple-checking every rope and pulley. （读后续写·开演前·群像描写）

collocations.example: Actually, the film you see on the screen is the product of a huge amount of hard work, most of which takes place behind the scenes. （必修二U1·课文原句）
For thirty years the old caretaker had worked quietly behind the scenes, and the school he loved never once thought to ask his name. （读后续写·平凡坚守·感人）
Few of us ever pause to wonder what goes on behind the scenes to bring fresh vegetables from a distant farm to our breakfast table. （议论文·社会分工/感恩）

collocations.translation: 对幕后的一瞥；幕后探秘
collocations.example: The documentary offers a fascinating behind-the-scenes look at how a single animated frame can swallow an entire day of an artist's life. （应用文·纪录片推荐）

collocations.phrase: the heroes / people behind the scenes
collocations.translation: 幕后英雄 / 幕后的人
collocations.example: When we celebrate the athletes on the podium, let us not forget the coaches, doctors and parents behind the scenes who carried them there. （议论文·团队与荣誉）

collocations.phrase: operate / pull the strings behind the scenes
collocations.example: Though he never once appeared on stage, everyone knew it was he who pulled the strings behind the scenes, steering the whole production with a calm, invisible hand. （读后续写·低调掌舵者）
The behind-the-scenes footage revealed how many retakes and stumbles lay hidden beneath one flawless three-minute dance. （应用文·活动纪实）

synonyms.example: Backstage, her heart hammered against her ribs, but the instant she stepped into the light, a strange calm washed over her. （读后续写·登台前紧张）
synonyms.usage: backstage 侧重剧院/演出的具体‘后台’空间；behind the scenes 更抽象，可泛指任何‘公众看不到的幕后运作或工作’，适用范围更广

synonyms.example: The final decision, reached behind closed doors, took the whole school by surprise the next morning. （议论文/记叙·秘密决策）
synonyms.usage: behind closed doors 强调‘不公开、保密’，常含隐秘甚至暗箱意味；behind the scenes 中性偏褒，多指默默付出的幕后工作，不必然带保密色彩

synonyms.example: She preferred to stay in the background, letting her teammates shine while she quietly held everything together. （读后续写·低调品格）
synonyms.usage: in the background 强调‘不显眼、不引人注目的位置’；behind the scenes 更强调‘公众视线之外的实际运作或付出’，二者语气相近但侧重不同

advancedExpressions.expression: behind the scenes / backstage / behind closed doors / in the background
advancedExpressions.example: behind the scenes 幕后运作(中性偏褒)；backstage 剧院后台(具体空间)；behind closed doors 私下秘密(含隐秘意)；in the background 不显眼的位置。四者语气侧重不同，写作按语境择用。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·默默付出（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: work behind the scenes / labour unseen / toil in the shadows / do the unsung work
advancedExpressions.example: 四者都表"不为人知地默默出力"，可互换：It was those who laboured unseen / worked behind the scenes / toiled in the shadows that made the show possible. （读后续写·幕后英雄）

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·连字符复合形容词
advancedExpressions.expression: behind the scenes (adv.) → behind-the-scenes (adj. 作定语)
advancedExpressions.example: 作状语无连字符：It happened behind the scenes；作定语加连字符置于名词前：a behind-the-scenes look / behind-the-scenes footage。这是高考构词高频考点。

advancedExpressions.type: 读后续写·幕后英雄升华
advancedExpressions.expression: the applause belonged to ..., but the victory belonged to those behind the scenes
advancedExpressions.example: The applause belonged to the dancers, but the victory belonged to those behind the scenes — the ones who had swept the floor, mended the costumes and waited in the dark for a bow that would never be theirs. （对比句式+破折号列举，为无名者立传）

advancedExpressions.expression: our heartfelt thanks go to all who laboured behind the scenes
advancedExpressions.example: Our heartfelt thanks go to all who laboured behind the scenes, for without their quiet dedication, tonight's brilliance would simply not exist. （thanks go to 致谢句式+without 虚拟暗示，感谢信/致辞点睛）

advancedExpressions.expression: what we see is only the surface; the real work happens behind the scenes
advancedExpressions.example: What the world applauds is only the surface; the real work always happens behind the scenes, in the unglamorous hours of practice that no camera ever records. （surface/behind the scenes 表里对照+具象收尾，论证成功的隐性代价）

sentenceUpgrade.original: Many people worked behind the scenes to make the show successful.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: For every performer bathed in the spotlight, a dozen unseen hands had toiled behind the scenes — stitching, hammering, rehearsing in the dark — so that when the curtain finally rose, not a single detail was left to chance. （读后续写·幕后付出·排比+细节）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: for every...a dozen... 数量对比 + 破折号内三个-ing排比(stitching, hammering, rehearsing) + so that 结果从句 + not...to chance 收尾强调周全

sentenceUpgrade.original: Success needs a lot of hard work that people cannot see.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Behind every effortless triumph lies a mountain of invisible effort; what dazzles the crowd for a moment is built, quietly and painstakingly, behind the scenes over months and years. （议论文·成功的代价）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: behind...lies 倒装开篇 + a mountain of 夸张量化 + what从句主语 + quietly and painstakingly 副词强化 + over months and years 时间跨度收尾

classPractice.question: 你在银幕上看到的电影是大量辛勤工作的结晶，其中大部分都在幕后进行。Actually, the film you see on the screen is the product of a huge amount of hard work, most of which ____ ____ ____ ____ ____.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；take place 表"发生/进行"，主语 most (of which) 视为单数用 takes

classPractice.question: We should never forget the heroes ____ the ____ who make every success possible.
classPractice.note: behind the scenes 作后置定语修饰 heroes，表"幕后的"；scenes 用复数

classPractice.question: The documentary offers a fascinating ____ (behind the scenes / behind-the-scenes) look at how films are made.
classPractice.note: 作定语置于名词 look 前需用连字符复合形容词 behind-the-scenes；作状语才用 behind the scenes

original_sentence: Actually, the film you see on the screen is the product of a huge amount of hard work, most of which takes place behind the scenes.
readingExamples: Actually, the film you see on the screen is the product of a huge amount of hard work, most of which takes place behind the scenes.
definitionEn:
(1) adv. used to emphasize that something is true or real, especially when it is surprising or contrary to expectation; in fact
(2) adv. used to correct or contradict what someone has said, often politely
(3) adv. used when telling someone something they may not know, or to introduce a new point
(4) adv. used to refer to what really happened, as opposed to what was thought or claimed

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （表委婉纠正）其实，说实话（用于礼貌地反驳或纠正对方）
uncommonMeanings.example: 'You must be exhausted after the whole journey,' she said kindly. 'Actually, I feel more alive than I have in years,' the old man replied, his eyes shining. （读后续写·礼貌纠正·对话描写）

posExamples.sentence: Everyone had written him off as the clumsy new boy, but when the fire alarm shrieked, it was he who actually kept his head, guiding two frightened juniors calmly down the smoke-filled stairs. （读后续写·反转刻画·平凡英雄）
Actually, the film you see on the screen is the product of a huge amount of hard work, most of which takes place behind the scenes. （说明文/应用文·课文原句）
Many people assume that reading more books automatically makes one wiser; actually, it is reflection, not accumulation, that turns pages into wisdom. （议论文·观点纠偏）

I had always pictured my new roommate as cold and distant, but she actually turned out to be the warmest person I had ever met, sharing her snacks and her secrets from the very first night. （读后续写·印象反转·友情）

wordForms.noun: actuality（现实，实际情况；in actuality 实际上）
wordForms.adjective: actual（实际的，真实的；the actual figures 实际数字）
wordForms.other: ★辨析 actual/present/current：actual=真实的(与想象/声称相对)；present=现在的(present situation)；current=当下正流行/现行的(current price)。三者勿混。★actually 位置灵活：句首/句中(助动词后、实义动词前)/句末皆可。

collocations.phrase: Actually, ... = In fact / As a matter of fact
collocations.translation: 实际上，事实上（【课件】强调真实、准确的情况，而非人们以为的）
collocations.example: Actually, the film you see on the screen is the product of a huge amount of hard work, most of which takes place behind the scenes. （【课件】课文原句；actually adv. used to emphasize the real or exact truth = in fact, as a matter of fact）

collocations.translation: 实际上，……（句首引出与预期相反的实情）
collocations.example: Actually, the film you see on the screen is the product of a huge amount of hard work, most of which takes place behind the scenes. （必修二U1·课文原句）

collocations.translation: 其实，……（句首委婉引出实情或转折）
collocations.example: 'I suppose you've given up on painting,' Dad said. 'Actually,' I answered, sliding my sketchbook across the table, 'I've never worked harder at anything.' （读后续写·亮出真相·对话）
Rumours swirled through the corridor all morning, yet only three people knew what had actually happened in the deserted lab the night before. （读后续写·悬疑铺垫）
Volunteering did not just fill my weekends; it actually reshaped the way I saw the world and my small place within it. （议论文·志愿服务感悟）

collocations.translation: 真正的意思是 / 确实认为
collocations.example: When she said she was 'fine', anyone who knew her could tell she actually meant the very opposite. （读后续写·言外之意·心理刻画）

collocations.phrase: if you think about it, actually ...
collocations.example: If you think about it, the classmate we envy for her effortless grades is actually the one who quietly studies longest after everyone has gone home. （议论文·努力被忽视）

collocations.phrase: actually, that's not quite right / true
collocations.translation: 其实那不太对（礼貌纠正）
collocations.example: 'So the pyramids were built by aliens?' the child asked. 'Actually, that's not quite right,' the guide smiled, kneeling to his level, 'they were built by thousands of very human hands.' （读后续写·师者耐心·对话）

synonyms.example: The task looked impossible at first; in fact, once we broke it into small steps, it proved surprisingly manageable. （议论文/记叙·实情揭示）
synonyms.usage: in fact 更书面正式，语气中性，可用于递进补充或强调真实情况，句首/句中皆可；actually 口语色彩更浓，尤其擅长引出"出人意料"或"委婉纠正对方"的语气。二者常可互换，但 actually 更含"纠错/意外"意味。

synonyms.example: I never really understood the meaning of home until I stood, suitcase in hand, at a foreign airport far from everyone I loved. （读后续写·思乡顿悟）
synonyms.usage: really 侧重"真实、确实"的强调，可加强程度(really good)，位置灵活；actually 侧重"与预期相反的真实情况"，不表程度。二者有时可换，但 actually 更含"纠正/意外"的转折意。

synonyms.translation: 事实上（引出新信息或强调）
synonyms.example: 'I hear you've never left this small town.' 'As a matter of fact, I once spent a whole summer in Paris,' she said, a mischievous smile tugging at her lips. （读后续写·意外揭底·对话）
synonyms.usage: as a matter of fact 较正式且带"其实还有你不知道的"意味，常引出新信息或纠正误解，多置句首；actually 更简短随和，日常对话与书面皆宜，句首/句中/句末均可。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·there is more to sth than meets the eye
advancedExpressions.expression: there is more to sb./sth. than meets the eye — 某人/某物远比表面看到的复杂或有趣
advancedExpressions.example: Whatever your answer is, there's always a lot more to it than first meets the eye. — 它（电影）都远比你最初表面看到的更为复杂。e.g. There is more to that problem than meets the eye. 那个问题比看上去更复杂。（【课件】Para.1·与 actually 呼应，强调"实情比表面更复杂"）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·疑问词+ever引导让步/名词性从句
advancedExpressions.expression: Whatever your answer is ... (=No matter what) 让步；whatever topic you prefer (=any topic that) 名词性从句
advancedExpressions.example: Whatever your answer is (=No matter what your answer is), there's always a lot more to it than first meets the eye. — 让步状语从句。You can write about whatever topic you prefer (=any topic that you prefer). — 名词性从句。（【课件】-ever 填空：However / whatever / whoever they are；此点与 actually/type 同段，均可挂）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·actually 作转折纠正
advancedExpressions.expression: A 表面/别人以为 …, but … actually …（用 actually 纠正、推翻前面的看法）
advancedExpressions.example: Everyone thought he had cheated; actually, he had solved it entirely on his own. actually 常与 but / yet 连用，或单独置句首，专门引出"与预期/说法相反"的真相，是委婉纠正的高级信号词。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·实际上（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: actually / in fact / in reality / as a matter of fact / to tell the truth
advancedExpressions.example: 五者都可引出实情，句首互换：Actually / In fact / In reality / As a matter of fact / To tell the truth, the plan was far riskier than it looked. （议论文/记叙·揭示真相）

advancedExpressions.expression: act → actual (adj.) → actually (adv.) → actuality (n.) → actualize (v.)
advancedExpressions.example: 词根 act(做/行动)派生：actual 实际的、actually 实际上、actuality 现实、actualize 使实现。掌握词族可推断生词并丰富表达。

advancedExpressions.expression: what everyone had assumed ... was, actually, quite the opposite
advancedExpressions.example: What everyone had assumed to be arrogance was, actually, quite the opposite — a painful shyness the boy had spent years hiding behind a cold, unsmiling mask. （actually插入语制造反转+破折号补释，人物形象逆转）

advancedExpressions.expression: I should point out that, actually, ...
advancedExpressions.example: I should point out that, actually, the event has been rescheduled to Saturday afternoon, so I sincerely hope this note reaches everyone in good time. （礼貌澄清句式，通知/说明中纠正误解）

advancedExpressions.expression: contrary to popular belief, ... is actually ...
advancedExpressions.example: Contrary to popular belief, failure is actually not the opposite of success but a necessary chapter of it, for no lasting achievement was ever written without a few painful drafts. （contrary to+actually 双重纠偏+比喻收尾，颠覆常识的论证）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The film looks easy to make, but it is actually very hard.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: What looks, on screen, like two effortless hours of magic is actually the fruit of years of painstaking labour — a thousand invisible decisions distilled into a single seamless illusion. （议论文/说明文·揭示真相）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: what looks like...is actually 表里对比 + 破折号同位语补释 + a thousand...distilled into a single 数量对照升华 + seamless illusion 收尾呼应

sentenceUpgrade.original: I thought he was unfriendly, but actually he was kind.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The boy I had dismissed as cold and unfriendly turned out, actually, to be the gentlest soul in the class — the first to lend a pen, the last to laugh at another's stumble. （读后续写·印象反转·细节佐证）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: dismissed as 前置贬评 + turned out actually to be 反转 + 破折号内对称细节(the first...the last...)具象化善良，避免空泛的 kind

classPractice.question: ____ (actual), the film you see on the screen is the product of a huge amount of hard work.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；句首用副词 actually 修饰全句，表"实际上"，首字母大写

classPractice.question: You may think the exam was easy, but ____ (actually / actual) most students found it quite challenging.
classPractice.note: 空格修饰后面整个句子作状语，用副词 actually；actual 是形容词，只能修饰名词

classPractice.question: In fact, he had never been to Paris before. → ____, he had never been to Paris before.
classPractice.note: actually 与 in fact 同义，均可置句首引出实情、表转折纠正

translation: 简洁的，简单的；短时间的
original_sentence: Today, I'll give you a brief introduction to some aspects of film-making you might not be familiar with.
readingExamples: Today, I'll give you a brief introduction to some aspects of film-making you might not be familiar with.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. lasting only a short time; short in duration
(2) adj. using few words; concise
(3) adj. (of clothing) short and not covering much of the body
(4) n. a set of instructions or a summary of facts explaining a task, case or situation
(5) vt. to give someone detailed instructions or essential information in advance

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】任务介绍，指示（instructions and information relating to a particular situation, job or task）
uncommonMeanings.example: It wasn't part of his brief to speak to the press. 交付他的任务不包括向新闻界发言。（【课件】brief 作名词·任务/指示）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】给（某人）指示，向（某人）介绍情况（brief sb on / about sth）
uncommonMeanings.example: The president has been fully briefed on the situation in Haiti. 总统已充分了解海地局势。（【课件】brief 作动词）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件·拓展】①短暂地，暂时地 ②简短地，简要地
uncommonMeanings.example: We stopped off briefly in London on our way to Geneva. (①短暂地) Sonia explained briefly what we had to do. (②简短地) （【课件·拓展】briefly 双义）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 任务简介；（律师的）案情摘要，诉讼要点
uncommonMeanings.example: The young lawyer stayed up all night poring over the brief, determined to find the single overlooked detail that might set an innocent man free. （读后续写·法庭·执着钻研）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 向……作简要介绍；面授机宜（brief sb on sth）
uncommonMeanings.example: Before we set off into the mountains, the guide briefed us on every hidden danger, his voice calm but his eyes deadly serious. （读后续写·探险前·紧张铺垫）

posExamples.sentence: Their reunion was painfully brief — a hurried hug on a crowded platform — yet in those ten seconds a whole year of longing seemed to pour silently from one heart into another. （读后续写·离别重逢·情感浓缩）
Today, I'll give you a brief introduction to some aspects of film-making you might not be familiar with. （说明文/应用文·课文原句）
Since your time is precious, I will keep this proposal brief and focus only on the two changes that would most benefit our reading club. （应用文·建议信开篇）
However brief a kind word may be, its warmth can linger in a stranger's memory for a lifetime, proving that the smallest gestures often cast the longest shadows. （议论文·善意的力量）

wordForms.noun: brief（案情摘要/任务简介）/ brevity（简短，简洁）
wordForms.verb: brief（向……简要介绍；brief sb on sth）
wordForms.adverb: briefly（简要地；briefly, 简言之，作句首连接副词）
wordForms.other: debrief（v. 听取汇报，事后询问）；★名言 Brevity is the soul of wit 言以简洁为贵。★in brief=briefly=to be brief 简言之，三者可互换作句首过渡。

idioms.example: In brief, the trip taught me that a map may show the way, but only courage can carry you along it. （读后续写/议论文·总结点题）
To be brief, I am writing to apply for the position of volunteer guide at the coming science exhibition. （应用文·申请信开门见山）

idioms.idiom: brevity is the soul of wit
idioms.translation: 言以简洁为贵（简洁是智慧的灵魂）
idioms.example: Remembering that brevity is the soul of wit, the champion debater made her point in a single unforgettable sentence and sat down to thunderous applause. （议论文·表达艺术·名言化用）

collocations.translation: 对……的简要介绍（【课件】adj. 简洁的，扼要的；课文原句）
collocations.example: Today, I'll give you a brief introduction to some aspects of film-making you might not be familiar with. （【课件】课文原句；brief adj. ① using very few words 简洁的，扼要的）

collocations.phrase: a brief visit / a brief silence（adj. 时间短暂的）
collocations.translation: 短暂的访问 / 暂时的沉默（【课件】brief adj. ② lasting only a short time 时间短暂的）
collocations.example: It'll only be a brief visit because we really haven't much time. There was a brief silence before he spoke. （【课件】brief 表"时间短暂"）
Let's keep this conversation brief; I have a plane to catch. （【课件】keep this conversation brief 让交谈简洁一点）

collocations.phrase: brief n. 任务介绍，指示
collocations.translation: （关于某任务的）指示，任务简介（【课件】n. instructions and information relating to a task）
collocations.example: It wasn't part of his brief to speak to the press. 交付他的任务不包括向新闻界发言。（【课件】brief 作名词：任务/指示）

collocations.phrase: brief sb (on / about sth) v. 给某人指示
collocations.translation: 向（某人）作简要介绍，面授机宜（【课件】v. to give sb all the information they will need）
collocations.example: The president has been fully briefed on the situation in Haiti. 总统已充分了解海地局势。He asked how many people were briefed about the decision. （【课件】brief 作动词）

collocations.phrase: briefly adv. ①短暂地 ②简短地；in brief 简言之
collocations.translation: 短暂地/暂时地；简短地/简要地；简言之（【课件·拓展】briefly / in brief）
collocations.example: We stopped off briefly in London on our way to Geneva. 我们做了短暂的停留。Sonia explained briefly what we had to do. In brief, he was happy with the result. 简言之，他对结果很满意。（【课件·拓展】briefly 双义 + in brief）
In brief, the trip taught me that a map may show the way, but only courage can carry you along it. （读后续写/议论文·总结点题）

collocations.translation: 就某事向某人作简要介绍/面授机宜
collocations.example: The captain gathered the team and briefed them on the rescue plan, each word landing with the weight of a life at stake. （读后续写·救援部署）
Allow me to begin with a brief introduction to our club before I invite the new members to share their own stories. （应用文·致辞开场）

collocations.translation: 短暂的一刻 / 停顿 / 沉默
collocations.example: There was a brief silence after her question, and in that fragile pause the whole classroom seemed to hold its breath. （读后续写·紧张氛围·细节）

collocations.phrase: keep it brief / make it brief
collocations.example: 'I'll keep it brief,' the coach said, though every player knew that his few blunt words would echo in their minds all through the final match. （读后续写·赛前动员）
During her brief stay in the village, the volunteer teacher planted a love of English in a dozen young hearts that would outlast a lifetime. （读后续写·支教·深远影响）
For a brief period after the storm, the whole valley fell utterly still, as if the world were catching its breath before beginning anew. （读后续写·雨后·环境描写）
Our exchange with the foreign students was brief but unforgettable, leaving each of us richer in friendship and wider in horizon. （应用文·活动感想）
To put it briefly, the secret of his success was neither talent nor luck, but a stubborn refusal to give up. （议论文·总结论点）

collocations.translation: 对……的简要介绍（课文原句）
collocations.example: Today, I'll give you a brief introduction to some aspects of film-making you might not be familiar with. （必修二U1·课文原句）

synonyms.example: Her concise reply — just three well-chosen words — said more than a whole paragraph of empty praise ever could. （读后续写/议论文·言简意赅）
synonyms.usage: concise 特指"用词精练、无冗余"，评价的是语言表达方式，多修饰 reply / summary / style；brief 兼指"时间短"与"篇幅短"，范围更广，可修饰 visit / pause 等非语言事物。

synonyms.example: It was only a short walk to school, yet along that familiar path she rehearsed a thousand versions of the apology she owed her friend. （读后续写·内心活动）
synonyms.usage: short 是最普通的"短"，可指长度、时间、身高、距离等，用途最广；brief 更正式，几乎只用于时间或言辞的"短暂/简短"，不用于形容物体长度或身高。

synonyms.example: A momentary lapse of attention was all it took for the vase to slip from her fingers and shatter across the marble floor. （读后续写·意外瞬间）
synonyms.usage: momentary 强调"仅持续一瞬、转瞬即逝"，程度比 brief 更短，多修饰 lapse / pause / hesitation；brief 指"短暂但仍有一段可感的时长"，如 a brief meeting 可持续数分钟。

advancedExpressions.expression: in brief / briefly / to be brief / to put it briefly / in short
advancedExpressions.example: 五者都表"简言之"，作句首过渡可互换：In brief / Briefly / To be brief / In short, success is ninety percent effort and ten percent luck. （议论文·收束点题）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·简短的（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: brief / short / concise / to the point
advancedExpressions.example: 评价篇幅/时间短可互换：a brief / short / concise report；口语中 keep it brief = keep it short = keep it to the point 长话短说。（应用文·开门见山）

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·brief 词族与一词多性
advancedExpressions.expression: brief (adj. 简短 / n. 摘要 / v. 简要介绍) → briefly (adv.) → brevity (n. 简洁) → debrief (v.)
advancedExpressions.example: brief 一词三性是高考考点：adj. a brief talk；n. read the brief；v. brief the team。名词 brevity 表抽象"简洁"，副词 briefly 可修饰动词或作句首连接词。

advancedExpressions.expression: brief as it was, the moment ... would ...
advancedExpressions.example: Brief as it was, that single glance of forgiveness would warm her through every cold and lonely night in the years that followed. （brief as it was 让步倒装+夸张时间跨度，把短暂瞬间的意义无限放大）

advancedExpressions.expression: I shall be brief, for ...
advancedExpressions.example: I shall be brief, for I know how busy your schedule is; my request concerns one small but meaningful change to the library rules. （I shall be brief 礼貌简洁承诺，正式书信开篇显体贴）

advancedExpressions.expression: in brief, ... — nothing more, nothing less
advancedExpressions.example: In brief, true education is the art of teaching a mind to think for itself — nothing more, nothing less. （in brief 收束+破折号 nothing more, nothing less 斩钉截铁定义，结尾有力）

sentenceUpgrade.original: Their meeting was very short.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Their meeting was heartbreakingly brief — a snatched embrace beneath the departure board — before the crowd swept them apart and the train swallowed him whole. （读后续写·车站离别·细节+比喻）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: heartbreakingly 副词渲染情感 + 破折号内动作特写(snatched embrace) + before 时间从句制造紧迫 + swallowed him whole 拟人收尾

sentenceUpgrade.original: I will give you a brief introduction to our plan.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Allow me to offer only a brief outline of our plan here, so that we may save our precious minutes for the questions and ideas that truly matter. （应用文·会议/演讲开场）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: allow me to 谦辞句式 + only a brief outline 限定谦逊 + so that 目的状语 + that truly matter 定语从句收尾显重点意识

classPractice.type: 词性判断·写出画线词的词性及含义
classPractice.question: 1) Greene spent a brief time at Cambridge. ____ ______________  2) Tell me briefly what your story is about. ____ ______________  3) The men have been fully briefed about the task. ____ ______________  4) Please write a brief description of a typical problem. ____ ______________  5) It was his brief to make sure that the facts were set down. ____ ______________
classPractice.answer: 1) adj. 短时间的，短暂的  2) adv. 简短地，简要地  3) v. 给（某人）指示，向（某人）介绍情况  4) adj. 简洁的，简单的  5) n. 指示（任务介绍）
classPractice.note: 【课件】词性填空原题；brief 一词多性：修饰 time 表"短暂"(adj.)；修饰 description 表"简洁"(adj.)；briefly 修饰动词 tell 作 adv.；been briefed 作被动谓语为 v.；his brief 前有物主代词、作主语为 n.（任务/指示）

classPractice.question: 今天，我将向你们简要介绍一些你们可能不熟悉的电影制作方面的内容。Today, I'll give you a ____ ____ ____ some aspects of film-making you might not be familiar with.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；a brief introduction to sth 对……的简要介绍，介词固定用 to

classPractice.question: ____ (brief), the plan is risky, costly and almost impossible to carry out.
classPractice.note: 句首作连接副词表"简言之"，用 Briefly 或 In brief；空处填一个连接语引出总结

classPractice.question: Before the expedition, the guide ____ us ____ every possible danger on the route.
classPractice.note: brief sb on sth 就某事向某人作简要介绍/面授机宜；此处 brief 作及物动词，用过去式 briefed

original_sentence: Today, I'll give you a brief introduction to some aspects of film-making you might not be familiar with.
readingExamples: Today, I'll give you a brief introduction to some aspects of film-making you might not be familiar with.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. well known to you; easily recognized because you have seen or experienced it before
(2) adj. (familiar with sth) having a good knowledge of something; well acquainted with
(3) adj. friendly and informal, sometimes in a way that is too relaxed or over-friendly
(4) adj. commonly seen or encountered; ordinary and everyday

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （贬）过分随便的，套近乎的；放肆的
uncommonMeanings.example: His tone grew a little too familiar for a first meeting, and she took an instinctive step back, uneasy at how quickly he had dropped every formality. （读后续写·社交警觉·分寸感）

posExamples.sentence: The moment she pushed open the creaking gate, a familiar smell of jasmine and old wood rushed to meet her, and twenty years of memories came flooding back in a single, dizzying wave. （读后续写·故地重游·嗅觉记忆）
Today, I'll give you a brief introduction to some aspects of film-making you might not be familiar with. （说明文/应用文·课文原句）
To help our exchange guests feel at home, we have prepared a handbook of familiar Chinese customs, so that no gesture of kindness will be lost in translation. （应用文·活动方案）
Real growth begins the moment we dare to leave the familiar behind; comfort zones, however cosy, are also the walls that quietly imprison our potential. （议论文·走出舒适区）

wordForms.verb: familiarize / familiarise（使熟悉；familiarize oneself with sth）
wordForms.other: unfamiliar（adj. 不熟悉的）；★双向辨析核心：主语是"人"用 be familiar with（人主动熟悉某物）；主语是"物"用 be familiar to（物为某人所熟悉）。The subject is familiar to me = I am familiar with the subject.

idioms.translation: 亲近生狎侮；越熟悉越易轻慢
idioms.example: The proverb warns that familiarity breeds contempt, yet true friendship somehow reverses it — the better two people know each other, the deeper their respect grows. （议论文·人际关系·名言辩证）
The stranger's excuse had a familiar ring to it, and only later did she realise it was the very same lie she had once told her own mother. （读后续写·悬疑·记忆闪回）

collocations.translation: 某事物为某人所熟悉（【课件】主语是事物）
collocations.example: This kind of situation was all too familiar to Thomas. （【课件】sth is familiar to sb 某事为某人所熟悉）

collocations.translation: 某人熟悉、通晓某事物（【课件】主语是人；课文用法）
collocations.example: Are you familiar with this type of machine? / Today, I'll give you a brief introduction to some aspects of film-making you might not be familiar with. （【课件】sb be familiar with sth 熟悉、通晓某事；课文原句）
When arriving in a foreign country, you'd better first familiarize yourself with the local situation. 当你到了国外，你最好先熟悉当地的情况。（【课件】familiarize oneself with sth）

collocations.phrase: familiarity n. 熟悉，通晓；unfamiliar adj. 不熟悉的
collocations.translation: 熟悉/通晓（名词）；不熟悉的（反义）（【课件】词族拓展）
collocations.example: When she saw the house, she had a feeling of familiarity as if she had been there before. / If the baby is put into an unfamiliar playroom without its mother, it ignores the toys. （【课件】familiarity / unfamiliar 汉译英原题）

collocations.translation: （事物）为某人所熟悉（主语是事物）
collocations.example: The old lullaby was so familiar to her that, though she had not heard it in decades, every note found its way home to her heart. （读后续写·记忆唤醒·主语区分）

collocations.translation: 熟悉的面孔 / 声音 / 景象
collocations.example: Lost and frightened in the vast foreign airport, she suddenly caught sight of a familiar face in the crowd, and relief broke over her like a warm tide. （读后续写·异乡遇故人）

collocations.translation: 看起来 / 听起来 / 似乎眼熟
collocations.example: The handwriting on the anonymous note looked oddly familiar, and a cold suspicion began to take shape in the back of his mind. （读后续写·悬疑推进）
Within a single term the new teacher was on familiar terms with every student, greeting each by name and, more remarkably, by dream. （读后续写·亲和力·师生情）
Returning to the familiar routine of morning bells and shared lunches, she realised how deeply she had missed the ordinary rhythm of school life. （读后续写·回归日常）
As the volunteers grew familiar with the villagers' habits and hardships, mere sympathy slowly deepened into genuine, lasting friendship. （议论文/记叙·志愿服务）

collocations.translation: （人）熟悉、通晓某事物（主语是人，课文用法）
collocations.example: Today, I'll give you a brief introduction to some aspects of film-making you might not be familiar with. （必修二U1·课文原句；主语 you 是人，用 be familiar with）
Before the debate, we spent a week familiarizing ourselves with every argument the other side might possibly raise. （应用文/议论文·充分准备）

synonyms.translation: 熟悉的，了解的（be acquainted with）
synonyms.example: Only those well acquainted with hardship can truly understand how much courage an ordinary smile sometimes conceals. （议论文·苦难与坚强）
synonyms.usage: acquainted 较正式，几乎只用于 be acquainted with 结构，表"对某人/某事有所了解"；familiar 更常用、语气更自然，且可作 a familiar face 这类定语，acquainted 不能。

synonyms.example: It is a well-known fact that regular exercise sharpens not only the body but also the focus of the mind. （议论文·健康主题）
synonyms.usage: well-known 强调"广为人知、有名气"，评价知名度；familiar 强调"因见过而熟悉、亲切"，主观色彩更强，如 a familiar face 熟脸不等于 a well-known face 名人脸。

synonyms.example: Kindness may be common, yet it is precisely its quiet, everyday presence that keeps the fabric of society from tearing apart. （议论文·平凡的善）
synonyms.usage: common 侧重"普遍存在、不稀奇"，客观描述频率；familiar 侧重"因熟悉而亲切或易辨认"，带认知与情感色彩，二者有时可换但重心不同。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·familiar with 与 familiar to 双向辨析
advancedExpressions.expression: sb be familiar with sth ⇄ sth be familiar to sb（主语互换，介词随之改变）
advancedExpressions.example: I am familiar with the song. = The song is familiar to me. 主语是人→with(人熟悉物)；主语是物→to(物为人所熟悉)。二者可等值互换，高考语法填空高频考介词。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·熟悉某事物（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: be familiar with / be acquainted with / have a good knowledge of / be well versed in
advancedExpressions.example: 四者都表"通晓、熟悉"，正式度递增，可替换：Anyone familiar with / acquainted with / well versed in local history knows this legend. （议论文/应用文·介绍）

advancedExpressions.expression: familiar (adj.) → familiarity (n.) → familiarize (v.) → unfamiliar (adj. 反义)
advancedExpressions.example: 词族派生：形容词 familiar、名词 familiarity、动词 familiarize、加 un- 构反义 unfamiliar。familiarize oneself with 使自己熟悉，是主动"熟悉"的动词化表达。

advancedExpressions.type: 读后续写·环境唤醒记忆
advancedExpressions.expression: the familiar ... brought a flood of memories rushing back
advancedExpressions.example: The familiar creak of the third stair brought a flood of memories rushing back — her father's footsteps, the smell of ink, the warm circle of lamplight where childhood had once felt safe forever. （familiar+具体触发物+破折号排比意象，感官唤醒记忆的续写定式）

advancedExpressions.expression: to help you feel at home, we have made everything as familiar as possible
advancedExpressions.example: To help you feel at home during your stay, we have tried to make everything as familiar as possible, from the dishes on your table to the songs in the welcome hall. （to help...feel at home+as...as possible，接待/邀请信显周到）

advancedExpressions.expression: growth begins where the familiar ends
advancedExpressions.example: Growth begins precisely where the familiar ends, for it is only by stepping beyond the comfort of the known that we ever discover what we are truly capable of. （growth begins where...ends 警句式+it is only by 强调，走出舒适区的有力论证）

sentenceUpgrade.original: When she got home, everything looked familiar.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The moment she stepped through the door, every familiar corner reached out to greet her — the chipped teapot, the sun-faded curtains, the clock that had always run five minutes slow — and something long knotted in her chest quietly came undone. （读后续写·归家·细节+情感释放）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: the moment 时间从句 + 拟人(reached out to greet her) + 破折号内三项具体旧物排比 + something...came undone 内心具象化收尾

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should not always stay in a familiar environment.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Clinging forever to familiar surroundings may feel safe, but it is a costly kind of safety, for the mind, like a muscle, weakens in comfort and strengthens only against the resistance of the new. （议论文·舒适区反思·比喻）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: clinging to 动名词主语 + a costly kind of safety 矛盾修辞 + like a muscle 明喻 + weakens/strengthens 对比 + against the resistance of the new 收尾深化

classPractice.type: 汉译英·用所给词的适当形式填空
classPractice.question: 1) If the baby is put into a(n) ________ (familiar) playroom without its mother, the baby ignores the toys no matter how interesting they might be. （不熟悉的）  2) When she saw the house, she had a feeling of ________ (familiar) as if she had been there before. （熟悉感）
classPractice.note: 【课件】原题；1) 陌生的游戏室，反义前缀 un- → unfamiliar (adj.)；2) a feeling of + 名词，familiar → familiarity (n. 熟悉)

classPractice.question: 当你到了国外，你最好先熟悉当地的情况。When arriving in a foreign country, you'd better first ____________ ________ the local situation.
classPractice.note: 【课件】原题；familiarize oneself with sth 使自己熟悉…；主语隐含 you，反身代词用 yourself

classPractice.question: I'll give you a brief introduction to some aspects of film-making you might not be familiar ____.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；主语 you 是人，用 be familiar with sth（人熟悉某物）

classPractice.question: The tune sounded so familiar ____ (to / with) me that I hummed along at once.
classPractice.note: 主语 The tune 是事物，用 be familiar to sb（事物为某人所熟悉）；主语是人才用 with

classPractice.question: She is familiar with the local customs. → The local customs are ____ ____ ____.
classPractice.note: 主语由人(She)换成物(customs)，介词随之由 with 变 to，宾语人称改宾格 her

original_sentence: To begin with, I'd like to draw your attention to an important factor of a film – sound effects.
readingExamples: To begin with, I'd like to draw your attention to an important factor of a film – sound effects.
definitionEn:
(1) n. one of several things that influence or cause a situation or result
(2) n. maths: a number that divides exactly into a larger number
(3) n. a level of protection provided by a substance (e.g. a factor 30 sunscreen)
(4) vt. (usu. factor sth in / into) to include a particular thing when making a calculation or decision

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （数学）因数，因子
uncommonMeanings.example: "The factors of twelve are one, two, three, four, six and twelve," the boy explained, his chalk squeaking across the board as the whole class fell silent in reluctant admiration. （读后续写·课堂·后进生逆袭）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （把某因素）计入，考虑进去（factor sth in / into）

collocations.example: The sound of the doors opening in the Star Trek films was made simply by pulling a sheet of paper out of an envelope. （必修二U1·课文原句）

collocations.phrase: a sheet of glass / metal / ice
collocations.translation: 一块玻璃／金属板；一片冰面
collocations.example: The pond had frozen into a smooth sheet of ice, gleaming like polished silver under the winter sun. （读后续写·冬景）
Every Sunday morning, Grandma would change the sheets and fill the whole house with the clean scent of sunshine. （读后续写·亲情·日常）
Make sure your name is written clearly at the top of the answer sheet before the exam begins. （应用文·考试须知）

collocations.phrase: rain / snow comes down in sheets
collocations.example: By midnight the snow was coming down in sheets, and the mountain hut was soon buried to its windows. （读后续写·风雪）
A sheet of water surged across the lowland, sweeping away everything in its path. （读后续写·洪灾）
He stared at the blank sheet before him, his mind as empty as the page. （读后续写·写作困境）

synonyms.example: She turned the yellowed page, and a pressed flower slipped quietly into her lap. （读后续写·旧物）
synonyms.usage: page 指书本或本子中"翻页"的一页（有页码、通常装订成册）；sheet 指单独、可数的"一张"纸，未必装订成册，如 a sheet of paper。

synonyms.example: A thin layer of frost coated the windowpane, turning it into a canvas of silver ferns. （读后续写·冬晨）
synonyms.usage: layer 强调"一层"（可上下堆叠、有厚度感）；sheet 强调"一大片、平铺展开"的整体表面，如 a sheet of ice 一片冰面。

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·量词 a sheet of
advancedExpressions.expression: a sheet of paper / glass / metal / ice / flame / water
advancedExpressions.example: sheet 作量词修饰不可数名词，表"一张/一块/一片"：a sheet of paper 一张纸、a sheet of ice 一片冰、a sheet of flame 一片火焰。是高考量词搭配考点。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·倾盆大雨（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: rain comes down in sheets / it rains cats and dogs / it pours / the heavens open

advancedExpressions.expression: the rain came down in sheets, and ...
advancedExpressions.example: The rain came down in sheets, and each thunderclap seemed to echo the turmoil raging within her heart. （in sheets 写暴雨 + 环境与心理呼应，情景交融）

advancedExpressions.expression: please make sure ... on the ... sheet
advancedExpressions.example: Please make sure to fill in every blank on the registration sheet, so that we can process your application without delay. （please make sure 礼貌祈使 + so that 目的状语，通知类得体表达）

advancedExpressions.expression: a mere sheet of ... can nonetheless ...
advancedExpressions.example: A mere sheet of paper, in the hands of a determined writer, can nonetheless topple prejudice and awaken a slumbering nation. （a mere...can nonetheless 让步对比，以小物喻大理）

sentenceUpgrade.original: It was raining very heavily.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The rain was no longer falling but coming down in sheets, hammering the tin roof so fiercely that the two of them had to shout to be heard above the din. （读后续写·暴雨场景）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: no longer...but 对比升级 + in sheets 地道表暴雨 + hammering 拟声动词 + so...that 结果状语写声响之大

sentenceUpgrade.original: She wrote her name on the paper and handed it in.

original_sentence: The sound of the doors opening in the Star Trek films was made simply by pulling a sheet of paper out of an envelope.
readingExamples: The sound of the doors opening in the Star Trek films was made simply by pulling a sheet of paper out of an envelope.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a flat paper container in which a letter or document is placed before being sent by post
(2) n. a covering that surrounds or encloses something
(3) n. (push the envelope) the outer limits of what is possible or allowed

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （push the envelope 中）极限，边界，可能性的范围
uncommonMeanings.example: Determined to push the envelope of what a school choir could achieve, she rearranged the classic piece into a daring blend of jazz and folk. （读后续写·创新·挑战极限）

posExamples.sentence: With trembling fingers she tore open the envelope, and as her eyes fell on the bright red 'Congratulations', tears of relief blurred the words she had waited so long to read. （读后续写·录取通知·喜极而泣）
Please find enclosed in the envelope a detailed schedule of the event, along with a map to help you locate the venue without any trouble. （应用文·邀请信）
In an age of instant messaging, a hand-written letter sealed in an envelope carries a warmth and sincerity that no screen can ever replicate. （议论文·传统与科技）
Tucked at the back of the old drawer lay a yellowed envelope, unopened for thirty years, holding a secret the whole family had long forgotten. （读后续写·旧物·悬念）

idioms.example: Great inventors are those who dare to push the envelope, refusing to accept the word 'impossible'. （议论文·创新）

collocations.phrase: pull a sheet of paper out of an envelope
collocations.translation: 从信封里抽出一张纸（课文原句）
collocations.example: The sound of the doors opening in the Star Trek films was made simply by pulling a sheet of paper out of an envelope. （必修二U1课文原句：Star Trek 拉门声的制作）

collocations.translation: 突破极限，挑战常规（熟词僻义）
collocations.example: Great inventors dare to push the envelope, refusing to accept 'impossible'. （议论文·创新·挑战极限）
He tore open the envelope so eagerly that half the letter ripped along with it. （读后续写·急切）
She sealed the envelope, pressed it to her lips for luck, and dropped it into the postbox. （读后续写·寄信）

collocations.translation: 写好回信地址／贴好邮票的信封
collocations.example: Kindly enclose a stamped, self-addressed envelope so that we may return your certificate promptly. （应用文·通知）
Enclosed in the envelope you will find two tickets to Saturday's charity concert. （应用文·邀请信）

collocations.phrase: slip / put sth into an envelope
collocations.example: Without a word, the old man slipped a few crumpled notes into an envelope. （读后续写·无声的善意）

collocations.translation: 空的／封着的／泛黄的信封
collocations.example: At the bottom of the box lay a sealed envelope addressed, in faded ink, to a name none of them recognised. （读后续写·悬念）

synonyms.example: The letter had lost its cover, but the message inside remained perfectly legible. （读后续写·旧信）
synonyms.usage: cover 泛指任何"封套、外壳"，用途广；envelope 专指装信件、文件的"信封"。

synonyms.example: He smoothed out the crumpled wrapper and read the tiny print with a magnifying glass. （读后续写·细节）
synonyms.usage: wrapper 指包裹商品的"包装纸"；envelope 特指邮寄用的纸质"信封"，两者场合不同。

advancedExpressions.expression: tear open / seal / slip sth into an envelope; enclosed in the envelope
advancedExpressions.example: She tore open the envelope, only to seal her reply and slip it back before dawn. （拆开／封上／塞入一组动作短语，续写寄信场景连贯）

advancedExpressions.expression: push the envelope（突破极限，挑战常规）
advancedExpressions.example: Determined to push the envelope of what a school choir could achieve, she rearranged the classic into a daring blend of jazz and folk. （envelope 由'信封'引申为'极限、边界'）

advancedExpressions.expression: envelope (n. 信封) / envelop (vt. 包围，笼罩)
advancedExpressions.example: As night fell, a heavy silence began to envelop the empty house. （名词 envelope 结尾有 e；动词 envelop 无 e，重音后移，勿混淆）

advancedExpressions.expression: with trembling fingers, sb. tore open the envelope, only to ...
advancedExpressions.example: With trembling fingers, she tore open the envelope, only to find a single line that changed everything she had believed. （伴随状语写紧张 + only to 意外转折，制造悬念高潮）

advancedExpressions.expression: please find enclosed in the envelope ...
advancedExpressions.example: Please find enclosed in the envelope the programme and a small souvenir, which we hope will add to your enjoyment. （please find enclosed 书信正式套语 + which 非限定从句，得体周到）

advancedExpressions.expression: a letter sealed in an envelope carries ... that no ... can replicate
advancedExpressions.example: A letter sealed in an envelope carries a human warmth that no digital message can ever replicate. （that no...can replicate 定语从句强调不可替代性，突出立场）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She opened the envelope and was very happy to see she was accepted.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Her heart pounding, she slid a fingernail beneath the flap and drew out the letter; the instant the word 'Admitted' leapt off the page, a wave of joy so fierce washed over her that her knees nearly gave way. （读后续写·录取·狂喜）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Her heart pounding 独立主格写紧张 + slid...beneath the flap 动作细节 + the instant... 时间状语抓瞬间 + so...that 结果状语 + knees gave way 生理反应写激动

sentenceUpgrade.original: Please look at the map in the envelope.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: For your convenience, we have tucked a detailed map inside the envelope, which should guide you to the venue with ease. （应用文·邀请信）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: For your convenience 礼貌开头 + tuck...inside 生动动词 + which 非限定定语从句 + with ease 收尾，语气周到得体

classPractice.question: True innovators are never content with the ordinary; they constantly ____ the envelope of what is thought possible.
classPractice.note: push the envelope 突破极限，挑战常规；envelope 熟词僻义'边界、极限'

classPractice.question: The mysterious sound in the film was made simply by ____ (pull) a sheet of paper out of an envelope.

translation: 认为有重要性，重视；把...固定，附上
original_sentence: Another aspect I attach great importance to is visual special effects.
readingExamples: Another aspect I attach great importance to is visual special effects.
definitionEn:
(1) vt. to fasten or join one thing to another
(2) vt. to include something as part of something else, especially a document with a letter or email
(3) vt. (attach importance / value / weight to sth) to believe that something has a particular level of importance
(4) vt. (be attached to sb/sth) to like or love somebody or something very much

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】（attach to sth）与……有关联；（危害、条件等）附着于、伴随
uncommonMeanings.example: No one suggests that any health risks attach to this product. （课件例句：没人指出该产品会危害健康）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①（attach importance / value / weight to sth）认为……有（重要性、价值）；重视（课文义）
uncommonMeanings.example: Another aspect I attach great importance to is visual special effects. （必修二U1课文原句：影评人最看重的方面）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②（be / become attached to sb/sth）依恋，喜爱，对……有感情
uncommonMeanings.example: Over those long winter months she had grown so attached to the stray cat that giving it away brought a lump to her throat. （读后续写·人与动物·不舍）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ③把……固定／附上；（邮件）添加附件
uncommonMeanings.example: He attached a small note to the bunch of flowers, though he lacked the courage to sign his name. （读后续写·暗恋）

posExamples.sentence: Carefully, she attached the tiny bell to the kitten's collar, smiling as it chased the jingling sound round and round the sunlit room. （读后续写·温馨·童趣）
I have attached my résumé and two letters of recommendation to this email, and I would be grateful if you could consider my application. （应用文·求职信）
We should attach greater importance to mental health, for a sound mind is no less vital to a student's growth than a strong body. （议论文·健康）
The rescue team attached the rope to a sturdy rock and, one by one, lowered the trapped hikers to safety. （读后续写·营救·惊险）

wordForms.other: 反义 detach (vt. 拆卸，分开)；固定短语 no strings attached 无附加条件；attach importance to 中 to 为介词，后跟名词/doing

idioms.translation: 没有附加条件，无条件的
idioms.example: The kind old man offered to fund her studies with no strings attached, asking only that she one day help another child in need. （读后续写·善意·传承）

collocations.example: Another aspect I attach great importance to is visual special effects. / I attach significance / great importance to this research. （课件Reading Para3原句＋课件例句）
Attach the coupon to the front of your letter. / Why not attach labels to the things before you put them away? （课件例句：把优惠券附在信正面／贴标签）

collocations.translation: 【课件】现附上……（附件前置的倒装表达）
collocations.example: Attached is a copy of the spreadsheet. / I attach a copy of my notes for your information. （课件例句：附电子表格／笔记一份）
How can you attach a condition to my admission to your club? （课件例句：对加入俱乐部附加条件）

collocations.translation: 【课件】与……有关联；（危害等）附着于
collocations.example: No one suggests that any health risks attach to this product. （课件例句：没人指出该产品会危害健康）
I've never seen two people so attached to each other. （课件例句：形影不离；attached adj. 喜爱的、依恋的）

collocations.translation: 【课件】in the attachment 在附件中；a child's strong attachment to its parents 孩子对父母的依恋
collocations.example: in the attachment / a child's strong attachment to its parents （课件例句：attach → attachment 名词，附件义与依恋义）

collocations.translation: 十分重视……（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Another aspect I attach great importance to is visual special effects. （必修二U1课文原句；attach importance to 后 to 是介词，接名词/动名词）

collocations.phrase: attach importance / value / weight to sth
collocations.example: Chinese families have always attached great importance to education. （议论文·教育观）
He attached a small note to the bunch of flowers. （读后续写·暗恋）
After only a week at the shelter, the children had become deeply attached to the gentle old dog. （读后续写·感情）

collocations.phrase: attach a file / document (to an email)
collocations.example: Please attach the completed form to your reply so that we can register you at once. （应用文·通知）
The scholarship was offered freely, with not a single condition attached. （应用文·说明）

collocations.translation: 归咎于，把责任归于某人
collocations.example: It would be unfair to attach all the blame to a single student when the whole team fell short. （议论文·公正）

collocations.phrase: attach a label / tag to sth
collocations.example: We should be careful not to attach hasty labels to those we do not understand. （议论文·包容）

synonyms.example: She fastened the badge to her coat and stepped proudly onto the stage. （读后续写·荣誉）
synonyms.usage: fasten 侧重"系牢、扣紧"具体物品（扣子、绳子等）；attach 含义更广，可指物理连接，也可指附文件、重视、依恋等抽象义。

synonyms.example: A narrow wooden bridge connected the two banks of the roaring stream. （读后续写·环境）
synonyms.usage: connect 强调两者"相连、关联"（未必固定）；attach 强调把一物"附着、固定"到另一物上，联系更紧密。

synonyms.example: I enclose a photograph of our volunteer team for your reference. （应用文·随信附寄）
synonyms.usage: enclose 专指"随信封装入"文件、照片等；attach 现多用于"电子邮件添加附件"或"把A固定到B"。

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·attach 一词多义搭配
advancedExpressions.expression: attach importance to（重视）/ attach A to B（附上）/ be attached to（依恋）
advancedExpressions.example: He attached the badge to his coat, attached great importance to it, and grew so attached to it that he never took it off. （一句串起三义，帮助辨清 attach 的三种用法）

advancedExpressions.expression: attach importance to = value = think highly of = set store by
advancedExpressions.example: We should attach great importance to / value / set great store by honesty. （功能相同，可替换；attach importance to 最书面正式）

advancedExpressions.expression: attach (v.) → attachment (n. 附件/依恋); 反义 detach (v. 分离)
advancedExpressions.example: Her attachment to the old house made it impossible to detach herself from its memories. （attach 加 -ment 变名词；de- 前缀表反义）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·attach importance to 的 to 是介词
advancedExpressions.expression: attach importance to + n. / doing（to 非动词不定式）
advancedExpressions.example: They attach great importance to protecting wildlife, not to protect. （对比 look forward to doing，to 后须用名词或动名词）

advancedExpressions.expression: over time, sb. had grown so attached to ... that ...
advancedExpressions.example: Over the years, the boy had grown so attached to the old apple tree that saying goodbye felt like losing a lifelong friend. （grow so attached that... 递进写依恋 + 比喻收尾，情感真挚）

advancedExpressions.expression: I have attached ..., and would be grateful if ...
advancedExpressions.example: I have attached my portfolio and references, and would be grateful if you could give my application your kind consideration. （I have attached... 书信实用句 + would be grateful if 委婉请求，得体规范）

advancedExpressions.expression: we should attach greater importance to ... than to ...
advancedExpressions.example: As a society, we should attach greater importance to character than to grades, for it is integrity, not scores, that shapes a nation. （attach importance to A than to B 价值对比 + it is...that 强调句）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She loved the little dog very much and did not want to leave it.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: By the time summer drew to a close, she had grown so deeply attached to the little stray that the mere thought of parting sent a sharp ache through her chest. （读后续写·离别·不舍）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: By the time... 时间状语交代过程 + grow deeply attached to 精准表依恋 + the mere thought of 名词化 + sent an ache through her chest 生理化写心痛

sentenceUpgrade.original: We think education is very important.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is a conviction deeply rooted in our culture that we should attach the utmost importance to education, for knowledge remains the one inheritance that neither time nor misfortune can take away. （议论文·教育观）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is a conviction...that 形式主语强调 + attach the utmost importance to 高级搭配 + for 引导原因 + neither...nor 平行结构升华

classPractice.note: 课件Para3练习；attach importance to sth 重视，to 为介词后接动名词 getting

classPractice.type: 【课件·语境应用】用所给词的适当形式填空

classPractice.question: 完成句子：Emma had never taken herself as a crane and become deeply ____ (依恋的) to humans.
classPractice.note: 课件练习；become attached to sb/sth 依恋、喜爱；attached 作形容词

classPractice.question: Another aspect I attach great importance ____ is visual special effects.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；attach importance to sth 中 to 是介词，固定搭配

classPractice.question: After caring for the injured bird for weeks, the girl had become deeply ____ to it and cried when it flew away.
classPractice.note: be / become attached to sb/sth 依恋、喜爱；此处过去分词作表语

classPractice.question: 我们应当更重视品格而非分数。We should ____ greater ____ ____ character than to grades.
classPractice.note: attach importance to A than to B；辨析'重视'的高级表达

original_sentence: Another aspect I attach great importance to is visual special effects.
readingExamples: Another aspect I attach great importance to is visual special effects.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. relating to seeing or to the eyes
(2) adj. done or produced so that it can be seen; presented in the form of pictures or images
(3) n. a picture, film, or piece of film used to illustrate or accompany something

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 视觉材料，图像（复数 visuals 常指影片/演示中的画面）
uncommonMeanings.example: The director spent months perfecting the visuals — every frame glowing like a hand-painted canvas — long before a single word of dialogue was recorded. （读后续写·电影幕后·匠心）

posExamples.sentence: As the lights dimmed, a breathtaking visual feast unfolded on the screen, and the boy who had never left his mountain village sat frozen, tears glistening as a whole new world flooded his senses. （读后续写·初入影院·震撼）
To make your presentation more engaging, I would strongly suggest adding some visual aids such as charts and short clips, which help the audience grasp complex ideas at a glance. （应用文·建议信）
In an age dominated by screens, our visual literacy — the ability to read and question images critically — matters just as much as the ability to read words. （议论文·媒介素养）
Halfway through the lecture, the speaker switched off the visuals and simply told a story, and it was in that quiet darkness that the room finally leaned in. （读后续写·课堂·反差）

wordForms.noun: vision (视力；视觉；远见) / visibility (能见度) / visuals (画面，视觉材料)
wordForms.verb: visualize / visualise (vt. 想象，使形象化)
wordForms.adjective: visual / visible (看得见的) / invisible (看不见的)
wordForms.other: 同根词族：vis-（看）→ vision / visible / visual / visit / revise；辨析 visual 视觉的 vs visible 看得见的 vs vivid 生动的

collocations.translation: 视觉特效（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Another aspect I attach great importance to is visual special effects. （必修二U1课文原句；visual 修饰 special effects）

collocations.translation: 视觉辅助工具（图表、图片等）
collocations.example: A well-chosen visual aid can turn a dull report into a story the audience remembers. （应用文·演讲指导）

original_sentence: CGI has been frequently used in film-making as a special effects technology.
readingExamples: CGI has been frequently used in film-making as a special effects technology.
definitionEn:
(1) adv. often; happening or done many times, especially at short intervals
(2) adv. commonly; as a regular or usual occurrence

posExamples.sentence: In those lonely winter months, she frequently caught herself gazing out of the frosted window, half-hoping to see her father's familiar figure trudging up the snowy path. （读后续写·思念·环境）
Our library is frequently overcrowded during exam weeks, so I am writing to propose that the reading hours be extended until midnight. （应用文·建议信）
Those who read frequently and widely tend to think more clearly, for a well-stocked mind is rarely at a loss for a fresh perspective. （议论文·阅读的价值）
The old lighthouse keeper, though frequently forgotten by the town below, kept his lamp burning night after night, faithful to a duty no one thanked him for. （读后续写·平凡坚守）

wordForms.other: 词族记忆 frequent(adj.) → frequently(adv.) → frequency(n.)；短语 with increasing frequency 越来越频繁地；反义 rarely / seldom 很少

collocations.translation: 被频繁使用（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: CGI has been frequently used in film-making as a special effects technology. （必修二U1课文原句；frequently 修饰被动语态 has been used）
To save everyone's time, we have compiled a list of frequently asked questions on the notice board. （应用文·通知）
The little café by the river was frequently visited by writers seeking a quiet corner. （读后续写·场景）
More frequently than not, the students who ask the most questions learn the fastest. （议论文·学习方法）
Misunderstandings frequently occur when people text instead of talk. （议论文·沟通）
His name was frequently mentioned among the finalists, yet he remained unaware. （读后续写·比赛）
The school website is frequently updated so that parents can follow their children's progress. （应用文·说明）

synonyms.example: He often stayed behind after class to help the slower students catch up. （读后续写·善良）
synonyms.usage: 最口语、最中性的常用词；frequently 略正式，书面语和议论文中更显水平

synonyms.example: She regularly wrote to her grandmother, each letter a small bridge across the miles. （读后续写·亲情）
synonyms.usage: 强调按固定间隔、有规律地发生；frequently 只强调次数多，不一定规律

synonyms.example: Despite failing repeatedly, he refused to abandon his experiment. （读后续写·坚持）
synonyms.usage: 强调同一动作一次次重复，常含‘不断、屡次’意味，语气比 frequently 更执着

advancedExpressions.expression: frequently used / asked / mentioned / updated
advancedExpressions.example: It is one of the most frequently used and frequently misunderstood words in essays. （frequently + 过去分词，作后置定语或状语，书面感强）

advancedExpressions.expression: frequent (adj.) → frequently (adv.) → frequency (n.)
advancedExpressions.example: Because of his frequent visits, the frequency with which he was mentioned grew, until his name came up frequently at every meeting. （形→副→名，一句带全词族）

advancedExpressions.expression: frequently / often / regularly / repeatedly（细微差别）
advancedExpressions.example: He often reads, regularly reviews, and frequently rereads what he loves. （often 最口语；regularly 强调规律；repeatedly 强调反复；frequently 强调次数多且较正式）

advancedExpressions.expression: sb. would frequently find oneself doing sth.
advancedExpressions.example: During those endless afternoons, she would frequently find herself lost in daydreams of a stage bathed in golden light. （'find oneself doing' 刻画不由自主的习惯）

advancedExpressions.expression: as ... is frequently ..., it is high time that ...
advancedExpressions.example: As the school gym is frequently packed to capacity after four o'clock, it is high time that a booking system was introduced. （由现状引出建议，虚拟语气）

advancedExpressions.type: 议论文·数据/普遍性论证

sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Time and again 副词前置 + 动作(glanced)与心理(heart leaping/sink)交织 + only to 转折落差

sentenceUpgrade.original: This word is used a lot in essays.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: This expression, frequently employed in well-crafted argumentative essays, lends a tone of authority that simpler alternatives simply cannot match. （议论文·语言鉴赏）

classPractice.note: 定时定量、有规律用 regularly；frequently 只强调次数多，不一定规律

original_sentence: Generally, scenes requiring CGI are filmed in front of a green screen in the studio.
readingExamples: Generally, scenes requiring CGI are filmed in front of a green screen in the studio.

posExamples.sentence: The moment the young dancer stepped into the mirrored studio, the outside world dissolved; here, among the worn wooden floors and the faint smell of resin, she was finally, fully herself. （读后续写·热爱·画面感）

synonyms.example: In the pottery workshop, clay-streaked hands turned shapeless lumps into graceful bowls. （读后续写·手作）

advancedExpressions.expression: film / recording / art / dance studio; studio apartment; in the studio

original_sentence: This enables CGI effects to be added later.
readingExamples: This enables CGI effects to be added later.
definitionEn:
(1) vt. to make it possible for someone to do something, or for something to happen
(2) vt. to make something possible or easier by providing the means or opportunity
(3) vt. (of technology) to make a device or system able to work or function

posExamples.sentence: A single word of encouragement from his teacher enabled the timid boy to raise his trembling hand at last, and in that instant something inside him quietly shifted forever. （读后续写·鼓励的力量·转变）
The scholarship will enable dozens of gifted but underprivileged students to pursue the university dreams that once seemed hopelessly out of reach. （应用文·倡议书）
Far from replacing human effort, technology at its best simply enables us to do more with the time and talent we already possess. （议论文·科技与人）
The rope, worn but faithful, enabled the exhausted climbers to inch their way up the icy cliff, hand over trembling hand, towards the light above. （读后续写·登山·脱险）

collocations.phrase: enable sb / sth to do sth (= make sth possible)
collocations.translation: 【课件】使某人／某事能够做……；使……成为可能
collocations.example: This enables CGI effects to be added later. / a new programme to enable older people to study at college. （课件Reading Para3原句＋课件例句；enable = make sth possible）
The new train line will enable easier access to Nanjing. （课件例句：新铁路线使去南京更方便）

collocations.translation: 使某事得以（被）完成（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: This enables CGI effects to be added later. （必修二U1课文原句；enable + 宾语 + to do，此处为不定式被动式 to be added）
Years of quiet practice enabled her to play the entire sonata without a single glance at the score. （读后续写·苦练）
Modern technology enables students in remote villages to attend lessons taught by the finest teachers. （议论文·教育公平）
The free library card enables access to thousands of books that would otherwise stay locked behind a price tag. （应用文·倡议）
A supportive environment enables genuine growth, allowing young talents to blossom without fear of failure. （议论文·成长环境）
A few shared words of a common language enabled communication between the two lost travellers. （读后续写·陌生人）
The generous donation financially enabled the school to rebuild its crumbling laboratory. （应用文·报道）

synonyms.example: The extra hour allowed her to finish the painting she had almost given up on. （读后续写·完成）
synonyms.usage: 三词辨析①：既可指'准许(permission)'也可指'使有条件'，语气较弱、最口语；句型 allow sb to do；enable 更强调'赋予能力/提供手段'，不含'许可'义

synonyms.example: Photography is not permitted inside the gallery. （应用文·规定）
synonyms.usage: 三词辨析②：最正式，侧重规则/规定上的'准许'，常用被动 be permitted to do / permit doing；enable 与'许可'无关，只表'使能够'。记忆：allow/permit 给'许可'，enable 给'能力'

synonyms.translation: 赋予（能力/权力），增强信心
synonyms.example: Learning to code empowered the shy girl to build the app she had only dared to dream about. （读后续写·自我实现）
synonyms.usage: 三词辨析③：强调赋予力量、增强自主性与信心，情感色彩更强；enable 更中性，侧重'提供客观条件'

synonyms.example: Clear signposts facilitated the flow of visitors through the crowded exhibition. （应用文·活动组织）
synonyms.usage: 补充辨析：书面正式，强调'使过程更顺畅/更容易'，宾语常为抽象过程；enable 强调'从不可能变为可能'

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·前缀 en- 构成动词（挂 enable）
advancedExpressions.expression: en- + 名词/形容词 → 动词：enable 使能够 / enlarge 扩大 / encourage 鼓励 / ensure 确保 / enrich 使丰富 / endanger 危及 / enforce 强制执行
advancedExpressions.example: The new policy will enable and encourage students to enlarge their vocabulary, enrich their reading and ensure steady progress, without endangering their health or forcing them to overwork. （课件归纳：其他 en- 前缀构成的动词一句串记）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·enable sb/sth to do 唯一句型
advancedExpressions.expression: enable + sb/sth + to do sth（不可接 doing 或 that 从句）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·表示'使能够'

advancedExpressions.expression: it was ... that enabled sb. to ...
advancedExpressions.example: It was not talent but sheer perseverance that enabled him to stand, at last, upon the winner's podium. （强调句 + 对比(not...but) 突出真正的关键，续写点题）

advancedExpressions.expression: ..., which will enable us to ...
advancedExpressions.example: I propose setting up a book-sharing corner, which will enable every student to read widely at no cost. （非限定定语从句说明方案意义）

advancedExpressions.expression: rather than ..., ... enables us to ...

original_sentence: However, the aid of computers isn't always preferred.
readingExamples: However, the aid of computers isn't always preferred.
definitionEn:
(1) vt. to like one thing or person better than another; to choose one thing rather than another because you like it more
(2) vt. to want or wish that something should happen (prefer to do / prefer doing / prefer that ...)
(3) vt. (formal, law) to bring or make a formal accusation against someone (prefer a charge against sb.)

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （法律，正式）提出（控告）：prefer a charge against sb.
uncommonMeanings.example: After weeks of silent suffering, she finally found the courage to prefer a charge against the man who had wronged her, her voice steady for the first time in months. （读后续写·勇气·正义）

posExamples.sentence: While the other children clamoured for the newest toys, little Tom quietly preferred the battered old bicycle his grandfather had left him, for to him it carried a love that no shiny gadget ever could. （读后续写·亲情·懂事）
If it is convenient for you, I would prefer to hold the meeting on Friday afternoon, when most of our members are free from lessons. （应用文·电子邮件）
Many would prefer a life of comfort to one of struggle, yet it is often struggle, not comfort, that carves character out of raw human clay. （议论文·安逸与奋斗）
Exhausted as she was, she preferred to walk the last three miles home under the stars rather than accept a ride from the noisy, careless crowd. （读后续写·独立·选择）

translation: 创造性的，创作的；有创造力的
original_sentence: Peter Jackson, director of The Lord of the Rings films, took a creative approach – he used clever camera angles to make characters seem bigger or smaller than they really were.
readingExamples: Peter Jackson, director of The Lord of the Rings films, took a creative approach – he used clever camera angles to make characters seem bigger or smaller than they really were.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. producing or using original and unusual ideas; showing imagination
(2) adj. involving the making of things through skill, especially in art, writing, music, or design
(3) adj. able to invent and develop original ideas, especially in an artistic way

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 创意工作者（广告/设计行业口语，可数）
uncommonMeanings.example: Fresh out of art school, she was hired as a creative at a small agency, where her wild sketches soon set the whole office buzzing. （读后续写·职场起步·崭露头角）

posExamples.sentence: With a single stroke of chalk, the street artist turned a grey, cracked wall into a leaping tiger — a creative spark that stopped every hurrying passer-by in their tracks. （读后续写·街头艺术·惊艳瞬间）
We warmly invite all students to join our Creative Writing Club, where you can unleash your imagination, exchange original stories, and discover a voice that is uniquely your own. （应用文·社团招募）
A truly creative mind does not merely memorise the answers handed down by others; it dares to question, to reimagine, and to forge fresh paths where none existed before. （议论文·创新精神）
Rather than scolding her son for the crayon marks on the wall, my aunt took a creative approach, framing them and hanging them proudly in the hallway as his 'first exhibition'. （读后续写·亲情·包容）

wordForms.noun: creativity (n. 创造力，不可数) / creation (n. 创造；作品) / creator (n. 创造者) / creature (n. 生物，动物)
wordForms.other: 构词法：create + -ive → creative（-ive 后缀构形容词，表"有……性质的"，如 act→active, effect→effective）；注意区分同根词 creativity（创造力）与 creation（创造行为/作品）、creature（造物→生物）；recreate (vt. 再创造，重现)

collocations.example: Peter Jackson, director of The Lord of the Rings films, took a creative approach. 《指环王》系列的导演彼得·杰克逊采用了一种有创意的方法。（课文原句）

collocations.translation: 有创意的方法／解决方案
collocations.example: Faced with a shortage of funds, the volunteers came up with a creative solution — turning recycled bottles into glowing lanterns for the night market. （读后续写·公益·巧思）
