collocations.translation: 不公平；公正的【课件·派生词】
collocations.example: Standing by in silence while others suffer injustice is itself a failure to be just. （课件派生词：injustice 不公平、just 公正的）

collocations.translation: 充分展现；公平对待（某人/某事）（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: My lecture today may not be able to do justice to all the work people have done behind the scenes. （课文原句：讲座难以充分展现幕后付出）

collocations.translation: 为正义而战 / 主持正义
collocations.example: Throughout history, countless ordinary people have dared to stand for justice against overwhelming odds. （议论文·勇气）
He could, with justice, claim that his hard work rather than luck had brought him success. （议论文·公正评价）
A fair justice system is the cornerstone of any civilised society. （议论文·社会）
The essay argues that equality and justice must go hand in hand if a nation is to prosper. （议论文·主题）

collocations.translation: 善有善报、恶有恶报的因果报应
collocations.example: In a moment of perfect poetic justice, the bully who had mocked the weak was rescued by the very boy he once despised. （读后续写·因果反转）
Fighting for social justice means giving a voice to those who have long been ignored. （议论文·社会）
The grieving family sought justice not out of hatred, but out of love for the truth. （读后续写·亲情/法庭）

synonyms.example: The teacher treated every student with such fairness that no one ever doubted her judgement. （议论文/记叙·公正）
synonyms.usage: fairness 侧重具体待遇上的'不偏不倚、一视同仁'，较日常；justice 更宏大、庄严，常与法律、道德、社会秩序相关

synonyms.translation: 公平，公正(尤指制度上的)
synonyms.example: Educational equity ensures that a child's future is not decided by the place where he happens to be born. （议论文·教育公平）
synonyms.usage: equity 强调'因人制宜的实质公平'，多用于制度、资源分配语境；justice 更强调'是非曲直得到伸张'

synonyms.example: He acted out of pure righteousness, never once considering what he might gain or lose. （议论文·品德）
synonyms.usage: righteousness 偏道德、宗教色彩，指个人的'正直、义举'；justice 偏社会与法律层面的'公正得以实现'

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·司法与正义（课件）
advancedExpressions.expression: bring sb to justice 绳之以法 / a sense of justice 正义感 / promote social justice 促进社会公平 / seek (for) justice 寻求公正 / do justice to 充分展现
advancedExpressions.example: justice 高频短语（课件 Reading Para.5 归纳）：bring...to justice（司法义）、a sense of justice（品德义）、promote social justice、seek for justice、do justice to（评价义），词义随搭配切换。

advancedExpressions.expression: just → justly → justify → justification / justifiable；injustice / unjust
advancedExpressions.example: 由 justice 展开一整族：形容词 just/justifiable、副词 justly、动词 justify、名词 justification，反义加 in-/un-。

advancedExpressions.expression: at last, justice had been done / had prevailed
advancedExpressions.example: At last, justice had been done, and the truth that darkness had buried for so long finally rose into the light. （at last + 抽象名词作主语 + 光暗隐喻，续写沉冤得雪的高潮收束）

advancedExpressions.expression: let us stand up for justice and ...
advancedExpressions.example: Let us stand up for justice and lend a hand to every classmate who is treated unfairly, for silence is itself a kind of injustice. （祈使呼吁 + for 引导原因，倡议信有力结尾）

advancedExpressions.expression: justice delayed is justice denied
advancedExpressions.example: As the old saying goes, justice delayed is justice denied; a right that comes too late may be no better than a right that never comes at all. （引用格言 + 平行同构，论证公正的时效性）

advancedExpressions.expression: bring sb to justice 绳之以法 / a sense of justice 正义感 / do justice to 充分展现
advancedExpressions.example: justice 三大高频块：bring...to justice（司法义）、a sense of justice（品德义）、do justice to（评价义），词义随搭配切换。

sentenceUpgrade.original: Finally the bad man was punished and it was fair.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: When the courtroom doors finally swung open and the verdict was read aloud, a wave of relief washed over the crowd — after so many years of waiting, justice had at last prevailed. （读后续写·法庭高潮）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: When 时间状语铺陈场景 + a wave of relief washed over 比喻 + justice had at last prevailed 抽象名词作主语升华主题

sentenceUpgrade.original: We need a fair society for everyone.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: A truly civilised society is not measured by the height of its skyscrapers, but by the justice it guarantees to its humblest citizen. （议论文·正式）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: not...but... 对比结构 + 具象(skyscrapers)与抽象(justice)对照 + the humblest citizen 以小见大凸显立意

classPractice.question: 无论花多长时间，这位侦探都发誓要把罪犯绳之以法。However long it took, the detective vowed to ____ the criminal ____ ____.
classPractice.note: 课件短语群 bring sb to justice 将某人绳之以法；此处 justice 作'司法'义

classPractice.question: Her strong sense of ____ (just) would not let her stay silent when a classmate was bullied.
classPractice.note: 课件短语群 a sense of justice 正义感；由形容词 just 派生名词 justice

classPractice.question: Staying silent while others suffer ____ (just) is itself a kind of wrongdoing; a truly ____ (just) society protects its weakest members.
classPractice.note: 课件派生词：前空填名词 injustice 不公平（in- 反义前缀），后空填形容词 just 公正的（修饰 society）

classPractice.question: My lecture today may not be able to do ____ to all the work people have done behind the scenes.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；do justice to 充分展现、公平对待，justice 不可数

translation: 恰当处理（某人或某事）；公平对待（某人或某事），给予公正的评价
original_sentence: My lecture today may not be able to do justice to all the work people have done behind the scenes.
readingExamples: My lecture today may not be able to do justice to all the work people have done behind the scenes.
definitionEn:
(1) phr. to treat, represent or judge someone or something fairly, in a way that shows their true worth or full value
(2) phr. to deal with or perform something well enough to show how good it really is
(3) phr. (of a photograph, description, etc.) to represent someone or something as favourably as they deserve

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (常用于餐桌)充分享用、大快朵颐，把食物吃得干干净净以示赞赏
uncommonMeanings.example: After three days lost in the mountains, the rescued boy finally sat down to a warm meal and did full justice to every dish his grandmother had prepared, as tears of relief slid down her cheeks. （读后续写·团圆·饱含深情的一餐）

posExamples.sentence: As the curtain fell, she stood frozen backstage, tears in her eyes, convinced that no words could ever do justice to the roar of applause still echoing through the theatre. （读后续写·舞台谢幕·情感高潮）
I am writing to recommend Li Hua for the exchange programme, for a mere paragraph can hardly do justice to the dedication and kindness she has shown our whole community. （应用文·推荐信）
A single test score can never do justice to a student's true abilities, since creativity, resilience and character all lie far beyond what any examination can measure. （议论文·教育评价）
The photograph on the postcard simply did not do justice to the breathtaking sunrise we witnessed from the summit, its molten gold spilling across an endless sea of clouds. （读后续写·登顶·景物描写）

idioms.translation: 充分发挥自己的水平；不辜负自己的能力
idioms.example: Crippled by nerves in the first round, the young violinist finally did herself justice in the finale, her bow gliding across the strings as if guided by some invisible hand. （读后续写·比赛逆袭）

idioms.idiom: to do sb. justice / in fairness to sb.
idioms.example: To do him justice, the new coach had never promised miracles; he had only asked us to trust the process and never give up. （读后续写·公正评价）

collocations.translation: 给予公正的评价；充分展现（某人/某事的价值）【课件】
collocations.example: My lecture today may not be able to do justice to all the work people have done behind the scenes. （课件原句：讲座恐怕无法对幕后所有工作给予公正的评价）

collocations.phrase: may not be able to do justice to all the work
collocations.translation: 恐怕难以充分展现所有的付出（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: My lecture today may not be able to do justice to all the work people have done behind the scenes. （课文原句：讲座难以充分展现幕后工作）

collocations.translation: 充分体现/尽情享用某物
collocations.example: No summary could do full justice to the sheer scale of the volunteers' effort behind this charity concert. （应用文·感谢信）

collocations.phrase: cannot / can hardly do justice to
collocations.translation: 无法充分展现/难以公正评价
collocations.example: Photographs can hardly do justice to the majesty of the Great Wall winding endlessly over the mountains. （读后续写·景物）
Words cannot do justice to the gratitude I feel towards the strangers who pulled me from the flooded car. （读后续写·感恩）

collocations.phrase: do justice to one's talent / ability
collocations.translation: 使某人的才华得到应有的展现
collocations.example: The dull, repetitive script failed to do justice to the actor's remarkable talent. （议论文·影视评论）

collocations.translation: 与场合相称；不负这一时刻
collocations.example: Determined to do justice to such a solemn occasion, the students bowed their heads and observed a full minute of silence. （应用文·纪念活动）

collocations.phrase: hardly do justice to the truth
collocations.example: A one-sided report can hardly do justice to the truth behind a complex event. （议论文·媒体素养）

collocations.phrase: do justice to the memory of sb
collocations.example: The best way to do justice to the memory of our late teacher is to carry on the kindness he taught us. （应用文·纪念文）

collocations.translation: 没能公正对待某人/某物
collocations.example: The critics admitted afterwards that their harsh reviews had not done the debut novel justice. （议论文·文学评论）

synonyms.example: No lens could truly capture the wonder in the child's eyes as the fireworks bloomed overhead. （读后续写·节日）
synonyms.usage: 侧重'完整生动地再现'某个瞬间或本质，常用于描写/艺术语境；do justice to 更强调'与其应得的价值相称'

synonyms.example: A single exam can never fully reflect the effort a student has poured into an entire year. （议论文·教育）
synonyms.usage: 中性地表示'反映/呈现'，不含'公正、够格'的评价意味；do justice to 隐含'配得上、不辜负'的褒义

synonyms.example: Years later, the discovery finally vindicated the scientist whose theory had once been ridiculed. （议论文·科学史）
synonyms.usage: 偏正式、书面，指'洗刷冤屈、证明清白'；do justice to 更日常，含'给予应有评价/展现应有价值'之意

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·do justice to 家族
advancedExpressions.expression: do sb/sth justice 公平对待 / do oneself justice 发挥水平 / words cannot do justice to 言语难以形容
advancedExpressions.example: 三大变体：do justice to sth（充分展现事物价值）、do oneself justice（考出/发挥应有水平）、words/no words can do justice to（否定强调）。

advancedExpressions.expression: may not / cannot / can hardly do justice to —— 常用否定或情态谦辞
advancedExpressions.example: 该习语高频用于否定：words cannot do justice to... / a mere letter can hardly do justice to...，以'言不尽意'凸显对象之美好或宏大（课文即用 may not be able to）。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·如实展现(只枚举可替换)
advancedExpressions.expression: do justice to = fully capture = truly reflect = faithfully represent
advancedExpressions.example: 表'充分展现其真正价值'时，do justice to 可与 fully capture / truly reflect / faithfully represent 互换（褒义、如实、够格）。

advancedExpressions.expression: no words / nothing could ever do justice to ...
advancedExpressions.example: No words could ever do justice to what that single act of kindness meant to a boy who had long believed himself invisible. （否定强调+情感升华，续写结尾段拔高）

advancedExpressions.expression: a mere ... can hardly do justice to ...
advancedExpressions.example: A mere letter can hardly do justice to the countless hours our teachers have devoted to us beyond the classroom. （谦辞式开头，凸显对方付出之大）

advancedExpressions.expression: ... can never do justice to ..., for ...
advancedExpressions.example: Numbers alone can never do justice to a nation's progress, for the true measure of a society lies in the dignity it affords its weakest members. （否定句+for引导论据，深化论点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The photo was not as beautiful as the real scene.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The faded photograph in my palm did no justice at all to that morning on the cliff — the salt wind in my hair, the gulls wheeling against a sky ablaze with dawn, and the quiet certainty, blooming in my chest, that I was finally free. （读后续写·景物+心理）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: do no justice to 否定强调 + 破折号铺陈感官细节(触觉/视觉) + 现在分词短语(blooming in my chest)状写心理 + 意象升华(free)

sentenceUpgrade.original: One exam cannot show a student's real ability.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is my firm conviction that a solitary examination, however rigorous, can never do justice to a student's true worth, for character, curiosity and courage are qualities that no answer sheet was ever designed to measure. （议论文·教育评价）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is my firm conviction that... 正式主句 + however引导让步 + do justice to 主干 + for引导原因 + 三个c头韵词(character, curiosity, courage)增强气势

classPractice.question: 我今天的讲座恐怕无法充分展现大家幕后所做的一切工作。My lecture today may not be able to ____ ____ ____ all the work people have done behind the scenes.
classPractice.note: 课文原句（课件 Reading Para.5）；do justice to sth 给予公正的评价、充分展现某物的价值

classPractice.question: Photographs can hardly ____ ____ ____ the majesty of the Great Wall winding over the mountains.
classPractice.note: 常用否定/情态谦辞句型 can hardly do justice to 难以充分展现

classPractice.question: No words can fully capture how much that kindness meant to him. -> No words can ____ ____ ____ how much that kindness meant to him.
classPractice.note: do justice to 与 fully capture 同义，均表'如实充分地展现'

classPractice.question: No words can fully capture how much that kindness meant to him. → No words can ____ ____ ____ how much that kindness meant to him.
classPractice.note: do justice to 与 fully capture 同义，均表'如实充分地展现'

original_sentence: Just as the poor passengers on the real Titanic saw the tip of the iceberg, what we see on the cinema screen is just the tip of the huge iceberg of filming.
readingExamples: Just as the poor passengers on the real Titanic saw the tip of the iceberg, what we see on the cinema screen is just the tip of the huge iceberg of filming.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a very large mass of ice floating in the sea, most of which is hidden beneath the surface of the water
(2) n. (figurative) the small, visible part of a much larger hidden problem, situation or body of information
(3) n. (informal) a person who is cold, unemotional or emotionally distant

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 冰山一角（the tip of the iceberg，熟词僻义/固定习语：显露的一小部分，隐藏部分更大）
uncommonMeanings.example: The few cases reported in the news are merely the tip of the iceberg of a far wider crisis. （议论文·社会问题·由表及里）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （比喻）冷漠无情、不动声色的人
uncommonMeanings.example: For years the whole office had regarded the old accountant as an iceberg, until the day they found him weeping quietly over a photograph of the stray dog he had secretly been feeding. （读后续写·反转·冷漠外表下的柔软）

posExamples.sentence: Out of the freezing mist loomed an iceberg the size of a cathedral, its jagged blue walls glittering coldly as the tiny fishing boat drifted helplessly towards them. （读后续写·海上险境·环境描写）
We are writing to remind all residents that the litter visible on our beach is merely the tip of the iceberg, for tonnes of plastic lie hidden beneath the sand and the waves. （应用文·环保倡议书）
The corruption exposed by the journalists proved to be no more than the tip of the iceberg, and each new revelation dragged deeper truths into the light. （议论文·社会治理）
What we admire in a champion — the medal, the podium, the roar of the crowd — is only the tip of the iceberg, concealing years of solitary training in the dark before dawn. （议论文·成功与努力）

wordForms.other: 构词法·合成词：ice（冰）+ berg（源自德语'山'）→ iceberg 冰山；同类合成 icebreaker 破冰船、iceland 冰岛。固定习语 the tip of the iceberg 整体使用，不可拆分替换

idioms.translation: 冰山一角；(问题、情况)显露的一小部分
idioms.example: The complaints reaching the headmaster's desk were only the tip of the iceberg; beneath them simmered a discontent that had been building for years. （读后续写·校园矛盾）

collocations.translation: 冰山一角（课文原句词块，熟词僻义/固定习语）
collocations.example: What we see on the cinema screen is just the tip of the huge iceberg of filming. （课文原句：银幕所见只是拍摄的冰山一角）

collocations.phrase: the tip of the huge iceberg of ...
collocations.translation: ……这座庞大冰山露出的一角（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Just as the poor passengers on the real Titanic saw the tip of the iceberg, what we see on screen is just the tip of the huge iceberg of filming. （课文原句：以泰坦尼克撞冰山类比幕后工作）
A floating iceberg, silent and immense, slid past the porthole in the moonlight. （读后续写·极地航行）
The moment the ship struck the iceberg, a terrible shudder ran through the hull and the lights flickered out. （读后续写·海难）
A melting iceberg, dripping under the relentless sun, has become the haunting image of a warming planet. （议论文·气候变化）
What the audience applauds on screen is just the visible edge of an enormous iceberg of unseen labour. （应用文·观后感）
Beneath the iceberg of his cheerful smile lay a loneliness he had never dared to confess. （读后续写·心理描写）

synonyms.example: The ancient glacier crept down the valley at a pace no human eye could detect. （读后续写·自然）
synonyms.usage: 指陆地上缓慢移动的巨大冰体，不漂浮在海上；iceberg 是断裂入海、随水漂流的冰块

synonyms.synonym: the tip of the iceberg (as a whole)
synonyms.example: These few scandals are just the tip of the iceberg. （议论文）
synonyms.usage: 作固定习语时整体使用，强调'显露的一小部分'；不可拆分成单个iceberg替换

advancedExpressions.expression: the tip of the iceberg —— 冰山一角（固定习语，整体使用）
advancedExpressions.example: 露出海面的只是一小部分，真正巨大的在水面之下；用于'表象只是极小部分'的比喻，议论文/续写皆宜。

advancedExpressions.expression: ice + berg（山）→ iceberg；ice + breaker → icebreaker 破冰船
advancedExpressions.example: berg 表'山'，与 ice 合成 iceberg；掌握词根便于记忆一组'冰'字合成词。

advancedExpressions.expression: out of the mist / darkness loomed an iceberg ...
advancedExpressions.example: Out of the swirling mist loomed an iceberg, so vast and so silent that every voice on deck died in a single held breath. （倒装+loom 制造压迫感，续写险境开场）

advancedExpressions.expression: ... is merely the tip of the iceberg; beneath it lies ...
advancedExpressions.example: The waste we can see is merely the tip of the iceberg; beneath it lies a mountain of pollution invisible to the naked eye. （分号+倒装，倡议信中制造警醒）

advancedExpressions.expression: what ... is only the tip of the iceberg, concealing ...
advancedExpressions.example: What the world celebrates as overnight success is only the tip of the iceberg, concealing years of quiet, unglamorous perseverance. （tip of the iceberg 引申，由表象推向本质）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The ship hit an iceberg and sank.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: There was a sickening groan of tearing steel as the ship struck the iceberg, and within minutes the freezing black water was pouring in, swallowing the laughter and music of only moments before. （读后续写·海难·感官+对比）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 拟声细节(groan of tearing steel) + strike an iceberg 替换 hit + 现在分词(swallowing) + 今昔对比(laughter and music of only moments before)营造悲剧张力

sentenceUpgrade.original: The problems we see are only a small part of the whole.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The difficulties visible on the surface are, in truth, no more than the tip of the iceberg, beneath which lurks a tangle of deeper problems that no quick fix can ever resolve. （议论文·由表及里）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: the tip of the iceberg 习语 + beneath which 定语从句倒装 + lurk 增添潜藏意味 + no quick fix 强调问题之复杂

classPractice.question: 正如泰坦尼克号上的乘客只看到冰山一角，我们在银幕上看到的也只是拍摄这座巨大冰山的一角。Just as the passengers saw the tip of the iceberg, what we see on screen is just the ____ ____ the huge iceberg of filming.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；the tip of the iceberg 冰山一角，固定习语，of 引出整体

classPractice.question: The few scandals exposed so far are merely the ____ of the iceberg; far more remains hidden.
classPractice.note: 熟词僻义习语 the tip of the iceberg 冰山一角，用 tip

classPractice.question: The moment the ship ____ (strike) the iceberg, a terrible shudder ran through the hull.
classPractice.note: hit / strike an iceberg 撞上冰山；the moment 引导时间状语从句，与主句用一般过去时

original_sentence: To the frequently asked question, 'What's your favourite film?', my answer is Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon.
readingExamples: To the frequently asked question, 'What's your favourite film?', my answer is Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a large imaginary creature that can breathe out fire, usually represented as a fierce, winged, fire-breathing beast in Western stories
(2) n. (in Chinese culture) a mythical creature symbolising power, good fortune, nobility and the emperor
(3) n. (informal, disapproving) a fierce, strict or bad-tempered woman who frightens people

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (非正式，贬义)凶悍严厉、令人生畏的女人(常指管教极严的女性)
uncommonMeanings.example: The new librarian had a reputation as a dragon, yet the timid boy soon discovered that behind her stern glasses hid the only adult who ever remembered his name. （读后续写·刻板印象被打破·温情反转）

posExamples.sentence: In the Spring Festival parade, a golden dragon over thirty metres long twisted and soared above the roaring crowd, its scales flashing like a thousand tiny suns. （读后续写·传统节日·场面描写）
On behalf of our club, I warmly invite you to join our dragon-dance workshop, where you will learn how this ancient symbol of good fortune comes alive in skilled hands. （应用文·活动邀请函）

To the Chinese people, the dragon is never a monster to be slain but a noble emblem of strength, wisdom and harmony — a striking example of how one image can carry opposite meanings across cultures. （议论文·文化差异）
In the old fairy tale the brave knight rode out to face the dragon, but the wisest of the villagers whispered that some dragons are best won over, not defeated. （读后续写·童话叙事）

wordForms.other: dragonfly (n. 蜻蜓)

idioms.translation: (俚语)吸食毒品；追逐虚幻/难以企及之物
idioms.example: The novelist warned that endlessly chasing the dragon of fame had left many artists emptier than before. （议论文·名利·比喻用法）

idioms.translation: 播下祸根，埋下冲突的种子(源自希腊神话)
idioms.example: By favouring one child over the other, the parents had unknowingly sown dragon's teeth that would divide the family for years. （读后续写·家庭矛盾）

collocations.example: My answer is Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon. （课文原句化用，答'最喜欢的电影'）
In his nightmare a fire-breathing dragon circled the village. （读后续写·梦境）
The dragon dance drew the loudest cheers of the festival. （应用文·活动通讯）
Every summer dragon boats race towards the finish line. （读后续写·端午）
The young hero set out to slay the dragon. （读后续写·英雄叙事）
Chinese people proudly call themselves the descendants of the dragon. （应用文·文化介绍）
In China the dragon is a symbol of imperial power and good fortune. （议论文·文化）

synonyms.example: A great serpent slid silently through the temple ruins, its eyes gleaming like emeralds. （读后续写·神话）
synonyms.usage: 指蛇形怪物或大蛇，无翼无足、不喷火；dragon 通常有翼、能喷火，且在中西文化中象征意义截然不同

synonyms.example: The knight had slain many a beast, but nothing had prepared him for what waited in the cave. （读后续写·冒险）
synonyms.usage: 泛指凶猛的动物或怪物，范围最广；dragon 特指传说中的龙，文化内涵丰富

advancedExpressions.expression: dragon + n. 构成合成词
advancedExpressions.example: dragonfly (蜻蜓), dragon dance (舞龙), dragon boat (龙舟), dragon-dance workshop (舞龙工作坊)。 （构词提示：dragon 常作定语与名词合成）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·神话怪兽(可替换)
advancedExpressions.expression: dragon / serpent / beast / monster
advancedExpressions.example: The knight faced the dragon (serpent / beast / monster) in the cave. （四词均可指'怪兽'，但文化含义与形态不同，见 synonyms 辨析）

advancedExpressions.expression: In the West ..., whereas / while in China the dragon ...
advancedExpressions.example: In the West the dragon is a monster to be slain, whereas in China it stands for power and good fortune. （whereas 引导对比，凸显中西文化差异）

advancedExpressions.expression: a dragon ..., its scales flashing / shadow blotting out ...
advancedExpressions.example: A golden dragon soared overhead, its scales flashing like a river of fire and its long body coiling through the sky as if the heavens themselves had come alive. （独立主格+明喻，营造节日/神话画面）

advancedExpressions.expression: come alive in ... hands / bring the dragon to life
advancedExpressions.example: Under the dancers' skilful hands, the lifeless silk dragon comes alive, twisting and leaping as though it truly breathed. （动态化描写，用于活动宣传/文化介绍）

advancedExpressions.expression: far from ..., the dragon stands for ...
advancedExpressions.example: Far from being the fearsome monster of Western legend, in China the dragon stands for wisdom, benevolence and prosperity — proof that no symbol is universal. （对比句式，论证文化多元）

sentenceUpgrade.original: A dragon appeared in the sky during the festival.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: As the drums thundered, a colossal dragon burst into the sky above the square, its scales blazing crimson and gold, weaving and plunging through clouds of firework smoke while the crowd below erupted into a single, deafening cheer. （读后续写·节日高潮）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: As引导时间状语铺垫 + 独立主格(its scales blazing) + 一连串现在分词(weaving, plunging) 制造动感 + 声画结合(thundered / deafening cheer)

sentenceUpgrade.original: In China the dragon is a good symbol, but in the West it is bad.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Whereas the Western dragon lurks in caves as a hoard-guarding monster to be slain, its Eastern counterpart soars through the clouds as a benevolent bringer of rain and fortune — a vivid reminder that a single image may wear opposite faces in different cultures. （议论文·文化对比）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Whereas引导对比状语从句 + counterpart 避免重复 + 破折号引出结论(a vivid reminder that...) + 拟人化对照(lurks vs. soars)

classPractice.question: In Western stories the dragon is often a monster to be slain, ____ ____ ____ ____ (然而在中国) it is a symbol of power and good fortune.
classPractice.answer: whereas / while in China / but in China
classPractice.note: 考中西文化对比表达，whereas/while 引导对比状语，注意 in China 位置。

classPractice.question: During the Spring Festival, the ____ dance drew the loudest cheers, and the boats raced in the summer ____ Boat Festival. （用 dragon 填两空）
classPractice.note: dragon 作定语构成合成名词 dragon dance / Dragon Boat Festival。

classPractice.question: 中国人自豪地称自己为龙的传人。（翻译，用 descendants）
classPractice.answer: Chinese people proudly call themselves the descendants of the dragon.
classPractice.note: 固定表达 the descendants of the dragon；call oneself + 宾补结构。

translation: n. 奖，奖品，奖金 | vt. 授予，给予
original_sentence: It has won many awards, including an Academy Award for Best Foreign Language Film.
readingExamples: It has won many awards, including an Academy Award for Best Foreign Language Film.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a prize, certificate or amount of money given to someone as an official recognition of their achievement, skill or quality
(2) vt. to officially give someone a prize, money or other recognition, especially for an achievement or effort
(3) vt. (law) to decide officially that someone should receive something such as compensation or damages

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (法律)判给，裁定给予(赔偿、金额等)
uncommonMeanings.example: After a long and bitter hearing, the court finally awarded the injured worker the compensation he had spent three exhausting years fighting for. （读后续写·维权·迟来的正义）

posExamples.sentence: When her name was called for the top award, the shy girl who had once been mocked for her stutter rose on trembling legs, and the whole hall fell into a hush before bursting into thunderous applause. （读后续写·颁奖·逆袭）
I am delighted to inform you that our school choir has received the National Excellence Award, and on behalf of every member I wish to thank you for your unwavering support. （应用文·喜讯/感谢信）
The committee decided to award the scholarship not merely to the student with the highest marks, but to the one whose courage in adversity had inspired everyone around her. （议论文·评价标准）
Beaming with pride, the old headmaster stepped forward to award the champion his medal, pressing the boy's hand as if to say the whole village had been waiting for this moment. （读后续写·颁奖·师生情）

collocations.phrase: award sb. sth. = award sth. to sb.
collocations.translation: 【课件】授予某人某物(双宾=介词结构，介词用 to)
collocations.example: They awarded Emma first prize. / A Nobel Prize was awarded to Waksman in 1952. （课件原句）

collocations.phrase: receive / win / get an award for sth.
collocations.example: Mr White won an award for his contribution to agricultural production. （课件·完成句子）

collocations.phrase: present sb. with an award = give sb. an award
collocations.example: The mayor presented the young hero with an award for his bravery. （课件搭配化用）

collocations.phrase: the award for ... went to sb.
collocations.example: The award for this year's best actor went to him. （课件原句）
He wept as he stepped onto the stage at the awards ceremony. （课件搭配化用）

collocations.translation: 获奖(课文原句：It has won many awards)
collocations.example: It has won many awards, including an Academy Award for Best Foreign Language Film. （课文原句）
The mayor personally presented the bravery award to the teenager. （读后续写·表彰）
The award-winning film drew huge crowds to cinemas. （应用文·影评）
Being nominated for the award was, in itself, an honour. （读后续写·励志）
The award ceremony was held in the grand old theatre. （读后续写·场面）
The film went on to win an Academy Award for Best Foreign Language Film. （应用文·影评）
The foundation awards ten scholarships each year to students from disadvantaged families. （议论文·教育公平）
At eighty, the veteran actress received a lifetime achievement award. （读后续写·致敬）

collocations.phrase: award sb. sth. / award sth. to sb.
collocations.translation: 授予某人某物(双宾/介词结构)
collocations.example: The judges awarded her first prize for an essay that moved them to tears. （应用文·比赛通讯）

synonyms.translation: n./vt. 回报，报酬；奖赏(酬劳性)
synonyms.example: The honest boy was rewarded with a hearty meal for returning the lost wallet. （读后续写·善有善报）
synonyms.usage: reward 强调'因付出/善行而给的回报或酬劳'，可给金钱、物质或精神满足，不一定经评审；award 是评审机构对'成就/技艺'的正式授予。辨析：award(评审授予的奖项) / reward(对行为的回报) / prize(竞赛所获奖品)。

synonyms.translation: 奖品，奖金(竞赛/抽奖所得)
synonyms.example: She clutched the first prize to her chest as though afraid it might vanish. （读后续写·比赛）
synonyms.usage: prize 多指'竞赛、抽奖'中赢得的具体奖品/奖金，随机性或竞争性更强；award 更正式，强调对成就的官方认可，常由评委会'评审授予'。

synonyms.translation: (尤指政府或机构的)拨款，资助
synonyms.example: The research team applied for a government grant to fund their study. （议论文·科研）
synonyms.usage: 指为特定目的(研究、学习等)提供的资金，不含'表彰'意味；award 侧重对功绩的褒奖。

synonyms.example: It was the highest honour the academy could bestow. （应用文·表彰）
synonyms.usage: 偏抽象、庄重，指'荣誉、殊荣'本身；award 多指具体可授予的奖项/物品。

synonyms.translation: 授予，赋予(学位/头衔/荣誉)
synonyms.example: The university conferred an honorary degree upon the veteran scientist. （议论文·学术）
synonyms.usage: confer 极正式，多用于授予学位/头衔/荣誉；award 用于奖项，语域略低于 confer。

advancedExpressions.expression: win / receive / get / present / be nominated for + an award；award sb. sth. = award sth. to sb.
advancedExpressions.example: The committee awarded her the top prize (= awarded the top prize to her), and she was also nominated for a national award. （双宾与介词结构可互换）

advancedExpressions.expression: award(评审授予的奖) / reward(对善行或付出的回报) / prize(竞赛所获奖品)
advancedExpressions.example: She won a prize in the writing contest, was later given an award by the academy, and received a small reward for helping the judges tidy up. （一句串三词，感知语义差别）

advancedExpressions.expression: award → awardee(获奖者) / award-winning(获奖的，形容词)
advancedExpressions.example: The award-winning director thanked every awardee on stage. （-ee 表'受动者'，award-winning 作定语）

advancedExpressions.expression: when sb.'s name was called for the award, ...
advancedExpressions.example: When her name was finally called for the award, time seemed to freeze, and every hardship she had endured melted into that single, shining moment. （时间凝固+情感升华，续写高潮段）

advancedExpressions.expression: I am delighted to inform you that ... has received / won the ... award
advancedExpressions.example: I am delighted to inform you that our team has won the first-place award, an honour we owe entirely to your generous encouragement. （报喜句式，用于感谢信/通知）

advancedExpressions.expression: an award should honour not ... but ...
advancedExpressions.example: A true award should honour not the loudest achievement but the quiet perseverance that so often goes unseen. （not...but... 对比，重塑评价标准）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She was very happy to win the award.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: As the golden trophy was pressed into her hands, the shy girl who had once believed she would never amount to anything felt hot tears blur the sea of faces before her — for in that instant, the award in her palm weighed far less than the belief now blazing in her heart. （读后续写·心理+对比）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: As引导时间状语 + 定语从句回溯过往(who had once believed...) + 感官细节(hot tears blur) + 破折号引出升华(for...) + 虚实对比(award的重量 vs. belief的重量)

sentenceUpgrade.original: The prize should be given to hardworking students.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is my firm belief that such an award ought to be conferred not upon those who happen to shine brightest on paper, but upon those whose quiet diligence and resilience, though seldom applauded, form the very backbone of any thriving community. （议论文·评价标准）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is my firm belief that... 正式主句 + not...but... 平行对比 + conferred 升级用词 + though seldom applauded 让步插入语 + backbone 隐喻

classPractice.question: Mr White won / received ____ (award) for his contribution to agricultural production.
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】win/receive an award for sth 因……获奖；此处泛指多个奖项，award 可数用复数 awards。

classPractice.question: Tony was ____ (award) a medal for bravery.
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】award sb. sth. 的被动 sb. be awarded sth.；was + 过去分词构成被动语态。

classPractice.question: 选词填空(award / reward / prize)：The academy ____ her the Best Actress title; for saving the child she got a small cash ____; and she once won first ____ in a school singing contest.
classPractice.note: award=评审授予(此处作动词)；reward=对善行的回报；prize=竞赛奖品。三词核心区别。

classPractice.question: The judges awarded the young writer the first prize. → The judges awarded the first prize ____ ____ ____ ____.
classPractice.note: award sb. sth. = award sth. to sb.，双宾变介词结构，介词用 to。

classPractice.question: The documentary is an award-____ (win) film that has received many awards at international festivals.
classPractice.note: 合成形容词 award-winning'获奖的'作定语；win 用现在分词构成主动'赢得奖项'。

original_sentence: It has also enabled Western audiences to have a better understanding of Chinese culture.
readingExamples: It has also enabled Western audiences to have a better understanding of Chinese culture.
definitionEn:
(1) n. the group of people who watch, listen to or attend a performance, film, speech or other event
(2) n. the people who read a particular book, watch a particular programme, or are reached by a particular medium; the readership or target group
(3) n. a formal meeting with an important or powerful person, such as a king, pope or ruler

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (与重要人物的)正式会见，觐见
uncommonMeanings.example: Trembling in his patched coat, the young inventor was at last granted an audience with the emperor, and in a single breath he laid before the throne the dream he had guarded for a lifetime. （读后续写·觐见·命运转折）

posExamples.sentence: The moment the lights dimmed, a hush swept over the audience, and a thousand held breaths seemed to rise together as the first note trembled through the silent hall. （读后续写·演出开场·氛围渲染）
On behalf of the drama club, I sincerely invite you to be part of the audience at our charity performance, where every ticket sold will help a rural child return to school. （应用文·邀请函）
A truly great speaker never talks down to the audience; instead, he treats his listeners as equals, trusting them to think, to question and to draw their own conclusions. （议论文·演讲与沟通）
By adding English subtitles, the film reached a far wider audience and enabled viewers overseas to glimpse the quiet beauty of Chinese village life. （应用文·影视推介）

idioms.idiom: play to the gallery / play to the audience
idioms.example: Instead of playing to the audience with cheap jokes, the young debater won respect by arguing calmly and honestly. （议论文·真诚沟通）

collocations.translation: 【课件】观众(整体→单数，着眼各成员→复数)
collocations.example: The audience was/were clapping for 10 minutes. （课件原句：集合名词谓语单复数均可）
Somewhere in the audience a young man sprang to his feet. （课件原句）
An audience of millions watched the wedding on TV. （课件原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】赢得/触及更广大的观众
collocations.example: His book reached an even wider audience when it was made into a movie. （课件原句）
The target audience for this advertisement was mainly teenagers. （课件原句）
TV, cinema and movie audiences have very different viewing habits. （课件搭配化用）
It has also enabled Western audiences to have a better understanding of Chinese culture. （课文原句）
The young pianist walked onto the stage to face a packed audience of over two thousand. （读后续写·演出）
A gripping opening line can instantly draw an audience into your story. （议论文·写作技巧）

collocations.phrase: the audience burst into applause / laughter
collocations.example: As she finished the final note, the audience burst into thunderous applause. （读后续写·谢幕）
The magician captivated the audience with a trick that defied all explanation. （读后续写·表演）
Performing before a live audience for the first time, his hands would not stop shaking. （读后续写·首秀）

collocations.translation: 接见某人(熟词僻义：正式会见)
collocations.example: The queen graciously granted the young envoy an audience the following morning. （读后续写·觐见）
Before designing the poster, we must first decide who our target audience really is. （应用文·活动策划）
Translating the novel into English allowed it to reach a far wider audience. （应用文·文化传播）

synonyms.translation: (尤指体育赛事的)观众，观看者
synonyms.example: Thousands of spectators leapt to their feet as the sprinter crossed the line. （读后续写·体育赛事）
synonyms.usage: 特指观看比赛/公开活动的人，强调'旁观'；audience 更常用于演出、演讲、影视，含'专注聆听/观看'之意

synonyms.example: Millions of viewers tuned in to watch the final episode. （议论文·媒体）
synonyms.usage: 特指通过屏幕观看(电视/网络)的观众；audience 涵盖现场与非现场，语义更广

synonyms.example: The radio host thanked his loyal listeners for their years of support. （应用文·广播）
synonyms.usage: 特指'用听'的受众(广播、音乐会等)；audience 视听皆可，用途更宽

synonyms.example: A restless crowd had gathered outside the stadium hours before the gates opened. （读后续写·聚集）
synonyms.usage: 泛指聚集的人群，可能杂乱无序；audience 更有组织、有共同的观看/聆听目的

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·集合名词主谓一致(audience + is/are)
advancedExpressions.expression: audience 作集合名词：视为整体→谓语单数(is/was)；着眼各成员→谓语复数(are/were)
advancedExpressions.example: The audience was/were clapping for 10 minutes. （课件原句）The audience was enormous.(整体) / The audience were divided in their opinions.(各成员各自看法)

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·各类受众(可替换，语义有别)
advancedExpressions.expression: audience / spectators / viewers / listeners / crowd
advancedExpressions.example: 演出用 audience，赛事用 spectators，电视网络用 viewers，广播音乐用 listeners，泛指人群用 crowd。 （据场景选词，见 synonyms 辨析）

advancedExpressions.expression: an audience with sb. = (与要人的)正式会见/觐见
advancedExpressions.example: He was granted an audience with the Pope. （固定搭配 an audience with / grant sb. an audience）

advancedExpressions.expression: a hush swept / fell over the audience
advancedExpressions.example: A hush swept over the audience, so complete that the flutter of a single programme sounded like thunder. （静默烘托 + 夸张对比，渲染演出/演讲前的紧张）

advancedExpressions.expression: I sincerely invite you to be part of the audience at ...
advancedExpressions.example: I sincerely invite you to be part of the audience at our annual charity gala, where your presence alone will bring warmth to those in need. （诚挚邀请句式，用于邀请函）

advancedExpressions.expression: a good ... never talks down to the audience, but ...
advancedExpressions.example: A good communicator never talks down to the audience, but meets them eye to eye, trusting their intelligence and honouring their time. （否定+转折，论述真诚沟通）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·集合名词主谓一致
advancedExpressions.expression: audience 作集合名词：视为整体→谓语单数；着眼成员→谓语复数
advancedExpressions.example: The audience was enormous. (整体，单数) / The audience were divided in their opinions. (各成员各自看法，复数)。 （集合名词一致规则）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The audience was quiet and then clapped loudly.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: For one endless heartbeat the audience sat in absolute silence, as though afraid to shatter the spell — and then, all at once, the hall exploded into applause that rolled over her like a warm and unstoppable wave. （读后续写·谢幕高潮）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: for one endless heartbeat 夸张计时 + as though 从句写心理 + 破折号+all at once 制造节奏突转 + 比喻(a warm and unstoppable wave)升华听觉体验

sentenceUpgrade.original: A good speaker respects the audience.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is precisely because a great speaker never underestimates the audience — treating every listener as a thinking, feeling equal — that his words are able to linger in the mind long after the applause has faded. （议论文·演讲之道）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is precisely because...that... 强调句 + 破折号插入现在分词短语(treating...) + 三个形容词并列(thinking, feeling equal) + 结尾意象(linger...after the applause has faded)余韵悠长

classPractice.type: 单句语法填空(集合名词一致)
classPractice.question: The audience ____ (be) clapping for ten minutes, for the members were all cheering wildly at once.
classPractice.note: 【课件原句】audience 作集合名词，着眼各成员(members...at once)时谓语用复数 were；若视为整体则用单数 was。

classPractice.question: When the film added English subtitles, it enabled Western ____ (audience) to enjoy the story and reached a far wider audience abroad.
classPractice.note: 指'不同国家/群体的观众'时 audience 可数变复数 audiences；呼应课文 Western audiences。

classPractice.question: The whole audience ____ (be) on its feet, clapping as one, the moment the curtain fell.
classPractice.note: audience 作集合名词，视为整体时谓语用单数 was，与 on its feet 的 its 一致。

classPractice.question: 选词填空(audience / spectators / viewers)：Thousands of ____ cheered at the stadium, millions of ____ watched on TV, and a quiet ____ listened to the poet in the small hall.
classPractice.note: 赛事现场用 spectators，电视机前用 viewers，听诗/演出用 audience，据场景选词。

translation: vi. 表演；工作，运转 | vt. 表演；做，履行
original_sentence: However, the film's director, Ang Lee, preferred to have actors perform on location.
readingExamples: However, the film's director, Ang Lee, preferred to have actors perform on location.
definitionEn:
(1) vt. & vi. to do or carry out a task, action, duty or piece of work, especially one that is difficult or requires skill
(2) vi. & vt. to entertain an audience by acting, singing, dancing or playing music
(3) vi. to work or function in a particular way, or to achieve a particular level of success (of a person, machine or system)

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 执行，做，履行(任务、职责、手术、动作等)
uncommonMeanings.example: The surgeon calmly performed the delicate operation. （perform a task/duty/operation，'执行/做'义，非'表演'）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (机器、系统、人)运转、运行、表现(达到某种水平)
uncommonMeanings.example: Against every expectation, the battered old engine performed flawlessly through the storm, carrying the fishermen home just as the last light drained from the sky. （读后续写·历险归途·机器拟人）

posExamples.sentence: Under the blinding stage lights, the once-timid boy performed with a confidence no one had ever seen in him, his voice soaring to the very back of the silent hall. （读后续写·首次登台·蜕变）
We are looking for volunteers who are willing to perform simple magic tricks and short plays for the children at the local hospital this weekend. （应用文·志愿者招募）
Students who are given the freedom to explore their interests often perform far better than those forced to memorise for exams, a truth too many schools still ignore. （议论文·教育方式）
The surgeon calmly performed the delicate operation that would decide whether the young mother ever walked again, his steady hands betraying nothing of the pressure within. （读后续写·手术·紧张时刻）

idioms.translation: 创造奇迹，产生神奇效果
idioms.example: A few words of genuine encouragement can perform wonders for a child who has all but given up on himself. （议论文·鼓励的力量）

collocations.example: Ang Lee preferred to have actors perform the role of the heroes on location. （课件搭配化用）

collocations.translation: 【课件】进行手术 / 演一场戏
collocations.example: The surgeon performed a delicate operation while the actors performed a play on the same evening. （课件搭配化用）
She was fired for not performing her duty. （课件·完成句子化用）
The children put on / gave a wonderful performance that began at eight o'clock. （课件搭配化用）
He was the best performer in the concert. （课件·完成句子化用）

collocations.translation: 在外景地表演(课文原句)
collocations.example: Ang Lee preferred to have actors perform on location. （课文原句化用）
The young nurse performed every duty with a tenderness that money could never buy. （读后续写·敬业）
The director insisted the actors perform on location to capture the wildness of the real mountains. （应用文·影视幕后）
She had prepared so thoroughly that she performed brilliantly under pressure. （读后续写·考验）
The team performed the experiment a hundred times before they dared to trust the result. （议论文·科学精神）

collocations.translation: 表演一出戏/一首歌/一支舞
collocations.example: The children performed a short play they had written entirely by themselves. （应用文·活动通讯）
Wetlands perform a vital function in filtering water and sheltering wildlife. （议论文·环保）
The new model outperformed every rival in the reliability tests. （议论文·科技）
What sets a champion apart is the ability to perform under pressure. （读后续写·比赛）

synonyms.example: The rescue team carried out the operation with remarkable precision. （读后续写·救援）
synonyms.usage: 指'具体执行、贯彻'计划/任务/命令，偏行动落实；perform 语域略高，且可表'表演/发挥水平'，语义更广

synonyms.example: He acted the part of the grieving father so convincingly that the audience wept. （读后续写·戏剧）
synonyms.usage: 特指戏剧影视中'表演/扮演角色'；perform 涵盖唱、跳、演奏等各类演出，也可表'完成任务/运转'

synonyms.translation: 进行，实施(尤指调查、实验)
synonyms.example: The scientists conducted a careful survey of the polluted river. （议论文·科研）
synonyms.usage: 多用于'进行'调查、实验、研究等系统性活动，正式；perform 侧重'执行动作/表演/运作表现'

synonyms.translation: 执行，完成(尤指技巧性动作)
synonyms.example: The gymnast executed the difficult routine without a single flaw. （读后续写·体育）
synonyms.usage: 强调'精准无误地完成'高难度或技巧性动作，正式；perform 更中性、通用

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·多义一览(表演/执行/表现)
advancedExpressions.expression: perform 三义：① 表演(perform the role of / a play / a song) ② 执行、做(perform a task / duty / an operation) ③ 表现、运转(perform well / under pressure)
advancedExpressions.example: The actor performed a play (表演), the surgeon performed an operation (执行), and both performed superbly under pressure (表现)。 （一词三义对照记，呼应课件搭配）

advancedExpressions.expression: perform → performance(n. 表演；表现) / performer(n. 表演者)；put on / give a performance 举行表演
advancedExpressions.example: The performer's dazzling performance won a standing ovation. （-ance 抽象名词，-er 施动者；课件搭配 put on/give a performance）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·执行/做(可替换，语域有别)
advancedExpressions.expression: perform / carry out / conduct / execute a task
advancedExpressions.example: They performed (carried out / conducted / executed) the task with great care. （四词均可'执行任务'，正式度与侧重不同，见 synonyms）

advancedExpressions.expression: sb. performed with a confidence / grace no one had ever seen ...
advancedExpressions.example: That night she performed with a grace no one in the little town had ever imagined she possessed, and even her sternest critic rose slowly to his feet. （对比过去+旁人反应，凸显人物成长）

advancedExpressions.expression: we are looking for volunteers willing to perform ... for ...
advancedExpressions.example: We are looking for enthusiastic volunteers willing to perform songs and short plays for the elderly at the community centre. （招募句式，明确任务与对象）

advancedExpressions.expression: students / people perform better when ..., which suggests that ...
advancedExpressions.example: People tend to perform far better when they feel trusted rather than watched, which strongly suggests that respect, not surveillance, is the true engine of excellence. （perform 引出因果 + which 非限定小结句）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·多义一览(表演/执行/表现)
advancedExpressions.expression: perform 三义：① 表演(a play/song) ② 执行、做(a task/duty/operation) ③ 表现、运转(perform well/under pressure)
advancedExpressions.example: The actor performed a play (表演), the surgeon performed an operation (执行), and both performed superbly under pressure (表现)。 （一词三义对照记）

advancedExpressions.expression: perform → performance(n. 表演；表现) / performer(n. 表演者)
advancedExpressions.example: The performer's dazzling performance won a standing ovation. （-ance 抽象名词，-er 施动者）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He was nervous but he performed well on stage.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: His heart hammered against his ribs and his palms were slick with sweat, yet the moment the music began, all his fear dissolved, and he performed with such fire that the audience forgot to breathe. （读后续写·登台·心理转折）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 身体细节写紧张(heart hammered / palms slick with sweat) + yet 转折 + the moment 引导时间从句 + such...that 结果句 + 夸张收尾(forgot to breathe)

sentenceUpgrade.original: Students do better when they are interested in learning.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is a truth borne out by countless studies that students perform far more impressively when driven by genuine curiosity than when spurred merely by the fear of failure — a finding that ought to reshape the way we teach. （议论文·学习动机）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is a truth borne out by... 正式引入 + perform...more impressively 主干 + when...than when 对比状语 + 破折号引出结论(a finding that ought to...)呼吁改变

classPractice.question: She was fired for not ____ (perform) her duty.
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】for 是介词，其后动词用动名词；perform one's duty 履行职责。

classPractice.question: The evening ____ (perform) begins at eight o'clock.
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】空前有 the、作主语，需名词 performance(表演)；谓语 begins 主谓一致。

classPractice.question: He is the best ____ (perform) in the concert.
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】the best + 名词，指人'表演者'用 performer(-er 施动者)。

classPractice.question: ____ (perform) the operation successfully, the doctors once again had a meeting.
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】句首作目的状语，用动词不定式 To perform；perform an operation 进行手术。

classPractice.question: The word perform has several meanings. Match: The children ____ a short play; the doctor ____ a difficult operation; the new engine ____ flawlessly. （三空均用 perform 的适当形式，一般现在时）
classPractice.note: 同一动词三义：表演 / 执行(做手术) / 运转表现；注意主谓一致(the doctor/the engine 用 performs)。

classPractice.question: Ang Lee preferred to have the actors perform on ____ (locate), so as to capture the real mountains and deserts.
classPractice.note: on location'在外景地'固定短语；locate 派生名词 location。呼应课文。

classPractice.question: The young pianist's ____ (perform) moved the whole audience, proving that a true ____ (perform) is born, not made.
classPractice.note: -ance 名词表'表演/表现'；-er 名词表'表演者'。同根派生辨形。

original_sentence: However, the film's director, Ang Lee, preferred to have actors perform on location.
readingExamples: However, the film's director, Ang Lee, preferred to have actors perform on location.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a particular place or position
(2) n. the fact of where someone or something is
(3) n. a place away from a studio where scenes for a film or television programme are recorded
(4) n. the act of finding the exact position of someone or something

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (电影)外景拍摄地;实景拍摄现场(常用 on location)
uncommonMeanings.example: For weeks the crew braved sandstorms on location in the Gobi, chasing the one flawless sunset the director insisted the story deserved. （读后续写·追梦/坚持）

posExamples.sentence: The old fisherman guided us to a secret location where the river bent sharply, and there, half-hidden by reeds, lay the wreck we had searched for all summer. （读后续写·探险/发现）
I am writing to inform you that the location of our English Corner has been moved to the library's reading room, which offers a quieter and more comfortable environment. （应用文·通知）
A shop's success depends far less on lavish decoration than on its location, for even the finest goods go unnoticed if customers cannot easily reach them. （议论文·商业/因果论证）
By tracking her phone signal, rescuers finally pinpointed the hiker's exact location and reached her before nightfall. （读后续写·救援）

collocations.translation: 在外景地(拍摄)(课文原句)
collocations.example: Ang Lee preferred to have actors perform on location. （课文原句化用）
The map clearly marks the location of every emergency exit. （应用文·通知/说明）
Nestled between two hills, the campsite proved an ideal location for stargazing. （读后续写·露营/自然）
Thanks to its central location, the museum draws thousands of visitors. （应用文·景点介绍）
Volunteering in such a remote location taught me that happiness owes nothing to material comfort. （应用文·支教感悟）
Keep your valuables in a safe location during the trip. （应用文·安全提示）
Before choosing a location for the charity fair, the committee weighed foot traffic, cost and accessibility. （应用文·活动策划）
Months of painstaking location scouting finally led the team to an untouched valley. （读后续写·电影幕后）

synonyms.example: The ancient temple stood on the very site where, legend said, a dragon had once descended from the clouds. （读后续写·传说/古迹）
synonyms.usage: 侧重具体一块地/发生某事的场所,常与建筑、事件、考古有关;location 更泛指'所处位置'

synonyms.translation: 地点(口语化,常指小而具体的地方)
synonyms.example: We found the perfect spot for a picnic beneath an old oak, its branches spreading like a green umbrella above us. （读后续写·郊游）
synonyms.usage: 口语、随意,多指小范围的'点';location 更中性正式

synonyms.example: From his elevated position on the cliff, he could see the whole valley bathed in golden light. （读后续写·登高远眺）
synonyms.usage: 强调相对方位或所处状态,也含'处境、职位'义;location 强调地理上的'哪儿'

advancedExpressions.expression: on location = (电影)在外景地/实景拍摄(区别于 in a studio 在摄影棚)
advancedExpressions.example: The film was shot on location in the Gobi Desert rather than in a studio. （课文关键短语：on location 无冠词，固定用法）

advancedExpressions.expression: location(n.) ← locate(v. 定位/位于) → be located in/at(位于) / local(adj. 当地的) / locally(adv.)
advancedExpressions.example: The factory is located in a remote area, and it hires mostly local workers. （be located in = 位于；local 当地的）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·地点(可替换，语域有别)
advancedExpressions.expression: location / site / spot / position
advancedExpressions.example: an ideal location = a perfect site = a lovely spot = a good position。 （四词均可指'地点'，正式度与侧重不同，见 synonyms）

advancedExpressions.expression: nestled in a location where ...
advancedExpressions.example: The cabin was nestled in a location where the forest seemed to hold its breath, and it was there that she finally learned to be still. （过去分词短语作后置定语,营造画面 + 环境映照心理）

advancedExpressions.expression: the event will be held at the following location: ...
advancedExpressions.example: The charity concert will be held at the following location: the school auditorium on Central Avenue, easily reachable by Bus No. 5. （通知文体,信息清晰 + 补充交通细节）

advancedExpressions.expression: the location of ... plays a decisive role in ...
advancedExpressions.example: The location of a city plays a decisive role in its prosperity, for rivers and ports have long served as the arteries of trade and culture. （主语抽象化 + for 引导原因论证）

sentenceUpgrade.original: We found a good place to camp.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: After hours of trudging through the underbrush, we stumbled upon a location so serene that even our exhausted footsteps seemed to fall silent in reverence. （读后续写·环境描写+情感）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 时间状语铺垫(After hours of...) + stumble upon 替换 find + so...that 结果状语 + 拟人(footsteps fall silent in reverence)

sentenceUpgrade.original: The library is in a good location.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Owing to its central and readily accessible location, the library has become the beating heart of campus life, a place where curiosity and community quietly converge. （应用文/议论文·正式）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Owing to 引导原因短语 + 隐喻(beating heart) + 定语从句(where...) + 头韵与抽象名词并列(curiosity and community)

classPractice.question: Instead of using a studio backdrop, the director insisted on shooting every scene on ____, determined to capture the real mountains. （填一词，构成'在外景地'）
classPractice.note: on location'在外景地拍摄'，固定短语无冠词；呼应课文 perform on location。

classPractice.question: The new library is ____ (locate) in a central location, so it is easy for local residents to reach.
classPractice.note: be located in'位于'，location 的动词 locate 用过去分词构成被动状态。同根词辨形。

classPractice.question: 由于地处中心、交通便利，这家博物馆吸引了成千上万的游客。（翻译，用 central location）
classPractice.answer: Thanks to / Owing to its central and convenient location, the museum attracts / draws thousands of visitors.
classPractice.note: a central/convenient location 固定搭配；Thanks to/Owing to 引导原因。

original_sentence: In addition to the amazing martial arts, the film also took advantage of China's beautiful mountains, forests and deserts.
readingExamples: In addition to the amazing martial arts, the film also took advantage of China's beautiful mountains, forests and deserts.
definitionEn:
(1) prep. phrase used to introduce another person, thing, or fact besides the one already mentioned; as well as; besides
(2) prep. phrase in a way that adds to something

posExamples.sentence: In addition to teaching us maths, Mr. Wang stayed behind every evening to coach the school football team, asking nothing in return. （读后续写·师恩/奉献）
In addition to a generous cash prize, the winners of the essay contest will each receive a certificate signed by the headmaster. （应用文·竞赛通知）
In addition to boosting academic performance, regular exercise sharpens concentration and lifts the spirit, benefits no student can afford to ignore. （议论文·观点论证）
In addition to the breathtaking scenery, the ancient town charmed us with its warm-hearted locals and the aroma of freshly steamed buns drifting through narrow lanes. （读后续写·旅行）

collocations.phrase: in addition to + n. / doing (to 是介词 = besides)
collocations.translation: 【课件】除……之外(还有)；to 为介词，相当于 besides，后接名词/动名词
collocations.example: In addition to (= Besides) his flat in London, he has a villa in Italy and a castle in Scotland. （课件原句）

collocations.phrase: in addition (副词，此外，单独作状语)
collocations.translation: 【课件】此外，另外；相当于副词 besides，其后不可接宾语
collocations.example: The hot weather affected many areas. In addition (= Besides), crops failed in many provinces. （课件原句）

collocations.phrase: in addition to the amazing martial arts
collocations.translation: 除了精彩的武术之外(课文原句)
collocations.example: In addition to the amazing martial arts, the film also took advantage of China's beautiful mountains, forests and deserts. （课文原句）

collocations.translation: 除某物以外(还)(后接名词)
collocations.example: In addition to English, she has mastered French and Japanese. （应用文·个人陈述）

collocations.translation: 除了做某事以外(还)(后接动名词)
collocations.example: In addition to raising funds, the volunteers spent weekends repainting the old people's home. （应用文·志愿活动）

collocations.translation: 此外,另外(对比：in addition to 是介词短语，后须接宾语)
collocations.example: The plan is costly; in addition, it demands far more time than we can spare. （议论文·补充论点）

synonyms.example: Besides its rich history, the city boasts some of the finest cuisine in the region. （应用文·城市介绍）
synonyms.usage: 既可作介词(=in addition to)也可作副词(此外),口语中更常见;in addition to 更书面、正式，后接名词/动名词。

synonyms.example: Apart from being a gifted painter, he was also a devoted teacher who inspired a generation of artists. （读后续写·人物介绍）
synonyms.usage: 既表'包括在内的另外',也可表'除...之外都不'(排除),需看语境;in addition to 只表'累加'。

synonyms.example: The campaign aims to protect wildlife as well as to raise public awareness of ecological balance. （议论文·并列目的）
synonyms.usage: 并列连词,连接对等成分,强调'两者都';in addition to 后多接名词/动名词作附加信息，且常置于句首。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·in addition to(介词短语) vs in addition(副词)
advancedExpressions.expression: in addition to + n./doing(介词短语，to 是介词=besides，须带宾语) ≠ in addition(副词，单独使用，其后加逗号，不接宾语)
advancedExpressions.example: In addition to (=Besides) the martial arts, the scenery amazed us. (介词短语) / The martial arts amazed us; in addition (=besides), the scenery was stunning. (副词)。 （课件核心辨析；to 后不能接完整句子）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·in addition to + 动名词
advancedExpressions.expression: in addition to 是介词短语，后接动词须用 -ing 形式
advancedExpressions.example: In addition to teaching maths, he coached the football team. (不能说 in addition to teach)。 （to 是介词而非不定式符号，故接动名词）

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·'除…之外还'表达(可替换)
advancedExpressions.expression: in addition to / besides / apart from / as well as / on top of
advancedExpressions.example: In addition to (Besides / Apart from) his talent, his humility impressed everyone. （功能相同，词性与语域略异，见 synonyms 辨析）

advancedExpressions.expression: in addition to ..., what struck me most was ...
advancedExpressions.example: In addition to his remarkable talent, what struck me most was the quiet humility with which he accepted both praise and criticism. （附加信息 + what 引导主语从句突出焦点）

advancedExpressions.expression: in addition to ..., I would also suggest that ...
advancedExpressions.example: In addition to extending the library's opening hours, I would also suggest that a quiet study zone be set aside for exam candidates. （递进建议 + suggest that + (should) do 虚拟语气）

advancedExpressions.expression: in addition to ..., it also ...
advancedExpressions.example: In addition to strengthening the body, sport also forges the resilient character that classrooms alone can seldom cultivate. （物质与精神双重益处 + also 递进 + 对比 classrooms alone）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·in addition to vs in addition
advancedExpressions.expression: in addition to + n./doing(介词短语，须带宾语) ≠ in addition(副词，单独使用，其后加逗号)
advancedExpressions.example: In addition to the martial arts, the scenery amazed us. (介词短语) / The martial arts amazed us; in addition, the scenery was stunning. (副词)。 （易错点：to 后不能接完整句子）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The trip was fun. We also learned a lot.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: In addition to the sheer delight it brought, the trip quietly enriched us, teaching lessons no textbook could ever hope to convey. （读后续写·旅行感悟）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: in addition to 合并两句 + 现在分词状语(teaching...) + 比较从句(no textbook could...) 拔高立意

sentenceUpgrade.original: The programme saves money. It also protects the environment.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: In addition to cutting costs significantly, the programme protects the environment, thereby serving both economic prudence and ecological responsibility. （议论文·双重效益）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: in addition to + 动名词并列 + thereby 引导结果 + 抽象名词对举(economic prudence / ecological responsibility)

classPractice.type: 辨析填空(in addition / in addition to)
classPractice.question: ____ some picture books, we still need some storybooks.
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】后接名词宾语 some picture books，须用介词短语 in addition to。

classPractice.type: 辨析填空(in addition / in addition to)
classPractice.question: My grandma gave us sandwiches for our picnic and a bag of cookies ____.
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】句末单独作状语、其后不接宾语，用副词 in addition(此外)。

classPractice.type: 辨析填空(in addition / in addition to)
classPractice.question: It's too late to invite any more people. ____, you know how my mother hates parties.
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】引出补充理由、其后为完整句子，用副词 in addition，后加逗号。

classPractice.type: 辨析填空(in addition / in addition to)
classPractice.question: He speaks French ____ English.
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】后接名词 English 作宾语，须用介词短语 in addition to(= besides)。

classPractice.question: In addition to ____ (teach) us maths, Mr Wang stayed behind every evening to coach the football team.
classPractice.note: in addition to 中 to 是介词，后接动词须用动名词 -ing 形式。高频易错点。

classPractice.question: 选词填空(in addition / in addition to)：____ the amazing martial arts, the film also used stunning scenery; ____, its music was unforgettable.
classPractice.note: in addition to 是介词短语后须带宾语；in addition 是副词单独作插入语。呼应课文。

classPractice.question: Besides raising funds, the volunteers also repainted the home. → ____ ____ ____ raising funds, the volunteers also repainted the home. （用同义短语替换 Besides）
classPractice.note: besides(介词) = in addition to = apart from，后接动名词 raising，表'除…之外还'。

original_sentence: In addition to the amazing martial arts, the film also took advantage of China's beautiful mountains, forests and deserts.
readingExamples: In addition to the amazing martial arts, the film also took advantage of China's beautiful mountains, forests and deserts.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. relating to war, soldiers, or fighting
(2) adj. connected with the armed forces or military life
(3) adj. characterized by a warlike, disciplined, or combative spirit

posExamples.sentence: As the drums thundered, a martial spirit swept through the ranks, and the once-timid recruits lifted their heads and marched as one. （读后续写·军训/热血）
Our school will host a martial arts demonstration next Friday, and all students are warmly invited to witness the elegance and discipline of traditional Chinese kung fu. （应用文·活动通知）
Far from glorifying violence, true martial training instils in its practitioners patience, humility and respect — virtues that outlast any physical strength. （议论文·观点论证）

idioms.example: When martial law was declared, an eerie silence fell over the streets that had, only hours before, echoed with the laughter of children. （读后续写·历史/动荡·对比反衬）

collocations.example: In addition to the amazing martial arts, the film also took advantage of China's beautiful mountains, forests and deserts. （课文原句）
The government imposed martial law to restore order after weeks of unrest. （议论文/新闻·社会）
The coach's fiery speech rekindled a martial spirit in the team. （读后续写·比赛）
Stirring martial music blared from the loudspeakers as the flag rose. （读后续写·升旗/庄严）
Weeks of rigorous martial training transformed the pampered teenager into a disciplined young man. （读后续写·成长）

collocations.translation: 军人般的仪态;威武的气度
collocations.example: Despite his advanced age, the veteran retained a martial bearing that commanded instant respect. （读后续写·人物刻画）

synonyms.example: The museum displays military uniforms and weapons dating back over a century. （应用文·展览介绍）

advancedExpressions.expression: a martial spirit swept / surged through ...

advancedExpressions.expression: far from ..., martial training in fact ...

original_sentence: In addition to the amazing martial arts, the film also took advantage of China's beautiful mountains, forests and deserts.
readingExamples: In addition to the amazing martial arts, the film also took advantage of China's beautiful mountains, forests and deserts.
definitionEn:
(1) n. any of various traditional forms of self-defence or combat that developed especially in East Asia, such as kung fu, judo, or taekwondo (usually plural: martial arts)
(2) n. a sport or skill practised for physical fitness, self-discipline, and spiritual cultivation as well as fighting

posExamples.sentence: From the moment she watched the old master glide across the courtyard, the girl knew that martial art would become the compass of her entire life. （读后续写·立志/拜师）
To promote traditional culture, our school is launching a martial art club this term, and beginners of every level are warmly welcome to join. （应用文·社团招募）
A martial art is far more than a means of self-defence; it is a moral education in which restraint, respect and perseverance are forged blow by patient blow. （议论文·观点论证）

collocations.translation: 精彩的武术(课文原句，常用复数 martial arts)
collocations.example: In addition to the amazing martial arts, the film also took advantage of China's beautiful mountains, forests and deserts. （课文原句）
Every dawn the boy slipped out to the riverbank to practise martial arts. （读后续写·坚持/自律）
I have been learning martial arts for three years, and the discipline has reshaped how I face challenges. （应用文·个人陈述）
To master a martial art, one must first master oneself. （议论文·哲理）
Traditional Chinese martial arts, with their blend of strength and grace, have won admirers across the globe. （应用文·文化介绍）
The martial arts master bowed deeply before every match. （读后续写·师父）
Ang Lee's martial arts films dazzled audiences worldwide. （应用文·影评）

synonyms.example: The child's clumsy attempts at kung fu drew laughter at first, but his stubborn persistence soon silenced every doubter. （读后续写·励志）

synonyms.example: The workshop teaches basic self-defence so that students can protect themselves in an emergency. （应用文·活动通知）
synonyms.usage: 侧重'防身'的实用目的与技巧;martial art 是完整的技艺与精神体系,防身只是其一面

advancedExpressions.expression: martial art(一门武术，可数单数) → martial arts(武术总称，习惯用复数)

advancedExpressions.expression: practise / learn / study / master + (a) martial art(s)
advancedExpressions.example: He learned martial arts as a boy and later mastered a martial art of his own creation. （常见动词搭配）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·武术/搏击(可替换，含义有别)

advancedExpressions.example: kung fu 特指中国功夫，combat sport 重竞技，self-defence 重防身，martial arts 为统称，见 synonyms 辨析。

advancedExpressions.expression: it was through martial arts that sb. came to understand ...

advancedExpressions.expression: whether you are a beginner or ..., our martial arts club welcomes ...
advancedExpressions.example: Whether you are a curious beginner or a seasoned enthusiast, our martial arts club welcomes you with open arms and open mats. （whether...or... 让步 + 排比 open arms and open mats 增强号召）

advancedExpressions.expression: martial arts embody not only ... but also ...
advancedExpressions.example: Martial arts embody not only centuries of physical wisdom but also a moral code that binds discipline to compassion. （not only...but also 递进 + 抽象名词对举 discipline / compassion 提升立意）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He practised martial arts every day and got better.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Day after day, dawn found him already in the courtyard, and blow by patient blow his martial art ripened from clumsy imitation into effortless grace. （读后续写·成长蒙太奇）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 拟人化时间(dawn found him) + 重复节奏(blow by patient blow) + from...into 转变结构 + 对比 clumsy imitation / effortless grace

sentenceUpgrade.original: Martial arts are good for young people.

original_sentence: In addition to the amazing martial arts, the film also took advantage of China's beautiful mountains, forests and deserts.
readingExamples: In addition to the amazing martial arts, the film also took advantage of China's beautiful mountains, forests and deserts.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a large area of land that is very dry and has few plants, often covered with sand
(2) v. to leave someone or something and no longer help or support them; to abandon
(3) v. to leave a place, causing it to appear empty
(4) v. to leave the armed forces without permission

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 抛弃,遗弃;背弃(读音变为 /dɪˈzɜːt/,重音在后)
uncommonMeanings.example: When the storm struck, the other climbers deserted him without a backward glance — and it was in that freezing silence that he learned who he truly was. （读后续写·困境/人性·被弃后成长）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (士兵)擅离职守,开小差;逃跑(读音 /dɪˈzɜːt/)
uncommonMeanings.example: Terrified by the roar of cannon fire, several young soldiers deserted under cover of darkness, only to be haunted for the rest of their lives by that single act of cowardice. （读后续写·战争/悔恨）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (能力、勇气等)突然丧失,离某人而去
uncommonMeanings.example: As she stepped onto the vast stage, her carefully rehearsed words suddenly deserted her, and for one terrible moment her mind was a blank white sheet. （读后续写·怯场/心理）

posExamples.sentence: By noon the desert shimmered like a sea of molten gold, and not a single sound broke the vast, breathing silence that stretched to the horizon. （读后续写·自然/探险）
I would never forgive myself if I deserted a friend in need, so I stayed by his hospital bed until the first light crept through the curtains. （读后续写·友情/忠诚）
Our geography club is organising a field trip to study how desert plants survive with almost no water, and we sincerely hope you will join us. （应用文·活动通知）

idioms.translation: 得到应有的(惩)报;罪有应得(此处 deserts 读 /dɪˈzɜːts/,意为'应得的赏罚')

A true friend will never desert you in need, however dark the hour may be. （读后续写/议论文·友情）
The lighthouse keeper never once deserted his post, though the storms raged for seven relentless nights. （读后续写·坚守）
She walked down the deserted street, her footsteps echoing against shuttered windows like a lonely heartbeat. （读后续写·孤独/氛围）

synonyms.example: He could not bring himself to abandon the injured stray, so he wrapped it in his own coat and carried it home. （读后续写·善良）

synonyms.example: She vowed never to forsake the dream that had carried her through the darkest years. （读后续写·坚守理想）

synonyms.translation: 荒地,不毛之地(对应名词沙漠义)

synonyms.usage: 泛指任何荒芜、无生机的土地;desert 特指干旱少雨的沙漠地貌

advancedExpressions.expression: a deserted + 名词 / feel deserted

advancedExpressions.expression: deserted by ..., sb. found ...

advancedExpressions.expression: let us never desert ...

advancedExpressions.expression: to desert ... is to betray ...

definitionEn:
(1) n. a tropical forest with thick vegetation and many trees, plants, and wild animals
(2) n. a confusing or complicated situation in which it is difficult to succeed or survive; a place of intense, ruthless competition
(3) n. a large amount of things arranged in a confused, tangled way

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 所有权，产权(法律)

posExamples.sentence: She turned the dusty book over in her trembling hands, and the moment her eyes fell on the faded title, a wave of childhood memories came flooding back, vivid as the summer they were made. （读后续写·睹物思人·回忆闪回）

I am writing to recommend a truly inspiring novel for our school reading list; though its title may seem plain, the story it holds within is nothing short of life-changing for young readers. （应用文·推荐信·图书推荐）
A book should never be judged by its title alone, for a modest, unassuming heading can conceal ideas that reshape the way an entire generation understands the world. （议论文·阅读与判断·由表及里）

Winning the title of 'Student of the Year' meant far more to him than the trophy itself; it was public proof that quiet persistence, invisible to others for so long, had finally paid off. （读后续写·荣誉时刻·内心独白）

collocations.phrase: a title match / a title defence
collocations.example: In the title match, the champion fought off point after point until, exhausted but unbeaten, she raised the trophy once more. （读后续写·体育卫冕）
The film, based on a bestselling novel of the same title, drew crowds to cinemas across the country within days of its release. （议论文·文化产业·改编现象）

collocations.phrase: the title of the book / film / song
collocations.translation: 书名 / 片名 / 歌名
collocations.example: I racked my brains for the title of the song that had been drifting through my head all morning, but it stubbornly stayed just out of reach. （读后续写·日常心理·懊恼）

collocations.translation: 保持 / 赢得 / 卫冕冠军
collocations.example: Against all expectations, the underdog team went on to win the title, silencing every critic who had written them off before the season even began. （读后续写·逆袭夺冠·反转）
The professor published his lecture notes under the title 'Thinking in an Age of Noise', a heading that perfectly captured the book's quiet urgency. （应用文·书评·出版介绍）

Do not let a fancy job title mislead you; what truly measures a person's worth is the responsibility they shoulder, not the label on their business card. （议论文·价值判断·名实之辩）
The village elder was granted an honorary title in recognition of the decades he had spent teaching local children to read beneath a single flickering lamp. （读后续写·乡村教育·致敬）
She gave her painting a simple title, 'Morning', yet those golden strokes captured a warmth that no elaborate name could ever have conveyed. （读后续写·艺术创作·以简驭繁）

synonyms.example: The name of the shop had faded from the sign, but everyone in the neighbourhood still remembered it as the little bakery where kindness came free with every loaf. （读后续写·社区温情）

synonyms.example: Each section of the report opened with a bold heading, guiding readers through the argument as clearly as signposts along a mountain trail. （应用文·报告写作）

synonyms.example: The photograph would have meant little without its caption, three quiet words that revealed the soldier in it had never come home. （读后续写·历史照片·留白）

advancedExpressions.expression: the title alone was enough to ...

advancedExpressions.expression: a book that lives up to / far surpasses its title
advancedExpressions.example: It is a book that not only lives up to its promising title but far surpasses it, leaving every reader richer than before. （用 live up to / surpass 递进强调推荐力度）

advancedExpressions.expression: a title / label tells us little about ...; what truly matters is ...
advancedExpressions.example: A grand title tells us little about a person's real character; what truly matters is how they treat those who can offer them nothing in return. （对比句式，论证名实之辨）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She saw the title and remembered her childhood.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The instant her fingertips brushed the faded title on the spine, the years peeled away like old paint, and she was a barefoot child again, curled by the window as her mother's voice rose and fell with the story. （读后续写·回忆闪回+比喻）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: The instant... 时间状语从句瞬时感 + peeled away like old paint 比喻 + 具象化回忆画面(barefoot child, rose and fell) + 感官细节触发记忆

translation: vt. 改编，改写；使适应 | vi. 适应
original_sentence: In 1967, Disney adapted the book into a cartoon film, which is widely regarded as a classic.
readingExamples: In 1967, Disney adapted the book into a cartoon film, which is widely regarded as a classic.
definitionEn:
(1) vt. to change a book, play, or film so that it can be made into a film, television programme, or stage production
(2) vi./vt. to change your behaviour or ideas to suit a new situation, or to make something suitable for a new use
(3) vt. to modify something so that it works better or fits a particular purpose or condition

posExamples.sentence: The young director set out to adapt the ancient legend for a modern stage, weaving glowing screens and haunting silence into a tale his grandmother had once whispered by candlelight. （读后续写·文化传承·古今交融）

Having just moved to a foreign city, I found it hard at first to adapt to the biting cold and the rapid speech around me, yet each passing week made the strange streets feel a little more like home. （读后续写·异乡成长·适应过程）

I would suggest that we adapt the original schedule to accommodate students with part-time jobs, so that no one is forced to choose between earning a living and joining our volunteer programme. （应用文·建议信·方案调整）

Those who thrive in an age of constant change are seldom the strongest or the cleverest, but rather those who can adapt swiftly, shedding old habits the moment the world demands something new. （议论文·适应与生存·达尔文式论证）

wordForms.noun: adaptation (改编；适应); adaptability (适应能力); adapter/adaptor (n. 适配器)

collocations.example: The couple adopted a child, adapted their home for her, and soon grew adept at bedtime stories. （一句连用·三词辨析记忆）
Disney adapted the beloved folk tale into an animated film, and the timeless story reached millions of children who might otherwise never have heard it. （议论文·文化传播·改编价值）
The ability to adapt to change is no longer a luxury but a necessity in a world that reinvents itself almost overnight. （议论文·终身学习·必要性）
She forced herself to adapt herself to the new school, swallowing her homesickness and offering a shy smile to the girl in the next seat. （读后续写·转学·主动融入）
The award-winning play was adapted from a little-known diary, proof that the most ordinary lives can hold the most extraordinary stories. （议论文·平凡与伟大·素材来源）

collocations.translation: 迅速地 / 欣然地适应
collocations.example: Children readily adapt to new languages, absorbing sounds and rhythms with an ease that leaves their struggling parents both amazed and a little envious. （议论文·语言习得·年龄优势）

collocations.translation: 调整食谱 / 方法 / 计划
collocations.example: The chef cleverly adapted the traditional recipe for guests who could not eat wheat, and not a single diner suspected a thing. （读后续写·餐厅细节·体贴入微）
Over countless generations, these desert plants have adapted to the harsh environment, storing every precious drop of rain deep within their swollen stems. （议论文·自然科学·进化适应）
It took the newcomers several weeks to adapt to the rhythm of village life, where the loudest sound at dusk was the distant lowing of returning cattle. （读后续写·田园生活·适应）

synonyms.example: Whenever the lighting changed, she quietly adjusted the camera settings, chasing that perfect golden glow before it slipped away. （读后续写·摄影细节）
synonyms.usage: 指为达到更好效果而做出细微、通常是技术性的调整；adapt 强调为适应全新或长期变化的环境而做出较根本的改变，程度更深

synonyms.example: Engineers modified the design after the trial run, replacing the fragile parts with materials that could survive the desert heat. （议论文·工程改进）
synonyms.usage: 指对已有事物做局部改动使其更合适，语气中性偏正式；adapt 更强调'为适配新用途/新环境'，常含主动求变之意

synonyms.example: It took him a whole month to get used to the deafening silence of the countryside after years of city noise. （读后续写·环境反差）
synonyms.usage: get used to 口语化，强调逐渐习惯的过程与结果；adapt to 更正式，且暗含'主动改变自己以契合环境'的能动性

synonyms.example: The couple converted the old barn into a cosy bookshop, and the smell of hay somehow lingered pleasantly among the shelves. （读后续写·空间改造）
synonyms.usage: 指把某物彻底改造成用途不同的另一事物；adapt 通常保留原物本体，只做适配性调整，改变没那么彻底

advancedExpressions.expression: I would suggest that we adapt ... so as to ...

advancedExpressions.expression: it is not ... but the ability to adapt that ...
