sentenceUpgrade.original: She found it hard to adapt to the new school.

original_sentence: In 1967, Disney adapted the book into a cartoon film, which is widely regarded as a classic.

definitionEn:
(1) vt. to think about someone or something in a particular way, or to consider them in a certain manner
(2) vt. to look at someone or something steadily, especially in a specified way
(3) n. respect or admiration for someone or something
(4) n. (plural: regards) good wishes, used especially at the end of a letter

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 注视，凝视(正式)
uncommonMeanings.example: The old sailor regarded the approaching storm in silence, his weathered face betraying neither fear nor surprise, only the calm of a man who had made his peace with the sea long ago. （读后续写·人物刻画·沉静气质）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 问候，致意(常用复数 regards)
uncommonMeanings.example: She folded the letter carefully and added, almost as an afterthought, 'Give my warmest regards to your grandmother' — words that would reach a woman who had once been a second mother to her. （读后续写·书信温情·牵挂）

posExamples.sentence: Though the whole village regarded him as a hopeless dreamer, the boy kept sketching his flying machines by candlelight, utterly convinced that one day the sky would prove them all wrong. （读后续写·追梦少年·世俗偏见）

original_sentence: Light and shadows were thrown onto Mowgli with the aid of a system they developed, showing that animals were moving near him.

As chairman of the Green Club, I firmly believe that planting trees is not a cure-all for pollution, but it is a hopeful first step every one of us can take today. （应用文·环保倡议）
They say time cures all sorrows, yet as she stood by the window watching the rain, she wondered how many springs it would take to cure a wound as deep as hers. （读后续写·失去·心理独白）
Simply banning mobile phones will not cure students' addiction to screens; only by offering richer, real-world experiences can we draw them back to life beyond the glass. （议论文·青少年与科技）

wordForms.other: cure-all (n. 万灵药)

idioms.example: When it comes to health, prevention is better than cure; a daily walk today may spare us a hospital bed tomorrow. （议论文/应用文·健康主题）

idioms.translation: 万灵药，包治百病的办法（常含反讽）
idioms.example: Technology is no cure-all: a smart classroom means little if the teacher's warmth and patience are lost along the way. （议论文·科技与教育）

collocations.phrase: a cure for cancer / for the cold
collocations.translation: 【课件】（癌症/感冒等）的疗法、治愈方法（cure n. + for）
collocations.example: the search for a cure for cancer 对癌症治愈方法的研究。（课件·Integrated skills 原句词块）
There is no known cure but the illness can be treated. 这种病尚没有确切的治愈方法，但可以医治。（课件·Integrated skills 原句）

collocations.phrase: cure sb of + 疾病/坏习惯
collocations.translation: 【课件】治好某人的（病/坏习惯）（cure v.，中间用 of）
collocations.example: The doctor cured her of a rare blood disease. 医生治好了她罕见的血液病。（课件·Integrated skills 翻译原句）

collocations.phrase: provide / fail to provide a cure for sth
collocations.example: Scientists have so far failed to provide a cure for the cold. 科学家目前还没有找到治疗这种感冒的方法。（课件·Integrated skills 翻译原句）

collocations.phrase: give up hope of a cure
collocations.translation: 放弃治愈的希望（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: The Prince has given up hope of a cure but his wife takes him to see a speech doctor. （课文原句·必修二U1影评）
So far there is no cure for the common cold. 至今普通感冒仍无根治之法。
The medicine cured him of his headache. 这药治好了他的头痛。
For thirty years the researcher chased the dream of finding a cure for the disease that had taken her mother, refusing to let a single failure break her resolve. （读后续写·科研·执着）

collocations.phrase: give up hope of a cure
collocations.example: The family had all but given up hope of a cure when a young intern quietly suggested one last, unconventional treatment. （读后续写·绝境转机）
That single embarrassing fall cured him of his reckless showing-off far more effectively than any warning ever had. （读后续写·成长教训）
Although there is as yet no known cure for the illness, the warmth of family and friends can do what medicine cannot. （读后续写·温情·陪伴）
Volunteers should not promise the villagers a miracle cure, but honestly explain what the new clinic can and cannot do. （应用文·公益说明）
Laughter, they say, is the cheapest cure for a heavy heart, and on that gloomy afternoon her friend's silly jokes proved the saying true. （读后续写·友情·治愈）
He travelled halfway across the country to seek a cure, carrying in his pocket a faded photograph of the daughter he was fighting to see grow up. （读后续写·父爱·奔波）
Modern medicine can now cure many diseases that once emptied whole villages, a triumph we too easily take for granted. （议论文·科技进步）

synonyms.translation: 治愈，愈合（尤指伤口/创伤，可指身心）
synonyms.example: Slowly, gently, the quiet days by the sea began to heal a heart that had believed itself beyond mending. （读后续写·疗伤·景物+心理）
synonyms.usage: heal 多指伤口愈合或心灵创伤的自然恢复，过程感强；cure 侧重彻底根除疾病，更强调结果。

synonyms.example: The nurses treated his burns with the greatest care, though they warned that recovery would be long and painful. （读后续写·医护·照料）
synonyms.usage: treat 只表示'施以治疗'，不保证痊愈；cure 则含'治好、根除'的结果义。句法上treat sb（treat a patient）、cure sb of sth（cure him of his cold），treat 后接病人/疾病均可，cure 治病人时须搭 of。

synonyms.translation: n.补救办法 / vt.补救（问题/弊端，较正式）
synonyms.example: To remedy the shortage of reading materials, the student council launched a book-donation drive that filled three empty shelves. （应用文·倡议）
synonyms.usage: remedy 既可指药方，也常喻指'纠正问题的补救措施'，比 cure 更书面、更常用于抽象问题。

advancedExpressions.expression: some wounds no medicine can cure; only ... can
advancedExpressions.example: Some wounds no medicine can cure; only time, and the steady love of those who stay, can slowly knit them whole again. （分号对照 + 排比 time and love，续写疗伤主题的升华句）

advancedExpressions.expression: as the old saying goes, prevention is better than cure; therefore, I urge everyone to ...
advancedExpressions.example: As the old saying goes, prevention is better than cure; therefore, I sincerely urge every classmate to take a short break from the screen and step out into the sunlight. （谚语开篇 + therefore 呼吁，倡议信套路）

advancedExpressions.expression: ... may ease the symptoms, but it is no cure for the deeper problem of ...
advancedExpressions.example: Stricter rules may ease the symptoms of campus bullying, but they are no cure for the deeper problem of indifference among those who look on and say nothing. （治标不治本论证结构，医疗隐喻贯穿）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The doctor cured the boy.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It was not the medicine alone that cured the boy, but the old doctor's unfailing habit of sitting by his bed each evening, telling stories until the small, frightened eyes finally softened into sleep. （读后续写·医患温情·强调句）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It was not...alone that...but...强调句+对比 + 细节动作 sitting by his bed telling stories + eyes softened into sleep 以外显内，写心理

sentenceUpgrade.original: We can't solve pollution with one method.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: There is no single cure for the sickness of pollution that now troubles our cities; only when governments, businesses and ordinary citizens act as one can the air we breathe truly begin to clear. （议论文·环保·比喻+强调）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 疾病隐喻 sickness of pollution 呼应 cure + only when...倒装强调条件 + 三方并列 governments, businesses and citizens 体现全局论证

classPractice.type: 语境应用·翻译句子（课件）
classPractice.question: 医生治好了她罕见的血液病。（The doctor ____ her ____ a rare blood disease.）
classPractice.note: 考点：cure sb of + 疾病名词。（课件·Integrated skills 翻译原题）

classPractice.type: 语境应用·翻译句子（课件）
classPractice.question: 科学家目前还没有找到治疗这种感冒的方法。（Scientists have so far failed to provide a ____ ____ the cold.）
classPractice.note: 考点：a cure for sth，'……的疗法'固定搭 for。（课件·Integrated skills 翻译原题）

classPractice.type: 语境应用·翻译句子（课件）
classPractice.question: 她想尽一切办法试图改掉她孩子的这个恶习。（She tried every means to ____ her child ____ the bad habit.）
classPractice.note: 考点：cure sb of sth 亦可指'矫正、根治坏习惯'。（课件·Integrated skills 翻译原题）

classPractice.question: The Prince has given up hope of a cure, so his wife takes him to see a doctor who may find a cure ____ his stammer.
classPractice.note: 考点：a cure for sth，'……的疗法'固定搭 for（呼应课文原句 hope of a cure）。

classPractice.question: 那次尴尬的摔倒治好了他爱炫耀的毛病。That embarrassing fall ____ ____ ____ his habit of showing off.
classPractice.note: 考点：cure sb of sth，治好某人的病/坏习惯，中间用 of。

classPractice.question: The nurses did their best to ____ (cure / treat) his burns, but no one could promise to ____ (cure / treat) him completely.
classPractice.note: 考点：treat 只表施治不保证治好，cure 强调根除治愈的结果。

original_sentence: Although the two men have very different backgrounds and do not get along at first, they eventually become friends.
readingExamples: Although the two men have very different backgrounds and do not get along at first, they eventually become friends.
definitionEn:
(1) adv. in the end, especially after a long time, delay, or a series of difficulties
(2) adv. as the final result of a process or sequence of events
(3) adv. used to say that something will happen at some unspecified point in the future, after other things have happened first

posExamples.sentence: Night after night she practised alone in the cold hall, and though her fingers ached and her courage often wavered, she eventually played the piece without a single mistake. （读后续写·坚持·苦尽甘来）
I am confident that, with everyone's steady support, our reading corner will eventually grow into the most beloved spot on the entire campus. （应用文·倡议信·展望）
Change never arrives overnight; those who plant trees in a barren land may not sit in their shade, yet their patience will eventually turn desert into forest. （议论文·坚持与远见）
The two boys quarrelled bitterly on the first day of camp, refused to share a tent, and yet, after a week of shared hardships, they eventually became the closest of friends. （读后续写·友情·由怨转亲）

wordForms.other: 构词法：event（事件）→ eventual（adj. 最终的，作定语，the eventual result 最终结果）→ eventually（adv. 最终）；注意 eventual 不表'可能的'，勿与 possible 混。eventuality（n. 可能发生的事，尤指坏事）

collocations.translation: 最终成为朋友（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Although the two men do not get along at first, they eventually become friends. （课文原句·必修二U1影评）
The seed of a careless remark, left unspoken-of, eventually turned into a wall of silence that neither friend knew how to break. （读后续写·误会·比喻）
After three crushing defeats, the small-town team eventually won the championship, and the whole village poured into the streets to celebrate. （读后续写·逆袭夺冠）
Seeing how much the trip meant to her daughter, the strict mother eventually gave in, though she pretended it had been her idea all along. （读后续写·亲情·妥协的温柔）
Only after losing her did he eventually realize that the little acts of care he had dismissed were, in fact, the truest form of love. （读后续写·顿悟·遗憾）
The rescued sparrow, its wing carefully bound, eventually recovered enough to circle the garden once before vanishing into the open sky. （读后续写·放归·治愈）
Years of quiet, thankless effort eventually paid off when her novel, once rejected by a dozen publishers, topped the bestseller list. （读后续写/议论文·努力有回报）
A society that ignores the cries of its lonely elderly will eventually have to answer a hard question: what kind of future are we truly building? （议论文·社会关怀）

synonyms.example: After hours of anxious waiting, the rescue helicopter finally appeared over the ridge, its blades scattering the mist like hope breaking through despair. （读后续写·获救·景物象征）
synonyms.usage: finally 除表'最终'外，还可用于列举时引出最后一点（First... Finally...），且常表期盼已久之事到来（含情绪）；eventually 无列举功能，只强调经历漫长过程/波折后的最终结果。位置上二者均可置动词前或句首。

synonyms.example: Ultimately, it is not talent but perseverance that decides how far a person can go. （议论文·观点收束）
synonyms.usage: ultimately 偏书面、正式，常用于议论文归纳'根本上、说到底'；eventually 更中性，侧重时间上的'最后终于'。

synonyms.example: In the end, all his boasting counted for nothing, and it was the quiet girl he had mocked who saved the day. （读后续写·反转）
synonyms.usage: in the end 是口语化短语，语气自然，宜置句首/句末；eventually 为副词，位置更灵活，常紧贴动词。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·表示'最终'（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: eventually = finally = in the end = at last = ultimately = sooner or later
advancedExpressions.example: After countless setbacks, they eventually / finally / in the end became friends. 历经波折，他们最终成了朋友。（功能：都表'最后终于'，写作换用避免重复；辨析见 synonyms）

advancedExpressions.expression: the eventual + n. （最终的……）
advancedExpressions.example: No one could have foreseen the eventual outcome of that small kindness. 没人能预见那件小善举最终的结果。（eventual 只作定语，adverb 用 eventually）

advancedExpressions.expression: step by step, against all odds, sb. eventually ...
advancedExpressions.example: Step by step, against all odds, the once-timid boy eventually stood at the top of the podium, holding the medal he had once dared not even dream of. （递进短语 step by step + against all odds 强化不易，续写高潮）

advancedExpressions.expression: with joint efforts, ... will eventually ...
advancedExpressions.example: With the joint efforts of every member, I believe our environmental campaign will eventually reach far beyond our campus and inspire the whole community. （倡议信结尾展望，with the joint efforts of 正式套语）

advancedExpressions.expression: though the road is long, ... will eventually prove that ...
advancedExpressions.example: Though the road to genuine change is long and often lonely, history will eventually prove that those who refuse to give up shape the world far more than those who merely complain. （让步 though + history will prove 提升论证高度）

sentenceUpgrade.original: They didn't like each other but eventually became friends.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Though they had clashed over everything from the start, the long days of shared hunger and cold slowly wore away their pride, and the two rivals eventually became friends closer than brothers. （读后续写·由敌到友·过程渲染）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 让步从句 Though they had clashed + 具体困境 shared hunger and cold 交代转变原因 + 比喻 closer than brothers 深化情感，避免生硬跳转

sentenceUpgrade.original: Hard work will succeed in the end.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is my firm belief that honest, patient effort, however slow its reward may seem, will eventually bear fruit, just as a river, drop by drop, wears its way through solid stone. （议论文·努力必有回报·比喻）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is my firm belief that 正式主句 + however 让步插入语 + eventually bear fruit + 类比 a river wears through stone，一句兼具观点与形象论证

classPractice.question: Although the two men do not get along at first, they ____ (eventual) become friends.
classPractice.note: 考点：修饰动词 become 需用副词 eventually（呼应课文原句）。

classPractice.question: 历经三次惨败后，那支小镇球队最终赢得了冠军。After three crushing defeats, the small-town team ____ ____ the championship.
classPractice.note: 考点：eventually 表'经波折后最终'，紧贴动词过去式。

classPractice.question: First we lost the map, then the torch broke, and ____ (eventually / finally) we had to spend the night in the forest.
classPractice.note: 考点：此处表'一波三折后最终'，eventually 与 finally 均可（finally 亦可用于列举结尾）。

original_sentence: The film looks like a fairly typical historical film without fancy special effects, and it is made enjoyable by the performances of the main actors.
readingExamples: The film looks like a fairly typical historical film without fancy special effects, and it is made enjoyable by the performances of the main actors.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. having the usual features or qualities of a particular type of person, thing, or group; representative
(2) adj. showing the most usual characteristics of a particular kind of thing, and therefore a good example of it
(3) adj. (of behaviour) happening in the way that you expect, based on what you know of someone or something (often used disapprovingly)

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （贬义、常带无奈）意料之中的，一贯如此的（That's typical!／典型的老毛病）
uncommonMeanings.example: The bus pulled away just as they turned the corner. "Typical!" he groaned, throwing up his hands at yet another morning gone wrong. （读后续写·倒霉的一天·口语反应）

posExamples.sentence: It was a typical winter morning in the village — smoke curling from the chimneys, frost lacing the windows, and the smell of fresh bread drifting warmly down the lane. （读后续写·环境描写·画面感）
In my report on our school life, I have described a typical school day so that overseas readers can picture how Chinese students study, rest and grow together. （应用文·介绍信/报告）
It is a mistake to judge an entire generation by a few typical complaints heard online; behind the noise stand millions of young people quietly working towards a better tomorrow. （议论文·反对以偏概全）
With her patched coat and endless questions, she was not a typical new student, and within a week she had turned our sleepy classroom completely upside down. （读后续写·人物出场·反差）

wordForms.other: 词族全家桶：type（n. 类型 / v. 打字）→ typical（adj. 典型的）→ typically（adv. 典型地，通常）→ typify（vt. 是……的典型）；反义前缀 a- 构成 atypical（adj. 非典型的）。搭配提示：a type of + n.（一种……），this type of person。

collocations.translation: 相当典型的历史片（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: The film looks like a fairly typical historical film without fancy special effects. （课文原句·必修二U1影评）

collocations.translation: 是……的典型特征；很符合……的一贯风格
collocations.example: Such warm generosity is typical of my grandmother. 这般热心慷慨正是我祖母的典型作风。
His quiet act of returning the lost wallet was a typical example of the honesty our teacher had spent three years trying to plant in us. （读后续写·品格·以事显德）

collocations.translation: 是某人/某物的典型特征；很符合……的一贯风格
collocations.example: It was typical of Grandma to give away her own umbrella and walk home soaked through, smiling as if nothing had happened. （读后续写·祖母·无私）
A typical morning at the shelter began before dawn, with the soft padding of paws and the eager eyes of dogs waiting to be fed. （读后续写·志愿服务）

collocations.phrase: far from typical / anything but typical
collocations.translation: 远非寻常，一点也不典型
collocations.example: What happened next was far from typical: instead of laughing, the whole class rose to its feet and applauded the trembling boy. （读后续写·意外反转·感动）
The little museum, typical of its kind in old mining towns, held rusty tools and faded photographs that whispered of a vanished way of life. （读后续写·怀旧·环境）
On the surface it seemed a fairly typical village, yet beneath its calm ran stories of courage no history book had ever recorded. （读后续写·表里对比）
In my presentation, I outlined the typical features of Chinese tea culture — patience, harmony and quiet respect for guests. （应用文·文化介绍）

synonyms.example: The survey chose a representative group of students from every grade, so that no single voice could drown out the rest. （议论文/应用文·调查报告）
synonyms.usage: representative 强调'能代表整体、可作样本'，常用于调查、抽样语境；typical 更强调'具备该类事物的常见特征'。

synonyms.example: With characteristic calm, the old captain gave his orders, and the panic aboard slowly gave way to order. （读后续写·人物·沉稳）
synonyms.usage: characteristic 强调'某人/某物独有、区别于他者的特征'；typical 强调'与同类相符、有代表性'，前者重个性，后者重共性。

synonyms.example: The standard procedure required every visitor to sign in, yet on that snowy night the guard quietly waved the shivering stranger inside. （读后续写·规则与温情）
synonyms.usage: standard 侧重'符合规定/常规标准'；typical 侧重'具代表性、常见'，standard 更中性、程序化。

advancedExpressions.expression: be typical of sb / sth；a typical example of；typical of its kind；far from typical
advancedExpressions.example: It was typical of him to arrive first and leave last. 他总是最早到、最晚走，一贯如此。（be typical of + 人/物，表'符合其一贯特征'）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·'典型的/有代表性的'（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: typical = representative = characteristic = classic = standard
advancedExpressions.example: It was a typical / classic case of a hero going unnoticed. 这是英雄不被看见的典型例子。（功能：都表'典型/代表性'，辨析见 synonyms）

advancedExpressions.expression: type → typical → typically → typify → atypical
advancedExpressions.example: This painting typifies the style of the whole period. 这幅画是整个时期风格的典型代表。（typify = be typical of）

advancedExpressions.expression: it was a typical ..., with ..., ..., and ...
advancedExpressions.example: It was a typical autumn afternoon, with golden leaves drifting down, sunlight pooling on the old stone steps, and the distant laughter of children floating on the breeze. （典型场景 + with 独立主格三细节，快速铺开画面）

advancedExpressions.expression: to give you a clearer picture, let me describe a typical ...
advancedExpressions.example: To give you a clearer picture of our campus life, let me describe a typical school day, from the cheerful morning run to the quiet reading hour before dusk. （介绍信过渡句，用 typical 引出具体描写）

advancedExpressions.expression: it is unfair / misleading to take a few typical cases as representative of the whole
advancedExpressions.example: It is both unfair and misleading to take a few typical cases of failure as representative of an entire group, for every generalization is a shadow that hides countless bright exceptions. （反对以偏概全，typical/representative 精准对比）

sentenceUpgrade.original: It was a normal winter morning.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It was a typical winter morning, and yet, as the first snow of the year settled softly over the sleeping town, even the most ordinary rooftops seemed touched with a quiet, unexpected magic. （读后续写·平凡中见诗意·环境）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: typical...and yet 制造'平凡→不凡'转折 + 拟人 town sleeping / rooftops touched with magic + 副词 softly, quietly 控制节奏

sentenceUpgrade.original: Don't judge everyone by a few bad examples.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: We should never allow a handful of typical failures to colour our view of an entire generation, for behind every loud complaint stand countless silent souls working, hoping and quietly changing the world. （议论文·反对以偏概全·排比）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: never allow...to colour our view 提升语气 + for 引出理由 + 三动词排比 working, hoping and changing + 对比 loud vs silent，论证更有力

classPractice.question: The film looks like a fairly ____ (type) historical film without fancy special effects.
classPractice.note: 考点：形容词修饰名词 film，type → typical（呼应课文原句）。

classPractice.question: 把伞让给别人、自己淋雨回家，这正是我奶奶的典型作风。To give away her umbrella and walk home soaked was ____ ____ ____ my grandmother.
classPractice.note: 考点：be typical of sb，'是某人一贯特征/作风'。

classPractice.question: ____ (typical), students here get up at six and start their morning reading before class.
classPractice.note: 考点：句首修饰全句需用副词 typically，'通常，一般来说'。

translation: adj. 复杂的；花哨的；昂贵的 | vt. 想要，想做；倾慕
original_sentence: The film looks like a fairly typical historical film without fancy special effects, and it is made enjoyable by the performances of the main actors.
readingExamples: The film looks like a fairly typical historical film without fancy special effects, and it is made enjoyable by the performances of the main actors.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. elaborate, decorative, or complicated in design, rather than plain or simple
(2) adj. expensive and fashionable, often unnecessarily so
(3) vt. (BrE, informal) to want something or want to do something
(4) vt. (BrE, informal) to feel sexually or romantically attracted to someone
(5) vt. to think or believe something, especially without being certain
(6) n. a feeling of wanting or liking something, which is not based on reason

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 花哨的，装饰华丽的；昂贵讲究的（a fancy restaurant／fancy clothes，常含'华而不实'意）
uncommonMeanings.example: The little café needed no fancy decorations to make travellers feel at home. 这家小咖啡馆无需华丽装饰就让旅人有家的感觉。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （英式口语）想要，想做（fancy sth / fancy doing sth）
uncommonMeanings.example: Fancy a cup of tea? 想来杯茶吗？

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （英式口语）喜欢，倾慕，看上（某人）
uncommonMeanings.example: Everyone in class had guessed that he fancied the new girl long before he dared even to say hello. （读后续写·校园·青涩情愫）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （较正式/文学）以为，认为，想象（尤指没把握地设想）
uncommonMeanings.example: For one wild moment she fancied she heard her late grandmother humming in the kitchen, and her heart clenched with a longing too deep for words. （读后续写·思念·恍惚幻觉）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 一时兴起的喜好，突发的念头；想象力
uncommonMeanings.example: Building a boat from old crates was just a summer fancy of theirs, yet that reckless dream taught the boys more than any classroom ever had. （读后续写·童年·奇思异想）

posExamples.sentence: The little café needed no fancy decorations; its worn wooden tables and the smell of roasting coffee were enough to make every traveller feel instantly at home. （读后续写·温馨小店·朴实之美）
For our charity sale, please do not bring fancy or expensive gifts; a simple handmade card will carry far more warmth to the children in the mountains. （应用文·倡议/通知）
"Fancy a walk before dinner?" Grandpa asked, holding out his weathered hand, and in that small invitation lay all the love he could never quite put into words. （读后续写·祖孙·含蓄温情）
A film need not rely on fancy special effects to move us; more often, it is an honest story and a single true performance that stay with us long after the lights come up. （议论文·艺术的本质）

wordForms.other: fancily (adv. 花哨地)

idioms.idiom: take a fancy to sb / sth
idioms.example: The lonely old widow took such a fancy to the stray cat that within a week it was sleeping on the softest cushion in the house. （读后续写·孤独与陪伴）
Of all the paintings in the gallery, it was a child's clumsy sketch of a sunrise that caught her fancy and would not let go. （读后续写·艺术·童真打动人心）

idioms.translation: 投合某人兴趣，逗某人开心
idioms.example: If none of the usual clubs tickle your fancy, why not gather a few friends and start one of your very own? （应用文·社团招募·亲切鼓励）

idioms.translation: 真没想到！竟有这种事！（表惊讶）
idioms.example: "The shy boy who never spoke in class has won the national writing prize — fancy that!" the old teacher murmured, wiping a tear of pride. （读后续写·意外·惊喜）

collocations.translation: 【课件】一双很花哨/讲究的鞋（fancy adj. 复杂的；花哨的；昂贵的）
collocations.example: That's a very fancy pair of shoes! 那是一双非常花哨的鞋！（课件·Integrated skills 原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】高昂的价格；昂贵得离谱的价钱
collocations.example: We stayed at some hotels with fancy prices in the centre of London. 我们住在伦敦市中心一些价格昂贵的旅馆。（课件·Integrated skills 原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】（英式口语）想要，想做某事（fancy v.）
collocations.example: Sorry, but I don't fancy going out tonight. 抱歉，我今晚不太想出门。（课件·Integrated skills 原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】倾慕，喜欢，看上（某人）（fancy v.）
collocations.example: All the girls fancied him. 所有女孩都倾慕他。（课件·Integrated skills 原句）

collocations.translation: 没有花哨的特效（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: The film looks like a fairly typical historical film without fancy special effects. （课文原句·必修二U1影评）

collocations.translation: 高档餐厅／华丽的衣服／正装（adj. 花哨昂贵的）
collocations.example: We didn't go to any fancy restaurant; a bowl of noodles was enough. 我们没去什么高档餐厅，一碗面就够了。

collocations.translation: （英式口语）想做某事（v. 想要）
collocations.example: Do you fancy going to the film festival with me? 你想跟我去电影节吗？

collocations.translation: 华丽的衣服/正装/高档餐厅
collocations.example: She did not own a single fancy dress, yet when she stepped into the hall in her plain white blouse, every head turned all the same. （读后续写·质朴之美·反差）
The meal was nothing fancy — just rice, eggs and pickled greens — but shared around that small table, it tasted like the finest feast in the world. （读后续写·家的味道·温情）
Stripped of fancy special effects, the documentary let the vast, silent desert speak for itself, and the audience sat spellbound. （议论文/读后续写·艺术评论）
"Fancy joining us for the mountain clean-up this Saturday?" she asked, and to her surprise the quiet boy nodded at once. （应用文/读后续写·邀请）
The moment the children took a fancy to the abandoned puppy, there was no chance any of them would leave the shelter without it. （读后续写·收养·温情）
He fancied himself a fearless explorer, until the first clap of thunder sent him scrambling back to the safety of the tent. （读后续写·自负受挫·幽默）
At first her parents dismissed the violin as a passing fancy, but ten years of dawn practice proved just how wrong they had been. （读后续写·坚持·证明自己）

collocations.translation: 花哨的脚法/华丽的辞藻
collocations.example: Real leadership is not about fancy words but about quiet deeds; people follow those who act, not those who merely talk. （议论文·言与行）

synonyms.translation: 精心制作的，复杂华丽的
synonyms.example: The palace ceiling was covered with elaborate carvings, each tiny figure telling a story older than the kingdom itself. （读后续写·古迹·环境）
synonyms.usage: elaborate 强调'工艺繁复、精雕细琢'，中性偏褒；fancy 有时暗含'华而不实、过分讲究'的意味，可褒可贬。

synonyms.example: After weeks in the wild, even a plain warm bed felt as luxurious as a king's chamber to the weary travellers. （读后续写·历尽艰辛·对比）
synonyms.usage: luxurious 侧重'昂贵、舒适、令人享受'；fancy 侧重'装饰花哨、显眼时髦'，未必真正舒适。

synonyms.example: All she desired that lonely evening was a familiar voice on the other end of the line. （读后续写·孤独·渴望）
synonyms.usage: desire 正式、语气强，表'强烈渴望'；fancy 作动词是英式口语，语气轻，多指'临时想要、有点想'。

advancedExpressions.expression: take a fancy to sb/sth（喜欢上）；fancy doing sth（想做）；nothing fancy（不奢华）；a passing fancy（一时兴起）
advancedExpressions.example: The children took a fancy to the stray puppy at once. 孩子们一下子就喜欢上了那只流浪小狗。

advancedExpressions.expression: fancy: adj. 花哨/昂贵 → vt. 想要/喜欢/以为 → n. 想象/一时爱好；派生 fanciful（adj. 异想天开的）、fancily（adv. 花哨地）
advancedExpressions.example: It's not a serious plan, just a passing fancy. 这不是正经计划，只是一时的念头。

advancedExpressions.expression: there was nothing fancy about ..., yet ...
advancedExpressions.example: There was nothing fancy about the tiny cottage, yet the warmth glowing from its windows on that snowy night felt richer than any mansion could ever offer. （nothing fancy...yet 对比，以简陋衬温情，续写常用）

advancedExpressions.expression: there is no need for anything fancy; what truly matters is ...
advancedExpressions.example: There is no need for anything fancy at our farewell party; what truly matters is that we gather, laugh, and treasure these last days together. （倡议/通知，反对铺张、强调心意）

advancedExpressions.expression: ... does not lie in fancy ..., but in ...
advancedExpressions.example: The value of a good film does not lie in fancy special effects, but in its power to make us feel, remember, and quietly become better people. （not in...but in...对比句，凸显本质超越形式）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The restaurant was not fancy but the food was good.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The little roadside restaurant was nothing fancy — no soft lights, no white tablecloths — yet the steaming bowl the old cook set before us carried a homely richness that no five-star kitchen could ever match. （读后续写·市井温情·对比）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: nothing fancy + 破折号列举缺失细节 no lights, no tablecloths + 对比 no five-star kitchen could match + 通感 steaming...homely richness

sentenceUpgrade.original: A good film doesn't need special effects.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: A truly great film need not dazzle us with fancy special effects; it wins our hearts instead through honest storytelling and performances so real that we forget, for two short hours, that we are only watching. （议论文·艺术本质·对比升华）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: need not dazzle...with fancy... + 分号转折 wins our hearts instead + so real that 结果状语 + 细节 forget that we are only watching，虚实结合论证

classPractice.question: 从括号中选词填空：A truly great film need not rely on ____ (fancy / typical) special effects to move us.
classPractice.note: 考点：fancy 作形容词'花哨的'（呼应课文原句 without fancy special effects）。

classPractice.question: 孩子们一下子就喜欢上了那只被遗弃的小狗。The children ____ ____ ____ ____ the abandoned puppy at once.
classPractice.note: 考点：take a fancy to sb/sth，'喜欢上，中意'。

classPractice.question: "Fancy ____ (join) us for the mountain clean-up this Saturday?" she asked with a smile.
classPractice.note: 考点：fancy doing sth，'（英式口语）想做某事'，后接动名词。

translation: adj. 狭窄的；勉强的；狭隘的 | vt. & vi. (使) 窄小，缩小
original_sentence: In the meantime, Hooper skilfully creates uncertainty and tension with narrow indoor sets and dark lighting.
readingExamples: In the meantime, Hooper skilfully creates uncertainty and tension with narrow indoor sets and dark lighting.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. measuring a small distance from one side to the other, especially in relation to length
(2) adj. limited in range, scope or variety; not broad-minded
(3) adj. only just achieved or avoided by a small margin
(4) v. to become or make sth less wide; to reduce or limit sth

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 勉强的，险胜的；仅以微弱差距的
uncommonMeanings.example: It was a narrow escape: had the branch snapped a second earlier, the falling climber would have plunged into the ravine below. （读后续写·历险脱困·后怕）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （眼睛）眯起，（差距）缩小
uncommonMeanings.example: Her eyes narrowed as she studied the stranger's face, and a flicker of recognition crept across her features. （读后续写·人物心理·警觉）

posExamples.sentence: As we edged along the narrow mountain path, the mist thickened around us, and every loose stone sent my heart hammering against my ribs. （读后续写·徒步历险·紧张氛围）
I would strongly advise against such a narrow selection of activities, for a festival confined to a single theme can hardly cater to the varied tastes of our student body. （应用文·建议信）
Those who cling to a narrow definition of success — money and fame alone — often overlook the quiet fulfilment that comes from serving others. （议论文·成功的意义）
By reading widely and travelling far, we can narrow the gap between what we imagine the world to be and what it truly is. （议论文·视野与成长）

wordForms.other: narrow-minded (adj. 心胸狭隘的)

idioms.idiom: a narrow escape / a close shave
idioms.example: The driver swerved just in time — it was such a narrow escape that his hands would not stop trembling for a full ten minutes. （读后续写·车祸险情·后怕）

idioms.idiom: keep to the straight and narrow
idioms.example: After years of trouble, he finally vowed to keep to the straight and narrow and rebuild the trust of those who had never given up on him. （读后续写·浪子回头·救赎）

collocations.translation: 【课件】一条狭窄的街道（narrow adj. 狭窄的；狭隘的）
collocations.example: a narrow street 一条狭窄的街道；The stairs were very narrow. 楼梯很窄。（课件·Integrated skills 原句）
a narrow escape 九死一生；侥幸逃脱。（课件·Integrated skills 原句词块）
The president won a narrow victory in the election. 总统在选举中险胜。（课件·Integrated skills 原句）
The choice of goods available is narrowing. 可供选择的商品范围正在缩小。（课件·Integrated skills 原句，narrow v.）

collocations.translation: 【课件】狭隘的眼界；（使）变窄、缩小
collocations.example: Some teachers have a narrow vision of what art is. 有些老师对艺术为何物有着狭隘的看法。The track divided into two and narrowed. 小路分成两条，并且变窄了。（课件·Integrated skills 原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件·拓展】勉强地；差一点；狭隘地
collocations.example: The bus went too fast and narrowly hit me. 那辆公交车开太快了，差点撞上我。（课件·Integrated skills 翻译原句）

collocations.translation: 狭窄的室内布景（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Hooper skilfully creates uncertainty and tension with narrow indoor sets and dark lighting. （课文原句·必修二U1影评）
It was a narrow escape; a second later and the branch would have hit him. 真是死里逃生，晚一秒树枝就砸中他了。
We narrowed down the list to three finalists. 我们把名单缩小到三名入围者。
We wandered through the narrow cobbled lanes of the old town, where washing hung like flags between the leaning houses. （读后续写·古镇漫游·画面感）
Looking back on that narrow escape, I realized how a single moment of caution had spared us from disaster. （读后续写·脱险反思）

collocations.phrase: a narrow margin / by a narrow margin
collocations.translation: 微弱的差距／以微弱优势
collocations.example: Our team won the debate by a narrow margin, a victory made all the sweeter by the weeks of relentless preparation behind it. （应用文·比赛报道）
The old fisherman narrowed his eyes against the glare of the setting sun, searching the horizon for the boat that had not yet returned. （读后续写·环境+心理·担忧）
Free evening classes were introduced to narrow the gap between urban and rural students' access to quality education. （议论文·教育公平）
After weeks of research, the committee narrowed down the candidates to just three finalists. （应用文·评选通知）

collocations.translation: 狭隘的心胸；心胸狭窄的
collocations.example: A narrow mind, forever suspicious of the unfamiliar, is the surest barrier to genuine friendship between cultures. （议论文·包容与偏见）
Confining ourselves to a narrow view of our own hometown blinds us to the astonishing diversity of the wider world. （议论文·开阔视野）

collocations.translation: 勉强避开／险些错过／侥幸逃脱
collocations.example: The goalkeeper dived full length and narrowly stopped the ball from crossing the line, sparing his team a crushing defeat. （读后续写·比赛·关键时刻）

synonyms.translation: 宽的，宽阔的（narrow 的直接反义）
synonyms.example: The lane was so narrow that two carts could hardly pass, unlike the wide new road across the river. 这条巷子窄得两辆车都难过，不像河对岸那条宽阔的新路。
synonyms.usage: 反义辨析：narrow ↔ wide 指物理宽度；抽象'心胸/眼界狭隘'的反义则用 broad（broad-minded 心胸开阔）。

synonyms.translation: 宽广的；（心胸/视野）开阔的
synonyms.example: Travel gave him a broad outlook that his narrow-minded neighbours could never understand. 旅行给了他开阔的眼界，那是心胸狭隘的邻居无法理解的。
synonyms.usage: 抽象义反义：narrow-minded（狭隘）↔ broad-minded（开明）；a narrow view ↔ a broad view。物理宽度反义才用 wide。

synonyms.example: In such a restricted space, the two rescue workers could barely turn around, let alone lift the collapsed beam. （读后续写·救援·困境）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:restricted 强调受外部条件限制而受限，narrow 更直接描述物理宽度小或思想不开阔

synonyms.example: With only limited resources at his disposal, the young teacher still managed to bring the whole village a library. （议论文·条件与作为）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:limited 泛指数量/范围有限，narrow 在抽象义上更强调思想或选择的狭隘、不宽广

synonyms.example: A slender ray of light slipped through the crack in the curtains, tracing a golden line across the dusty floor. （读后续写·环境描写·清晨）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:slender 多形容优雅细长的形状（身材、光线），narrow 中性地强调宽度小，不带审美色彩

advancedExpressions.expression: a narrow escape（死里逃生）；narrow down（缩小范围）；narrow the gap（缩小差距）；narrow one's eyes（眯眼）
advancedExpressions.example: After weeks of research they narrowed down the options to three. 数周调研后他们把选项缩小到三个。

advancedExpressions.expression: narrow (adj./v.) → narrowly (adv. 勉强地) → narrowness (n.) → narrow-minded (adj. 心胸狭隘的)
advancedExpressions.example: He narrowly escaped the falling rocks. 他险些被落石砸中。（narrowly = 差一点，勉强）

advancedExpressions.expression: it was a narrow escape; had ... , sb. would have ...
advancedExpressions.example: It was a narrow escape indeed; had the rope frayed a moment sooner, he would have been swept away by the churning current. （虚拟条件倒装+后怕心理，续写脱险段升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: I would caution against so narrow a ... , for ...
advancedExpressions.example: I would caution against so narrow a focus on academic scores, for a truly enriching campus life must also nourish the heart and body. （委婉劝诫+because从句，建议信论证）

advancedExpressions.expression: to narrow the gap between ... and ... , we must ...
advancedExpressions.example: To narrow the gap between ambition and achievement, we must translate lofty ideals into disciplined daily action.

sentenceUpgrade.original: We walked along a narrow path.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Single file, we picked our way along a narrow ledge that clung to the cliff face, the valley yawning dizzyingly beneath our trembling feet. （读后续写·环境+动作·惊险）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 定语从句(that clung to)拟人化 + 独立成分(Single file)开头 + 环境细节(yawning dizzyingly)营造惊险氛围

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should not have narrow minds.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: If we are ever to flourish as global citizens, we must cast off the narrow-mindedness that breeds prejudice and instead embrace the rich tapestry of human difference. （议论文·包容主题）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 条件状语从句前置 + 定语从句(that breeds prejudice) + 比喻(rich tapestry) + 对比结构(cast off...embrace)

classPractice.note: 考点：narrow adj. '狭窄的'，形容街道宽度小。（课件·Integrated skills 翻译原题）

classPractice.note: 考点：narrow adj. 抽象义'狭窄的、有限的'，修饰 circle of friends。（课件·Integrated skills 翻译原题）

classPractice.note: 考点：narrowly adv. '差一点，勉强地'，修饰动词 hit。（课件·Integrated skills 翻译原题）

classPractice.question: 导演用狭窄的室内布景和昏暗的灯光营造紧张感。The director creates tension with ____ indoor sets and dark lighting.
classPractice.note: 考点：narrow 作形容词'狭窄的'（呼应课文原句 narrow indoor sets）。

classPractice.question: It was ____ ____ ____ — had the branch snapped a second earlier, the climber would have fallen into the ravine.
classPractice.note: 考点：a narrow escape，'死里逃生，侥幸脱险'。

classPractice.question: Travel gives us a ____ (narrow / broad) outlook and helps us leave our old prejudices behind.
classPractice.note: 考点：抽象'眼界开阔'用 broad，与 narrow（狭隘）互为反义。

original_sentence: All in all, I highly recommend this film.
readingExamples: All in all, I highly recommend this film.
definitionEn:
(1) v. to advise sb that a particular person, product or course of action would be good or suitable
(2) v. to praise sth or say it is good; to speak favourably of
(3) v. to suggest that sth should be done or accepted
(4) v. (of a quality) to make sb or sth attractive or acceptable

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 使显得吸引人；使被接受（常用 have much to recommend it）
uncommonMeanings.example: The little seaside inn had much to recommend it: home-cooked meals, a crackling fire, and a hostess whose kindness made every guest feel like family. （读后续写·旅途温情·环境）

posExamples.sentence: 'You simply must try the almond cake,' the old baker recommended with a wink, sliding an extra slice onto my plate before I could refuse. （读后续写·人物对话·温情）
I am writing to recommend Li Hua for the position of student ambassador, as her warmth and fluent English make her an ideal candidate for the role. （应用文·推荐信）
Experts strongly recommend that teenagers limit their screen time, arguing that unbroken hours before a glowing display do lasting harm to both sleep and concentration. （议论文·健康与科技）
The committee recommended replacing the outdated computers, a proposal that was warmly welcomed by teachers and students alike. （应用文·会议纪要）

wordForms.other: 词族：recommend（vt.）→ recommendation（n. 推荐；建议；推荐信）→ recommendable（adj. 值得推荐的）。特例提示：recommend 后不接不定式，只用 recommend doing / recommend that sb (should) do；名词搭配 a letter of recommendation（推荐信）、on one's recommendation（经某人推荐）。

collocations.translation: 【课件】把某物推荐给某人（推荐义，介词用 to）
collocations.example: Could you recommend a good restaurant to me? 你能给我推荐一家好餐馆吗？（课件·Integrated skills 原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】推荐某物/某人担任（某职位）
collocations.example: The teacher recommended her for the exchange programme. 老师推荐她参加交流项目。（课件·Integrated skills 讲点：recommend sth for a job）

collocations.translation: 【课件】建议做某事（建议义，后接动名词）
collocations.example: I would recommend booking your tickets in advance. 我建议提前订票。（课件·Integrated skills 讲点：recommend (doing)）

collocations.translation: 【课件】建议某人做某事（课件所列句型）
collocations.example: The doctor recommended him to take more exercise. 医生建议他多锻炼。（课件·Integrated skills 讲点：recommend sb to do；注：正式笔试更常用 recommend that sb (should) do）

collocations.phrase: recommend + that 从句（should + 动词原形，should 常省）
collocations.translation: 【课件】建议……（that 从句用虚拟语气）
collocations.example: You are strongly recommended to seek professional advice. 强烈建议您寻求专业意见。The committee recommended that the plan (should) be carried out at once. 委员会建议立刻执行该方案。（课件·Integrated skills 讲点及原句）

collocations.phrase: have little / much to recommend it
collocations.translation: 【课件】毫无可取之处／有很多可取之处
collocations.example: The hotel has little to recommend it. 这个旅馆毫无可取之处。（课件·Integrated skills 原句）

collocations.translation: 强烈推荐（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: All in all, I highly recommend this film. （课文原句·必修二U1影评）

collocations.translation: 建议做某事（后接动名词，不接不定式）
collocations.example: I recommend arriving early to get a good seat. 我建议早点到以占个好座位。

collocations.translation: 建议某人做某事（that 从句用虚拟语气 should + 动词原形，should 可省）
collocations.example: The doctor recommended that he (should) take a complete rest. 医生建议他彻底休息。
It was my grandmother who first recommended this dusty little bookshop to me, and I have loved its quiet corners ever since. （读后续写·回忆·温情）
Our head teacher recommended me for the exchange programme, a vote of confidence that filled me with both pride and nervous excitement. （读后续写·成长机遇）
I would recommend arriving at least half an hour early, so that everyone has time to settle in before the ceremony begins. （应用文·通知）

collocations.translation: 建议某人做某事（虚拟语气）
collocations.example: The doctor recommended that he take a complete rest for a fortnight and avoid any strenuous exercise. （应用文·建议）
All in all, I highly recommend this novel to anyone who has ever felt lost and longed to find their way home. （应用文·书评）
The professor kindly agreed to write me a letter of recommendation, praising the very qualities I had feared no one had noticed. （读后续写·师生·感激）

collocations.translation: 经某人推荐；根据某人的建议
collocations.example: On my teacher's recommendation, I joined the debate club, a decision that would quietly reshape the course of my life. （读后续写·转折·成长）

collocations.phrase: have much / little to recommend it
collocations.translation: 有很多／没什么可取之处
collocations.example: The plan, hastily drawn up overnight, had little to recommend it beyond its low cost. （议论文·方案评价）

synonyms.example: May I suggest that we hold the charity sale in the school hall rather than outdoors, in case the weather turns against us? （应用文·活动建议）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:suggest 语气较委婉、平等，只提出想法；recommend 带有背书、担保的分量，暗示说话者认为这确实是好选择。句法上二者都可接 doing / that (should) do，均不接不定式（不可 suggest/recommend sb to do）。

synonyms.example: I would advise you to think twice before making so hasty a decision, for haste seldom leads to a wise outcome. （议论文/应用文·劝诫）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:advise 强调基于经验给出忠告，带指导意味；且 advise 可接 advise sb to do（recommend/suggest 不可如此）；recommend 更侧重积极地推举、赞许某物值得选择。

synonyms.example: The famous athlete publicly endorsed the campaign, and overnight thousands of young people signed up. （议论文·名人效应）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:endorse 多指公开、正式地表示支持（常见于产品代言、政策），比 recommend 更正式、更有权威色彩

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·recommend/suggest/advise + that 从句虚拟语气（should 常省）
advancedExpressions.expression: recommend / suggest / advise + that + sb (should) + do（从句谓语用动词原形，should 常省略）
advancedExpressions.example: You are strongly recommended to seek professional advice; likewise, the committee recommended that the plan (should) be carried out at once. 强烈建议您寻求专业意见；委员会同样建议立刻执行该方案。（课件·Integrated skills 讲点：表'建议/要求'的词后 that 从句用虚拟语气）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·recommend 推荐义 vs 建议义 的两组句型
advancedExpressions.expression: 推荐：recommend sth to sb / recommend sb for (a job)；建议：recommend (doing) sth / recommend sb to do sth / recommend that sb (should) do
advancedExpressions.example: Could you recommend a good restaurant to me? 你能给我推荐一家好餐馆吗？— I'd recommend booking a table first. 我建议先订个位子。（课件·Integrated skills 讲点：两义各自搭配区分）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·recommend 之'使显得吸引人'义
advancedExpressions.expression: have little / much / nothing to recommend it
advancedExpressions.example: The hotel has little to recommend it. 这个旅馆毫无可取之处。（课件·Integrated skills 原句：recommend 表'使显得可取、吸引人'，主语常为物）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·recommend 的虚拟语气
advancedExpressions.expression: recommend / suggest / advise + that + sb (should) do （从句用should+动词原形，should 常省略）
advancedExpressions.example: The committee recommended that the plan (should) be carried out at once. 委员会建议立刻执行该方案。（表'建议/命令'的词后 that 从句用虚拟语气）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·'推荐/建议'（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: highly recommend = strongly recommend = warmly recommend = cannot recommend ... enough
advancedExpressions.example: I cannot recommend this film enough. 这部电影我怎么推荐都不为过。（功能：都强化推荐语气，书评/影评结尾常用）

advancedExpressions.expression: it was sb. who recommended ... , and for that I shall be forever grateful
advancedExpressions.example: It was Mr. Li who recommended me for the contest, and for that act of quiet faith I shall be forever grateful. （强调句+情感升华，续写感恩段）

advancedExpressions.expression: it is with the greatest confidence that I recommend ... , for ...
advancedExpressions.example: It is with the greatest confidence that I recommend Wang Ming for this scholarship, for seldom have I taught a student of such diligence and integrity. （正式主句+倒装强调，推荐信开篇）

advancedExpressions.expression: experts recommend that ... , a view that ...
advancedExpressions.example: Experts recommend that schools cultivate curiosity rather than mere obedience — a view that gains fresh urgency in an age of relentless change.

sentenceUpgrade.original: My teacher recommended this book to me.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It was my teacher who, noticing how I lingered by the shelves, gently pressed this worn little book into my hands and recommended I read it slowly, as one savours a fine meal. （读后续写·师生·细腻）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 强调句(It was...who) + 现在分词状语(noticing) + 明喻(as one savours a fine meal)增添画面与温度

sentenceUpgrade.original: I recommend this film because it is inspiring.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: All in all, I would wholeheartedly recommend this film, not merely for its stunning visuals but for the quiet courage it awakens in every heart that dares to watch it. （应用文·影评）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 递进关联词(not merely...but) + 副词强化(wholeheartedly) + 定语从句(that dares to watch)升华情感

classPractice.type: 语境应用·完成句子（课件）
classPractice.question: 强烈建议您寻求专业意见。You are ____ ____ ____ ____ professional advice.
classPractice.note: 考点：be recommended to do sth（被动式）'被建议做某事'。（课件·Integrated skills 完成句子原题）

classPractice.type: 语境应用·完成句子（课件）
classPractice.question: 你可以给我推荐一家好的餐馆吗？Could you ____ me a good restaurant? / Could you ____ a good restaurant ____ me?
classPractice.note: 考点：recommend sb sth = recommend sth to sb，'把某物推荐给某人'。（课件·Integrated skills 完成句子原题）

classPractice.type: 语境应用·翻译理解（课件）
classPractice.question: The hotel has little to recommend it. 这句话的意思是？（该旅馆____。）
classPractice.note: 考点：have little to recommend it，'没什么可取之处'（recommend 表'使显得吸引人'）。（课件·Integrated skills 原句）

classPractice.question: 总而言之，我强烈推荐这部电影。All in all, I ____ ____ this film.
classPractice.answer: highly recommend / strongly recommend / warmly recommend
classPractice.note: 考点：highly/strongly/warmly recommend，'强烈推荐'（呼应课文原句）。

classPractice.question: The doctor recommended that he ____ (take) a complete rest for two weeks.
classPractice.note: 考点：recommend that 从句用虚拟语气 (should) + 动词原形，should 可省，故 take 保持原形。

classPractice.question: I would recommend ____ (arrive) at least half an hour early so that everyone can settle in.
classPractice.note: 考点：recommend doing sth，后接动名词，不接不定式。

original_sentence: It tells the story of Forrest Gump, a simple man with a warm personality.
readingExamples: It tells the story of Forrest Gump, a simple man with a warm personality.
definitionEn:
(1) n. the various aspects of a person's character that combine to make them different from others
(2) n. qualities that make sb interesting, attractive or full of life
(3) n. a famous person, especially in entertainment or sport; a celebrity
(4) n. the quality of being a lively, distinctive individual

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 名人，公众人物（尤指娱乐、体育界，a TV / sports personality）
uncommonMeanings.example: The charity gala drew a host of television personalities, yet it was a shy little boy's speech that brought the entire hall to tears. （读后续写·慈善晚会·反差）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （场所、物件的）独特气质，鲜明特色
uncommonMeanings.example: The old café had a personality all its own — mismatched chairs, jazz humming from a corner, and walls papered with the dreams of a hundred regulars. （读后续写·环境·怀旧）

posExamples.sentence: Beneath his gruff exterior lay a warm and generous personality, one that revealed itself only to those patient enough to look beyond first impressions. （读后续写·人物刻画·反差）
In choosing our class monitor, we should value a sincere and responsible personality far more highly than a merely impressive academic record. （应用文·选举倡议）
It is often adversity, rather than comfort, that forges a resilient personality capable of weathering life's fiercest storms. （议论文·逆境与成长）
Her bubbly personality lit up the classroom the moment she walked in, and within a week not a single stranger remained. （读后续写·转学生·活泼）

wordForms.other: person 词族全家桶：person（n. 人）→ personal（adj. 个人的，私人的）→ personally（adv. 就个人而言；亲自）→ personality（n. 个性；名人）→ personalize（vt. 使个性化）→ personalized（adj. 个性化的）→ personify（vt. 象征，拟人化）→ persona（n. 人格面具）。辨析提示：personal 私人的 ≠ personnel（n. 全体员工，重音在末尾）。

idioms.example: What began as a mere clash of personalities gradually softened into mutual respect, as each learned to see the world through the other's eyes. （读后续写·和解·成长）

idioms.idiom: the life and soul of the party
idioms.translation: 聚会的灵魂人物，最活跃的人
idioms.example: With her boundless energy, Grace was always the life and soul of the party, drawing even the shyest guests into laughter. （读后续写·人物·活力）

collocations.translation: 热情友善的性格（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: It tells the story of Forrest Gump, a simple man with a warm personality. （课文原句·必修二U1《阿甘正传》简介）
Her strong personality made her the natural leader of the group. 她强势的性格使她自然成了团队的领头人。

collocations.translation: 电视名人，电视界名人（personality 表'名人'）
collocations.example: The show was hosted by a well-known TV personality. 节目由一位知名电视名人主持。
It tells the story of a simple man with a warm personality whose kindness quietly changes everyone he meets. （应用文·电影简介）
Her strong personality, once mistaken for stubbornness, proved to be exactly the courage the team needed in its darkest hour. （读后续写·人物·反转）
His outgoing personality made him the natural bridge between the shy newcomers and the tight-knit old class. （读后续写·融入集体）
On stage she was fearless and radiant, but off it a quiet shyness took over — a dual personality that few of her fans ever guessed at. （读后续写·反差）
The way a person treats a waiter, they say, reveals more about their true personality than any interview ever could. （议论文·品格）
Patience and perseverance are the two personality traits that most reliably distinguish those who succeed from those who give up. （议论文·成功要素）
The young coach had such a magnetic personality that players would run through walls for him without a second thought. （读后续写·领袖魅力）
The years spent volunteering abroad did more to shape his personality than a decade of comfortable schooling ever had. （议论文·经历塑造人）

synonyms.example: It is in moments of hardship, not of ease, that a person's true character stands revealed. （议论文·品格）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:character 偏重道德品质与内在原则（诚实、勇敢），personality 侧重外在表现出的性格特点与魅力（活泼、外向）

synonyms.example: Blessed with a calm temperament, she remained composed even as chaos erupted all around her. （读后续写·危机·沉稳）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:temperament 指与生俱来、较稳定的情绪倾向和脾性；personality 范围更广，涵盖后天形成的整体性格面貌

synonyms.example: His cheerful disposition was infectious, turning even the dreariest of rainy afternoons into an occasion for laughter. （读后续写·氛围·感染力）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:disposition 较正式，指一个人惯常的、内在的情绪倾向；personality 更常用、更全面地描述整个人的性格特质

advancedExpressions.expression: a warm / strong / outgoing personality；a TV personality（电视名人）；personality traits（性格特征）；shape one's personality（塑造性格）
advancedExpressions.example: It is often adversity, rather than comfort, that shapes a resilient personality. 塑造坚韧性格的往往是逆境而非安逸。

advancedExpressions.expression: person → personal → personally → personality → personalize → personify
advancedExpressions.example: Personally, I value a sincere personality more than good looks. 就我个人而言，真诚的性格比外表更重要。（personally 就个人而言）

advancedExpressions.expression: beneath sb.'s ... exterior lay a ... personality
advancedExpressions.example: Beneath his cold, unsmiling exterior lay a tender personality, bruised by years of loneliness yet aching to be understood. （倒装+反差刻画，续写人物深度）

advancedExpressions.expression: what truly sets sb. apart is not ... but his / her ... personality
advancedExpressions.example: What truly sets Li Hua apart is not her grades but her generous personality, which draws people to her as naturally as flowers draw bees. （强调对比+定语从句+明喻，介绍信）

advancedExpressions.expression: it is ... that shapes personality, far more than ...
advancedExpressions.example: It is the challenges we overcome, far more than the comforts we enjoy, that ultimately shape a strong and enduring personality.

sentenceUpgrade.original: He has a warm personality.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: There was a warmth to his personality that needed no words to express — a smile that reached the eyes, a hand always first to reach out, a presence that made strangers feel, somehow, at home. （读后续写·人物·细节）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 破折号引出并列名词短语铺陈(a smile...a hand...a presence) + 排比 + 具体动作细节替代抽象形容

sentenceUpgrade.original: Personality is more important than looks.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: While a pleasing appearance may open a door, it is a genuine and generous personality that keeps it open — for beauty fades, but character endures. （议论文·内在与外在）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 让步状语从句(While...) + 强调句(it is...that) + 隐喻(open a door) + 对偶收束(beauty fades, but character endures)

classPractice.question: 影片讲述了一个性格温暖的朴实男子的故事。It tells the story of a simple man with a ____ ____.
classPractice.note: 考点：a warm personality，'热情友善的性格'（呼应课文原句）。

classPractice.question: The show was hosted by a famous TV ____ (person) who had once been a shy schoolboy.
classPractice.note: 考点：a TV personality，personality 表'名人，公众人物'。

classPractice.question: ____ (Personally / Personality), I believe a sincere ____ (personal / personality) matters far more than a perfect exam record.
classPractice.note: 考点：句首状语用副词 Personally（就我个人而言）；a sincere + 名词 personality（性格）。

original_sentence: Despite an IQ of 75, he lives a truly amazing life.
readingExamples: Despite an IQ of 75, he lives a truly amazing life.
definitionEn:
(1) prep. without being affected by; in spite of
(2) prep. used to show that sth happens or is true although sth else might have prevented it
(3) n. (formal / literary) contempt; the state of being scorned (chiefly in the phrase 'in despite of')

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （文学／古语）轻蔑，蔑视（多见于 in despite of）
uncommonMeanings.example: In despite of every warning the villagers had given him, the stubborn old sailor set out to sea, his weathered jaw set hard against the coming storm. （读后续写·倔强性格·文学化）

posExamples.sentence: Despite the biting wind that clawed at his coat, the boy pressed on toward the distant light, determined to bring the medicine home before dawn. （读后续写·雪夜·意志）
Despite the tight budget, I firmly believe our class outing can still be both meaningful and memorable if we plan it with care. （应用文·活动策划）
Despite an IQ of just 75, Forrest Gump lives a truly amazing life, proving that a good heart may carry a person further than a brilliant mind ever could. （议论文·善良的力量）
Despite repeated failures, the young inventor refused to abandon her dream, and it was precisely this stubborn hope that finally lit the world. （议论文·坚持与成功）

wordForms.other: 介词，后接名词/动名词/代词，绝不接从句(接从句用 despite the fact that ...); 同义介词短语 in spite of; 对比连词 although/though(后接从句)

idioms.translation: 不由自主地，情不自禁地
idioms.example: Despite herself, a tear slid down her cheek as the old melody drifted from the piano, unlocking memories she had long tried to bury. （读后续写·情感·触动）
In despite of the danger, he plunged into the icy river without a moment's hesitation to save the drowning child. （读后续写·英勇·文学化）

collocations.phrase: despite = in spite of + 名词
collocations.translation: 尽管……（后接名词/代词，不接从句）【课件】
collocations.example: Despite an IQ of 75, he lives a truly amazing life. 只有75的智商，但他过着真正令人惊叹的生活。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 尽管某事／尽管做某事（后接名词或动名词）【课件】
collocations.example: Despite winning the competition, he remained humble. 尽管赢得了比赛，他仍然很谦虚。（课件完成句子答案）

collocations.phrase: despite the fact that = in spite of the fact that + 从句
collocations.translation: 尽管……（要接从句时用 the fact that 引导）【课件】
collocations.example: Despite the fact that the doctor asked him to lie in bed all day, he still went to work. 尽管医生让他卧床，他还是去上班了。（课件完成句子答案）

collocations.translation: 尽管付出了全部努力【课件】
collocations.example: Despite all her efforts, she still failed. 尽管付出了全部努力，她还是失败了。（课件完成句子答案）

collocations.translation: 尽管智商只有75（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Despite an IQ of 75, he lives a truly amazing life. （课文原句：despite 后直接接名词短语）

collocations.translation: 尽管……（后接名词或动名词，不接从句）
collocations.example: Despite failing twice, she tried again. 尽管失败两次，她还是又试了一次。
Despite the fact that he had never held a brush before, his first painting stunned everyone who saw it. （读后续写·天赋·惊叹）
Despite everything she had suffered, she never allowed bitterness to harden her generous heart. （读后续写·苦难·坚韧）
Despite our best efforts, the rescue came too late — yet the whole village would forever remember how hard they had fought. （读后续写·悲情·尊严）
Despite the countless obstacles in their path, the volunteers built a school where once there had been only ruins. （应用文·公益报道）
Despite being the youngest competitor, she carried herself with a calm that put even the veterans to shame. （读后续写·比赛·沉稳）
That so many students persisted despite the exhausting schedule speaks volumes about their dedication. （议论文·毅力）

synonyms.example: In spite of the pouring rain, the fans cheered until the final whistle. 尽管大雨倾盆，球迷们一直欢呼到终场哨响。
synonyms.usage: 语义差别+句法位置:in spite of 与 despite 意义完全相同，均为介词短语，后接名词/动名词/代词，不可直接接句子；in spite of 由三词组成、稍口语，despite 更简洁正式

synonyms.example: Although his IQ was only 75, he lived an amazing life. 尽管智商只有75，他过着精彩的一生。
synonyms.usage: 句法位置辨析（高频考点）:although/though 是连词，后必须接完整从句(主语+谓语)；despite 是介词，后只能接名词/动名词，不能接从句。要接从句须用 despite the fact that。误用 despite it was raining 为典型错误

synonyms.example: Notwithstanding the committee's objections, the headmaster pushed the reform through, convinced that history would prove him right. （议论文·改革·魄力）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:notwithstanding 极为正式、书面，多用于公文、议论文；despite 通用性更强，日常与正式写作皆宜

synonyms.example: Regardless of the risks, the firefighters charged into the blaze, thinking only of the family trapped inside. （读后续写·英勇·舍己）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:regardless of 强调'不顾、不理会'某因素而行动，主动色彩强；despite 侧重客观上'尽管有某阻碍事情仍发生'

advancedExpressions.expression: despite(介词)+名词 vs. although(连词)+从句
advancedExpressions.example: Despite the rain, we went out. = Although it rained, we went out. 两句同义，但 despite 后是名词 the rain，although 后是从句 it rained，句法不可混用。

advancedExpressions.expression: despite / in spite of / regardless of / notwithstanding + n.
advancedExpressions.example: 四个均为介词(短语)，后接名词性成分；表'尽管'时 despite 与 in spite of 可互换。

advancedExpressions.expression: despite ... , sb. pressed / soldiered on, determined to ...
advancedExpressions.example: Despite the numbing cold and his aching legs, he soldiered on through the snow, determined to reach the summit before the light failed. （介词短语前置+分词状语，续写坚持段）

advancedExpressions.expression: despite the ... , I am confident that, together, we can ...
advancedExpressions.example: Despite the limited funds at our disposal, I am confident that, together, we can turn this modest classroom into a warm and welcoming library. （让步开篇+呼吁团结，倡议信）

advancedExpressions.expression: despite ... , the truth remains that ...
advancedExpressions.example: Despite the dazzling convenience of modern technology, the truth remains that no screen can replace the warmth of a human hand.

sentenceUpgrade.original: Although it was raining, he kept running.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Despite the rain lashing at his face and the mud dragging at his shoes, he kept running, driven by a single thought: he would not let his team down. （读后续写·比赛·意志）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: despite 替代 although 使句子更凝练 + 现在分词并列(lashing...dragging) + 冒号引出内心独白强化动机

sentenceUpgrade.original: He was not clever, but he succeeded.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Despite an intellect far from remarkable, he carved out a life of quiet triumph — proof, if any were needed, that character often outweighs cleverness. （议论文·品格胜过才智）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: despite + 抽象名词短语 + 破折号插入评论(proof, if any were needed) + 对比(character...cleverness)提炼主旨

classPractice.question: Despite ____________________ (医生让他卧床), he still went to work.
classPractice.answer: the fact that the doctor asked him to lie in bed (all day)
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】考点:要接从句(主谓)须用 despite the fact that；despite 后不能直接跟句子

classPractice.question: Despite ____________________ (付出了全部努力), she still failed.
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】考点:despite 后接名词短语 all her efforts，不接从句

classPractice.question: Despite ____________________ (赢得了比赛), he remained humble.
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】考点:despite 后接动名词短语 winning the competition 表'尽管做了某事'

classPractice.question: ____ (尽管) an IQ of only 75, Forrest lives a truly amazing life.
classPractice.note: 考点:后接名词短语 an IQ of 75，用介词 Despite；不可用连词 Although(其后需接从句)。呼应课文原句

classPractice.question: ____ it was raining heavily, the match went on as planned. (Despite / Although)
classPractice.note: 考点:后接完整从句 it was raining，须用连词 Although；Despite 是介词不能接从句

classPractice.question: Although he was very tired, he kept working. → ____ his tiredness, he kept working. (用 despite)
classPractice.note: 考点:连词+从句 → 介词+名词的转换，although→despite 后须把从句改成名词 his tiredness

original_sentence: He sees, and sometimes influences, some of the major events of the United States in the second half of the 20th century.
readingExamples: He sees, and sometimes influences, some of the major events of the United States in the second half of the 20th century.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. very large or important, especially when compared with other things or people of a similar kind
(2) adj. very serious or dangerous
(3) n. a student's main subject or field of study (esp. AmE); v. to specialize in a subject at university
(4) n. an officer of middle rank in the army or air force

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 主要的，重要的（尤指与同类相比规模大、地位重要）
uncommonMeanings.example: The major events of the century reshaped the nation. 那个世纪的重大事件重塑了国家。（课文义）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 严重的，危险的（如疾病、手术）
uncommonMeanings.example: He underwent major surgery last winter. 去年冬天他做了一次大手术。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （大学的）主修专业；（v.）主修
uncommonMeanings.example: Standing at the crossroads of her future, she finally chose to major in medicine — not for the salary, but for the frail grandmother who had once needed a doctor and found none. （读后续写·选择·动机）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （军队）少校
uncommonMeanings.example: The old major, his chest heavy with medals, saluted the young recruits one last time, his eyes betraying a pride no words could hold. （读后续写·军旅·传承）

posExamples.sentence: The discovery of the hidden letter marked a major turning point in the story, unravelling secrets the family had guarded for three long generations. （读后续写·情节·转折）
I am writing to propose a major change to our recycling scheme, one that I believe could transform our school into a model of green living. （应用文·建议信）
One major reason so many students lose interest in reading is that they are forced to chase grades rather than encouraged to chase wonder. （议论文·阅读教育）
After months of hesitation, he decided to change his major from law to marine biology, drawn irresistibly by the silent mysteries of the deep. （读后续写·抉择·热爱）

wordForms.other: majority (n. 多数; 反义 minority); majorly (adv. 非正式:非常); 反义形容词 minor (次要的); 词族对立 major↔minor, majority↔minority

idioms.example: The major part of his childhood was spent by that quiet river, where he first learned to dream beyond the narrow horizon of his village. （读后续写·回忆·成长）

collocations.phrase: major (adj.) 主要的，重要的；重大的
collocations.translation: 比同类其他更重要／更大／更严重的【课件】
collocations.example: All of her major plays have been translated into English. 她所有主要的剧作都已被译成英语。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: ……的大部分（课件重点搭配）【课件】
collocations.example: The major part of a little baby's life is spent in sleeping. 小婴儿一生的大部分时间都在睡觉。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 主修课程，专业；某专业的学生；(动词)主修【课件】
collocations.example: What is your major, English or French? 你主修什么，英语还是法语？ Phoebe is a history major. 菲比是历史专业的学生。 Laura is majoring in physics. 劳拉主修物理。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 大多数……（谓语单复数依后接名词而定）【课件】
collocations.example: The majority of the population interviewed prefer TV to radio. 大多数接受采访的人都喜欢看电视多于听收音机。（课件原句）
In the nursing profession, women are in a/the majority. 女性在护理行业中占大多数。（课件原句）
She was elected by/with a majority of 749. 她以749票的多数票当选。 a clear (= large) majority 明显多数票。（课件原句）

collocations.phrase: the major events (of the United States)
collocations.translation: （美国的）重大事件（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: He sees, and sometimes influences, some of the major events of the United States in the second half of the 20th century. （课文原句：major 作形容词修饰 events）
She decided to major in medicine. 她决定主修医学。
He witnesses, and sometimes influences, some of the major events that shaped his nation in the second half of the century. （应用文·人物简介）
Encouragement from a single teacher can play a major role in awakening a talent the child never knew he possessed. （议论文·教育的力量）
Water shortage remains a major challenge for the region, one that demands the combined wisdom of scientists and citizens alike. （议论文·环境）
Moving to a new city brought about a major change in her outlook, teaching her that home is a feeling far more than a place. （读后续写·成长·感悟）
That rainy afternoon, when a stranger returned her lost wallet, became a major turning point that restored her faith in humanity. （读后续写·转折·温情）
The young scientist's persistence led to a major breakthrough that would save countless lives in the decades to come. （议论文·科研·坚持）
Learning to listen is a skill of major importance, yet one that our schools too often neglect. （议论文·沟通能力）

synonyms.example: That small act of kindness, seemingly trivial, would have a significant impact on the course of her entire life. （读后续写·细节·深远影响）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:significant 强调'意义重大、值得注意'，常搭配 impact/change/difference；major 更侧重'规模大、地位重要'，作定语可修饰 event/role/problem，二者常可互换但 major 更口语化

synonyms.example: The principal cause of the misunderstanding was not malice but a simple failure to communicate. （议论文·分析）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:principal 指'首要的、排第一位的'，强调在众多中居首、通常只作定语；major 强调'重要且规模大'，不一定是唯一最重要的

synonyms.example: In that crucial moment, when everyone else froze, it was the quietest boy who stepped forward. （读后续写·关键时刻·反转）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:crucial 强调'成败攸关、决定性'，语气最强，常搭 moment/role/step；major 只表'重要、大'，未必到生死攸关的程度

synonyms.example: It was only a minor problem, easily fixed. 那只是个小问题，轻松就解决了。
synonyms.usage: 反义辨析:minor 与 major 相对，表'次要的、不严重的、辅修的'(a minor injury/a minor role/minor in ...)；答题时注意 major↔minor 的对立

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·重要的(可替换 major)
advancedExpressions.expression: major / significant / crucial / vital / key + n.
advancedExpressions.example: 作定语表'重要的'时，a major role ≈ a significant role ≈ a crucial role ≈ a key role，可依语气强弱择用。

advancedExpressions.expression: major ↔ minor；majority ↔ minority
advancedExpressions.example: major(主要)—minor(次要)；名词 majority(多数)—minority(少数)，成对记忆。

advancedExpressions.expression: a major event / turning point / breakthrough；major in；of major importance
advancedExpressions.example: major in astronomy(主修天文)、a major turning point(重大转折)、of major importance(极其重要)。

advancedExpressions.expression: little did sb. know that ... would become a major turning point
advancedExpressions.example: Little did she know that this chance encounter on a crowded platform would become the major turning point of her life. （否定副词倒装+悬念，续写转折段）

advancedExpressions.expression: I am convinced that a major improvement lies in ...
advancedExpressions.example: I am convinced that a major improvement in our study environment lies not in grander facilities, but in a shared culture of quiet respect. （正式表态+对比强调，建议信）

advancedExpressions.expression: ... plays a major role in ... ; without it, ...
advancedExpressions.example: Perseverance plays a major role in every success story; without it, even the brightest talent withers into mere unfulfilled promise.

sentenceUpgrade.original: This event was very important to him.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: That single event, so easily overlooked at the time, proved to be a major landmark in his life — the invisible hinge on which his entire future would silently turn. （读后续写·回望·顿悟）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 插入语(so easily overlooked at the time)制造回望视角 + 破折号补充比喻(invisible hinge) + 抽象升华

sentenceUpgrade.original: Reading is a major part of learning.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Reading, far from being a mere pastime, plays a major part in the shaping of the mind, for every book we open is a new window flung wide upon the world. （议论文·阅读的价值）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 插入让步结构(far from being a mere pastime) + because从句说理 + 隐喻(window flung wide)形象论证

original_sentence: He sees, and sometimes influences, some of the major events of the United States in the second half of the 20th century.
readingExamples: He sees, and sometimes influences, some of the major events of the United States in the second half of the 20th century.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a thing that happens, especially something important, interesting or unusual
(2) n. a planned public or social occasion, such as a party, competition or celebration
(3) n. any of the races or competitions in a sports programme
(4) n. (in the phrase 'in the event of / in any event') a possible or actual situation or outcome

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （重要的）事件，大事
uncommonMeanings.example: The major events of the century were rarely announced in advance. 那个世纪的重大事件很少事先宣布。（课文义）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （有组织的）活动，社交/公共场合
uncommonMeanings.example: The charity event raised thousands of pounds. 那次慈善活动筹得数千英镑。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （体育）比赛项目
uncommonMeanings.example: The 800-metre was the one event she had trained for all year, and as she crouched at the starting line, the roar of the crowd faded into a single, steady heartbeat. （读后续写·赛场·专注）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （in the event / in any event）无论如何；结果
uncommonMeanings.example: We had feared the storm would ruin the ceremony, but in the event the skies cleared just as the first guest arrived. （读后续写·转折·天意）

posExamples.sentence: That summer's flood was an event none of the villagers would ever forget, for out of its muddy ruin grew a bond stronger than any they had known before. （读后续写·灾难·团结）
On behalf of the Student Union, I warmly invite you to attend our charity event this Saturday, where every ticket sold will bring warmth to a child in need. （应用文·邀请函）
History teaches us that great events are rarely the work of a single hero, but the quiet accumulation of countless ordinary acts of courage. （议论文·历史与个人）
He witnesses, and sometimes influences, some of the major events of the United States in the second half of the twentieth century. （读后续写·人物·时代）

wordForms.other: eventuality (n. 可能发生的事); 辨析 eventful(充满大事的)/eventual(最终的); in the event of(万一)/in any event(无论如何)固定短语

idioms.idiom: in any event / at all events
idioms.translation: 无论如何，不管怎样【课件】
idioms.example: In any event, I was not in a position to undertake such a task. 无论如何，我当时都不能承担这样一项任务。（课件原句）
The flight may be delayed; in that event, we will wait for you at the hotel. 航班可能延误；如果是那样的话，我们会在酒店等你。

idioms.translation: 万一……发生，如果……的话【课件】
idioms.example: He told his grandma to call him in the event of any accident. 他叮嘱奶奶，万一出任何意外就给他打电话。（课件原句）
It is easy to be wise after the event, but true wisdom lies in foreseeing the danger before it strikes. （议论文·远见）

collocations.translation: 发生或举行的事，尤指重要／有组织的活动【课件】
collocations.example: a fund-raising event 筹款活动；a three-day event 一个为期三天的活动；a social event 社交活动。（课件原句）

collocations.phrase: in any event / at all events
collocations.translation: 不管怎样，无论如何【课件】
collocations.example: In any event, I was not in a position to undertake such a task. 无论如何，我当时都不能承担这样一项任务。（课件原句）
The flight may be delayed; in that event, we will wait for you at the hotel. 航班可能延误；如果是那样的话，我们会在酒店等你。
He told his grandma to call him in the event of any accident. 他叮嘱奶奶，万一出任何意外就给他打电话。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 事后聪明（事后诸葛亮）【课件】
collocations.example: It is easy to be wise after the event, but few can foresee the danger before it strikes. 事后聪明谁都会，但少有人能在危险来临前预见它。

collocations.phrase: the major events (of the United States)
collocations.translation: （美国的）重大事件（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: He sees, and sometimes influences, some of the major events of the United States in the second half of the 20th century. （课文原句：event 作可数名词，指重大事件）

collocations.translation: 径赛／田赛项目（体育项目义）
collocations.example: The 100-metre sprint is her favourite track event. 一百米短跑是她最喜欢的径赛项目。
The school's centenary was such a big event that alumni flew in from every corner of the globe to celebrate. （应用文·活动报道）
Our club plans to host a fund-raising event next month, and we sincerely hope you will lend us your support. （应用文·倡议书）

collocations.phrase: attend / take part in an event
collocations.example: Hundreds of students eagerly took part in the tree-planting event, turning a barren hillside into a sea of tender green. （读后续写·公益·画面感）
The annual charity event has become a cherished tradition, weaving generosity into the very fabric of our school life. （应用文·活动介绍）
A single careless remark set off a chain of events that no one could have foreseen or undone. （读后续写·连锁反应·悬念）
Keeping abreast of current events broadens the mind and sharpens one's judgement of the wider world. （议论文·关注时事）

collocations.translation: 事态的发展，事件的进程
collocations.example: One brave decision that morning altered the entire course of events, sparing the town a tragedy it never learned it had escaped. （读后续写·关键抉择）

collocations.translation: 事态的转变，形势的变化
collocations.example: By a strange turn of events, the very rival she had feared became, in the end, her closest friend. （读后续写·反转·温情）

collocations.translation: 万一……发生，如果……的话（重点短语）
collocations.example: In the event of fire, use the stairs, not the lift. 万一失火，请走楼梯不要乘电梯。

synonyms.example: The graduation was a joyous occasion, one that mingled the sweetness of triumph with the quiet ache of farewell. （读后续写·毕业·复杂情感）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:occasion 强调'特定的、往往正式或有纪念意义的场合'，常搭 on this occasion；event 更泛，可指任何发生的事或有组织的活动

synonyms.translation: （尤指不寻常或不愉快的）事件
synonyms.example: The classroom fell silent as the teacher recounted the incident that had almost cost a life on the icy road. （读后续写·警示·氛围）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:incident 多指较小的、常带负面或意外色彩的事件；event 中性，且常指重大或有计划的活动

synonyms.translation: 发生的事情，事件（较正式）
synonyms.example: Power cuts were a common occurrence in the mountain village, yet the children learned to find magic in the candlelit dark. （读后续写·乡村·诗意）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:occurrence 较正式书面，强调'发生的事情'这一事实本身；event 更常用，且带'重要／有组织'的意味

advancedExpressions.expression: in the event of + n.(万一)；in any event(无论如何)；in the event(结果)
advancedExpressions.example: in the event of an emergency(万一有紧急情况)、in any event we must go(无论如何都要去)、in the event, all went well(结果一切顺利)。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·事件/活动(可替换 event)
advancedExpressions.expression: event / occasion / incident / occurrence + n.
advancedExpressions.example: 指'有组织的活动'用 event/occasion；指'意外小事件'用 incident；书面'发生的事'用 occurrence。

advancedExpressions.expression: a strange turn of events found sb. ...
advancedExpressions.example: A strange turn of events found her, only a year later, standing on the very stage she had once fled in tears. （无灵主语+对比命运，续写转折升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: on behalf of ... , I cordially invite you to this year's ... event, where ...
advancedExpressions.example: On behalf of the whole class, I cordially invite you to this year's Reading Festival event, where books and friendships bloom in equal measure. （正式套语+定语从句，邀请函）

advancedExpressions.expression: history shows that great events spring not from ... but from ...
advancedExpressions.example: History shows that great events spring not from the whim of a single ruler but from the awakened conscience of ordinary people.

sentenceUpgrade.original: The sports day was a big event for us.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The sports day was the one event we had counted down to for weeks, and when the starting gun finally cracked the morning air, months of quiet sweat and stubborn hope surged into a single, roaring instant. （读后续写·赛场·激情）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 定语从句(we had counted down to)蓄势 + 环境细节(cracked the morning air) + 抽象名词具象化(sweat and hope surged)

sentenceUpgrade.original: Many events happened that changed history.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The events that reshaped history were seldom trumpeted in advance; more often they crept in quietly, disguised as ordinary days, recognised for what they were only long after they had passed. （议论文·历史的偶然）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 定语从句(that reshaped history) + 分号连接对比 + 拟人(crept in quietly) + 时间状语延宕(only long after)引发思辨

original_sentence: The bus pulls up as Mrs Gump prepares Forrest for his first day of school.
readingExamples: The bus pulls up as Mrs Gump prepares Forrest for his first day of school.
definitionEn:
(1) phr. v. (of a vehicle or its driver) to stop, especially for a short time
(2) phr. v. to move your body upwards, especially by pulling with your arms
(3) phr. v. to bring or drag something into an upright or higher position
(4) phr. v. to tell someone that they have done something wrong; to check or correct sb.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 责备，纠正（某人）
