translation: vi. & vt. 挥手，招手；挥舞 | n. 海浪；大量涌现
original_sentence: Mrs Gump waves to Forrest as the bus drives away.
readingExamples: Mrs Gump waves to Forrest as the bus drives away.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a raised line of water that moves across the surface of the sea, especially when the wind blows
(2) n. a sudden increase in a particular type of behaviour, feeling, or activity; a large number of people or things arriving at the same time
(3) v. to raise your hand and move it from side to side as a greeting, farewell, or signal
(4) v. to move something held in your hand from side to side, or to move gently to and fro in the air

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 挥手，招手（打招呼、告别或示意）
uncommonMeanings.example: Mrs Gump waves to Forrest as the bus drives away. 格姆太太向坐车离去的福雷斯特挥手。（课文义）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 挥舞，摇动（手中之物或在空中摆动）
uncommonMeanings.example: The crowd waved flags as the team marched past. 队伍走过时人群挥舞旗帜。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 海浪，波浪
uncommonMeanings.example: Towering waves crashed against the rocks. 滔天巨浪拍打着礁石。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （情绪、活动、事物的）浪潮，热潮，一阵
uncommonMeanings.example: A wave of unexpected tenderness washed over her as she watched her son, now a grown man, sleep as peacefully as he had done as a child. （读后续写·亲情·情感涌动）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （无线电、声、光等的）波
uncommonMeanings.example: The rescuers sent radio waves crackling across the frozen valley, praying that somewhere in the white silence someone was still listening. （读后续写·救援·科技细节）

posExamples.sentence: As the train pulled away, my grandmother stood on the platform and waved until her small figure was swallowed by the crowd, yet I could still feel her love reaching after me. （读后续写·离别·目送）
On behalf of the whole school, I sincerely invite you to wave our banners high at the sports meeting and cheer our athletes on with unfailing enthusiasm. （应用文·邀请信·运动会）
A wave of environmental awareness is sweeping across our campus, inspiring students to abandon disposable cups and embrace a greener way of living. （议论文·环保·社会趋势）
Towering waves crashed against the rocks as the tiny fishing boat fought its way home, and I clung to the rail, both terrified and strangely exhilarated. （读后续写·海上历险·环境描写）

wordForms.other: waver (vi. 摇曳；动摇); waveform (n. 波形); wavy (adj. 波浪形的、卷曲的); 一词多义:n.海浪/浪潮/波; v.挥手/挥舞

idioms.example: When the factory closed, hundreds of workers had to wave goodbye to the only livelihood they had ever known. （议论文·社会·失业）

idioms.translation: 兴风作浪；制造麻烦；引起轰动
idioms.example: The young journalist was warned not to make waves, but she knew that some truths were worth every ounce of the trouble they caused. （议论文/读后续写·勇气·坚持真相）

collocations.translation: 向某人挥手（打招呼或示意）【课件】

collocations.translation: 挥动、挥舞手中之物【课件】

collocations.example: The whole family came to the platform to wave him off. 全家人都来到站台为他送行挥别。（课件原句义）

collocations.example: The grief comes over me in waves. 悲伤阵阵袭来。 When hearing some strange sound in the dark, she felt a wave of fear sweeping over her. 在黑暗中听到怪声，她感到一阵恐惧涌上心头。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 引起轰动；兴风作浪【课件】
collocations.example: Three hundred employees lost their jobs in the latest wave of unemployment. （wave 表'浪潮'）；The young reformer was not afraid to make waves. 这位年轻的改革者不怕引起轰动。（课件原句义）

collocations.translation: 向福雷斯特挥手（课文原句词块）

collocations.phrase: a wave of + 情绪/事物

collocations.phrase: wave sb goodbye / wave goodbye to sb
collocations.example: We waved the volunteers goodbye at dawn, knowing that the memories of that summer would bind us together for years to come. （读后续写·分别·友情）

He waved his arms wildly above the swaying grass, desperate to catch the attention of the search helicopter overhead. （读后续写·求救·动作）
By riding the wave of renewed interest in traditional crafts, the old artisan finally found the recognition he had long deserved. （议论文·文化·机遇）

collocations.translation: 把（意见、担忧等）置之不理；挥手示意走开
collocations.example: The captain waved aside our fears with a confident smile, assuring us that he had weathered far worse storms than this. （读后续写·危机·领袖气度）

advancedExpressions.expression: a wave of ... washed / swept over sb

original_sentence: You know, it's funny what a young man recollects.
readingExamples: You know, it's funny what a young man recollects.
definitionEn:
(1) vt. & vi. to remember something, especially by making an effort to do so
(2) vt. to bring an image, event, or fact back into your mind after a period of forgetting
(3) vi. to call past experiences to mind, often in a reflective or nostalgic way

uncommonMeanings.meaning: recollection 回忆，记忆；记忆力（课件重点名词）【课件】
uncommonMeanings.example: I have no recollection of meeting her before. 我不记得以前见过她。 have a clear/vivid recollection of sth 对某事的记忆清晰／历历在目。（课件原句）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 记起，回忆起（尤指努力去想）
uncommonMeanings.example: It's funny what a young man recollects. 有趣的是一个年轻人能记起些什么。（课文义）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 使镇定，使（自己）恢复镇静（recollect oneself）
uncommonMeanings.example: For a moment she stood frozen with shock; then, recollecting herself, she straightened her shoulders and walked calmly towards the waiting examiners. （读后续写·临场·恢复镇定）

posExamples.sentence: Sitting by the fading firelight, the old sailor recollected the storms he had survived, and his weathered face softened with a strange, wistful pride. （读后续写·回忆·人物刻画）
As I write this letter, I recollect with deep gratitude the countless evenings you spent patiently helping me with my English, and I owe my success to your kindness. （应用文·感谢信·回忆恩师）
When we pause to recollect, we often discover that the moments which shaped us most were not the grand triumphs but the small, quiet acts of love we once overlooked. （议论文·成长·人生反思）
Try as he might, the boy could not recollect where he had last seen his grandfather's watch, and a cold dread began to creep up his spine. （读后续写·遗失·心理）

wordForms.other: 构词法:re-(重新、再)+collect(收集)→'重新收集(记忆碎片)'→回忆; 名词 recollection(回忆); 熟词僻义 recollect oneself(使自己镇定)

collocations.translation: recollect 的名词形式（= the ability to remember）【课件】
collocations.example: I have no recollection of meeting her before. 我不记得以前见过她。 To the best of my recollection, I was not present at that meeting. 如果我没记错的话，我没有出席那次会议。 have a clear/vivid recollection of sth 对某事的记忆清晰／历历在目。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 一个年轻人记起的东西（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: You know, it's funny what a young man recollects. （课文原句：recollect 作及物动词，宾语为 what 从句）
I distinctly recollect promising my dying mother that I would care for my little sister. 我清楚地记得曾答应临终的母亲照顾妹妹。

collocations.translation: 使自己镇定下来（熟词僻义）
collocations.example: He took a deep breath, recollected himself, and stepped onto the stage. 他深吸一口气，稳住心神，走上了舞台。

collocations.phrase: as far as I can recollect
collocations.example: As far as I can recollect, it was on that very bench that we first shared our dreams of travelling the world together. （读后续写·回忆·友情）
Even now, I can vividly recollect the smell of my grandmother's kitchen and the warmth of her flour-dusted hands. （读后续写·回忆·感官细节）
Only later did she recollect that the kind stranger had never once asked for her name in return. （读后续写·善意·后知后觉）
If I recollect rightly, the annual charity fair was your idea in the first place, and it has since helped hundreds of children. （应用文·信件·委婉肯定）

synonyms.example: I still recall the exact moment my name was called out as the winner. 我仍记得名字被念出宣布我获胜的那一刻。
synonyms.usage: 语义差别:recall 更常用、更中性，回忆常直接浮现；recollect 更书面、更强调'努力去想'和怀旧色彩。二者句法相近，均可接 doing/that 从句/名词

synonyms.example: The old friends sat late into the night, reminiscing about the reckless adventures of their youth. （读后续写·老友·怀旧）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别+句法:特指愉快地、絮絮地'追忆往昔'，多用于口头畅谈美好回忆，常作不及物 reminisce about sth；recollect 侧重把某事想起来这一动作，可及物

synonyms.example: I will always remember the day you believed in me when no one else would. （读后续写·感恩·回忆）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别:最普通、最口语的'记得'，可指自然记起或牢记不忘；recollect 更正式、更强调主动追忆的过程

advancedExpressions.expression: re-(再)+ collect(收集)= recollect(把记忆重新收集起来→回忆)
advancedExpressions.example: 同理:re-(再)+ call(呼喊)= recall(把记忆再唤回→回忆)；借构词理解 recollect/recall 的记忆义。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·回忆(可替换 recollect)
advancedExpressions.expression: recollect / recall / remember / reminisce about / call to mind
advancedExpressions.example: 书面追忆用 recollect/recall；口语用 remember；畅谈往昔用 reminisce about。

advancedExpressions.expression: as sb recollected ..., the years seemed to melt away
advancedExpressions.example: As she recollected the summers of her childhood, the long grey years seemed to melt away, and once more she was a barefoot girl running through the golden wheat. （回忆过渡 + 时间拟人"melt away" + 具象闪回，续写倒叙）

advancedExpressions.expression: I recollect with gratitude ...
advancedExpressions.example: I recollect with heartfelt gratitude the many teachers who shaped who I am today. （"recollect with + 情感名词"，感谢信/毕业致辞正式开头）

advancedExpressions.expression: when we recollect ..., we come to realise that ...
advancedExpressions.example: When we recollect the sacrifices of previous generations, we come to realise that the comforts we take for granted were paid for in courage and toil. （"when we recollect...we realise"引出反思结论，议论文说理）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He remembered his happy childhood.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: As he sat alone in the darkening room, he recollected the sunlit afternoons of his childhood — the laughter, the scraped knees, the endless summers that had once seemed as though they would never end. （读后续写·怀旧·细节堆叠）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: recollect 替换 remember 增文学感 + 破折号引出细节列举 + 三重意象(laughter, scraped knees, summers) + 用"never end"反衬时光流逝

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should think about the past.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is only when we pause to recollect the road we have travelled that we can truly appreciate how far we have come and how much we owe to those who walked beside us. （议论文·感恩·文体升级）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: it is only when...that 强调句 + recollect the road we have travelled 隐喻人生 + 两个 how 引导的宾语从句递进 + 收尾点出"感恩他人"主题

classPractice.question: You know, it's funny what a young man ____ (recollect) about his childhood.
classPractice.note: 考点:主语 a young man 第三人称单数，一般现在时用 recollects。呼应课文原句

classPractice.question: 我清楚地记得曾答应过母亲照顾妹妹。 I clearly ____ ____ my mother that I would look after my sister.
classPractice.note: 考点:recollect doing sth '记得做过某事'，后接动名词而非不定式

classPractice.question: The old friends sat up all night ____ about their carefree school days. (recollecting / reminiscing)
classPractice.note: 考点:'畅谈怀念往昔'用不及物的 reminisce about；recollect 侧重'把某事想起来'，此处搭配 about 且强调闲谈追忆更宜用 reminiscing

original_sentence: I don't recall what I got for my first Christmas and I don't know when I went on my first outdoor picnic.
readingExamples: I don't recall what I got for my first Christmas and I don't know when I went on my first outdoor picnic.
definitionEn:
(1) vt. & vi. to bring the memory of a past event into your mind; to remember something
(2) vt. to order someone to return, or to order a product to be returned (e.g. because of a fault)
(3) vt. to make you think of something because of a similarity; to be reminiscent of
(4) n. the ability to remember things; an act of officially ordering someone or something back

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 回忆，记忆（recollection）；记忆力（课件拓展名词）【课件】
uncommonMeanings.example: I have no recollection of meeting her before. 我不记得以前见过她。 To the best of my recollection, I was not present at that meeting. 如果我没记错的话，我没有出席那次会议。（课件原句）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 回想，回忆起（把往事带回脑海，常需一点努力）
uncommonMeanings.example: I don't recall what I got for my first Christmas. 我不记得第一个圣诞节收到了什么。（课文义）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 召回（有缺陷的产品）；召回（人员，如大使、议员）
uncommonMeanings.example: The company was forced to recall thousands of faulty heaters, and its once-spotless reputation crumbled overnight. （议论文·企业·诚信危机）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 使人想起，使人联想到（因相似）
uncommonMeanings.example: As the familiar melody drifted from the old radio, it recalled to her a face she had spent twenty years trying to forget. （读后续写·睹物思人·情感）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 记忆力，回想的能力；召回
uncommonMeanings.example: Her powers of recall were so extraordinary that she could recite, word for word, letters she had read a decade ago. （读后续写·天赋·人物特写）

posExamples.sentence: Even after all these years, I can still recall the trembling of my voice and the pounding of my heart the first time I stood before a crowd. （读后续写·第一次·紧张回忆）
I am writing to recall the wonderful days our exchange group spent in your city, and to express, on behalf of us all, our deepest thanks for your warm hospitality. （应用文·感谢信·回顾行程）
History teaches us a lesson we would do well to recall: that arrogance, however dazzling, has always been the prelude to a fall. （议论文·历史·警示）
As the familiar melody drifted from the old radio, it recalled to her a face she had spent twenty years trying, and failing, to forget. （读后续写·睹物思人·情感）

wordForms.other: 构词法:re-(再、回)+call(呼喊)→'把记忆再唤回'→回忆; 一词多义 v.回忆/召回(产品、人员)/使人想起, n.记忆力/召回; recall doing(记得做过) vs. remember to do(记得去做)

idioms.example: By the time he understood how deeply he had wounded her, the friendship was already beyond recall, lost like a letter thrown into the sea. （读后续写·遗憾·无法挽回）

collocations.translation: 记得做过某事（后接动名词，动作已发生）【课件】
collocations.example: I don't recall seeing any cars parked outside. 我不记得看到外面停过什么车。（课件原句）
He recalled that she always came home late on Wednesdays. 他回想起她周三总是很晚才回家。（课件原句）
I can't recall who gave me the information. 我记不起是谁把这个消息告诉我的。 I seem to recall I've met him before somewhere. 我似乎记得以前在哪儿见过他。（课件原句）

collocations.phrase: I don't recall what I got
collocations.translation: 我不记得我得到了什么（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: I don't recall what I got for my first Christmas and I don't know when I went on my first outdoor picnic. （课文原句：recall 作及物动词，接 what 从句）

collocations.translation: 记得做过某事（重点搭配，接动名词）
collocations.example: I clearly recall telling him to be careful, yet the reckless boy paid me no heed. （读后续写·后悔·回忆）

collocations.phrase: recall a product / recall faulty cars
collocations.translation: 召回产品（熟词僻义:召回）
collocations.example: The company was forced to recall thousands of faulty heaters. 公司被迫召回数千台有缺陷的取暖器。

collocations.phrase: as I recall / if I recall correctly
collocations.translation: 据我回忆；如果我没记错
collocations.example: As I recall, it was a stormy night in October when the stranger first knocked upon our door. （读后续写·开篇·设置背景）
The scent of jasmine instantly recalled to mind the little courtyard where I had grown up. （读后续写·嗅觉·闪回）
I faintly recall a lullaby my mother used to hum, though the words have long since slipped away. （读后续写·童年·朦胧记忆）
Years of training had sharpened her powers of recall to a razor's edge. （读后续写·天赋·人物）

collocations.translation: 把某人召回；使某人回想起
collocations.example: The sharp cry recalled him to the present, and he snapped out of his daydream at once. （读后续写·回神·细节）
Some opportunities, once let slip, are gone beyond recall. （议论文·珍惜·警句）

collocations.phrase: have no recollection of sth / doing sth
collocations.translation: 完全不记得某事（名词 recollection）【课件】
collocations.example: I have no recollection of meeting her before. 我不记得以前见过她。（课件原句）

collocations.phrase: to the best of my recollection
collocations.translation: 如果我没记错的话（= if I recall correctly）【课件】
collocations.example: To the best of my recollection, I was not present at that meeting. 如果我没记错的话，我没有出席那次会议。（课件原句）

collocations.phrase: have a clear/vivid recollection of sth
collocations.translation: 对某事的记忆清晰／历历在目【课件】
collocations.example: She has a vivid recollection of the day she first stepped onto the stage. 她对第一次登台的那天记忆清晰。（课件原句义）

synonyms.example: Sitting by the window, she recollected the summers she had once spent by the sea. （读后续写·怀旧·回忆）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别:recollect 更正式、更文学，强调'努力去想、带怀旧色彩'；recall 更常用、更中性，句法均可接 doing/that 从句/名词。近义高频辨析对

synonyms.example: I will always remember the kindness you showed me on that cold winter's night. （读后续写·感恩·回忆）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别:最普通的'记得'，既可自然记起也可牢记；recall 更强调'回想、检索出'这一过程，常需一点努力

synonyms.translation: 唤起，使人想起（情感、记忆）
synonyms.example: The faded photograph evoked a flood of memories she thought she had buried forever. （读后续写·睹物·情感）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别+句法位置:evoke 指某物'唤起'记忆或情感，主语常是物；recall 主语多为人(也可指物'使人想起')，evoke 情感色彩更浓

advancedExpressions.expression: re-(再、回)+ call(呼喊)= recall(把记忆再唤回→回忆；把人/物召回)
advancedExpressions.example: 同源 recollect = re-(再)+ collect(收集)，都含'把过去的东西再拿回来'之意，一起记。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·recall doing vs. remember to do
advancedExpressions.expression: recall/remember doing sth(记得做过) ≠ remember to do sth(记得去做)
advancedExpressions.example: I recall meeting him(记得见过他，已发生) vs. Remember to lock the door(记得去锁门，未做)。recall 只接已发生的 doing。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·回忆(可替换 recall)
advancedExpressions.expression: recall / recollect / remember / bring/call to mind / look back on
advancedExpressions.example: 书面回忆用 recall/recollect；口语 remember；'回顾'用 look back on。

advancedExpressions.expression: even now, I can still recall ...
advancedExpressions.example: Even now, I can still recall the exact weight of his hand on my shoulder and the quiet certainty in his voice. （"even now, I can still recall"倒叙开篇 + 具体感官细节，续写回忆框架）

advancedExpressions.expression: I write to recall ... and to thank you for ...
advancedExpressions.example: I write to recall the unforgettable days of our summer camp and to thank you, most sincerely, for making them possible. （"recall...and thank"双目的并列，感谢信正式开头）

advancedExpressions.expression: we would do well to recall that ...
advancedExpressions.example: We would do well to recall that every great civilisation was built not on convenience but on sacrifice and perseverance. （"we would do well to recall that"委婉劝诫句式，议论文引历史立论）

sentenceUpgrade.original: I remember the day I won the prize.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: To this day I can vividly recall the moment my name echoed through the hall — the disbelief, the roar of applause, and the sudden, dizzying realisation that all those sleepless nights had finally been worth it. （读后续写·高光时刻·细节+心理）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: recall 替换 remember + 破折号引出三重反应(disbelief, applause, realisation) + 感官化(echoed, roar) + 用"sleepless nights"回扣前文努力

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should learn from history.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: If we pause to recall the hard-won lessons of history, we will find in them a compass reliable enough to guide us through even the darkest of times. （议论文·以史为鉴·文体升级）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: recall the lessons of history 使论点厚重 + 隐喻(a compass) + even the darkest of times 极端情境强化 + "if...we will find"条件推理结构

original_sentence: I had never seen anything so beautiful in my life. She was like an angel.
readingExamples: I had never seen anything so beautiful in my life. She was like an angel.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a spiritual being believed to be a servant or messenger of God, usually represented with wings and dressed in white
(2) n. a person who is very kind, good, or beautiful, or who behaves in a way that shows great goodness
(3) n. (informal) a term of endearment used to address someone you love or feel tenderly towards

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （投资领域）天使投资人；出资赞助者
uncommonMeanings.example: The struggling drama club would never have staged its play at all had a generous angel not quietly covered the cost of the costumes and lights. （读后续写·善举·幕后资助）

posExamples.sentence: When the nurse gently wiped my fevered brow at three in the morning, she seemed less like an ordinary stranger and more like an angel sent to watch over me. （读后续写·善良·陌生人）
On behalf of our class, I wish to thank the volunteer teachers who came to our remote village — to us, these selfless souls were nothing short of angels. （应用文·感谢信·支教）
True kindness never demands a stage or an audience; the real angels among us are those who do good quietly, expecting nothing in return. （议论文·善良·论证）
'Sleep now, my little angel,' Mother whispered, tucking the worn blanket around the trembling child as the storm raged on outside. （读后续写·亲情·温情称呼）

wordForms.other: 【拼写辨析·易混词】angel /ˈeɪndʒl/ n. 天使 ≠ angle /ˈæŋɡl/ n. 角度，角（如 a right angle 直角）——两词只差一个字母顺序，读音也不同(dʒ vs. ɡ)，高考默写/改错常故意设坑，务必看清

idioms.idiom: be on the side of the angels
idioms.example: Whatever the cost, she was determined to remain on the side of the angels, defending the weak even when it made her powerful enemies. （议论文/读后续写·正义·坚守）
Looking back, I realise that old librarian had been my guardian angel, quietly steering me towards books that would change my life. （读后续写·恩人·感恩）

idioms.idiom: fools rush in where angels fear to tread
idioms.translation: 初生牛犊不怕虎；愚者敢闯智者所惧之地
idioms.example: Fools rush in where angels fear to tread, and it was his very recklessness, oddly enough, that led him to a discovery no cautious man would ever have made. （议论文·勇气与鲁莽·辩证）

collocations.translation: 像天使一样（课文原句：She was like an angel.）
collocations.example: She was like an angel, and the whole room fell silent. （课文原句词块，比喻美好善良）

collocations.translation: 一位天使；一个善良/美丽的人
collocations.example: To the lost child, the kind stranger seemed an angel. （比喻善良之人）
That old teacher was my guardian angel. （守护、庇佑之人）

collocations.translation: 救苦救难的天使（常指护士/救助者）
collocations.example: To the wounded soldiers, the young nurse was an angel of mercy, her gentle hands the only comfort in a world of pain. （读后续写·战地·救助）

collocations.translation: 你真是个大好人（表感谢）
collocations.example: 'You're an angel,' she breathed, clutching the umbrella the stranger had pressed into her hands before vanishing into the rain. （读后续写·善意·感激）
Behind that angelic smile, however, lay a will of iron that no obstacle could ever bend. （读后续写·人物·反差刻画）
The teacher called each child her 'little angel', and under such tender words even the naughtiest boy began to behave. （读后续写·校园·温情）

collocations.phrase: as patient / good as an angel
collocations.translation: 像天使一样有耐心/善良
collocations.example: My grandmother was as patient as an angel, never once raising her voice in all the years she raised us. （读后续写·长辈·品格）

synonyms.example: You would need the patience of a saint to teach such a restless class, yet she never once lost her temper. （读后续写·师德·耐心）
synonyms.usage: 指品德近乎完美、极有耐心与美德的人，语气比 angel 更强调道德崇高；angel 更侧重善良、美丽或可爱

synonyms.example: The orphanage owed its very survival to an anonymous benefactor who asked for nothing in return. （议论文·慈善·无私）
synonyms.usage: 特指出钱出力帮助他人的"恩人/资助者"，正式、书面；angel 情感色彩更浓，可泛指任何善良之人

synonyms.example: 'Come here, my darling,' she said, opening her arms to the frightened child. （读后续写·亲情·爱称）
synonyms.usage: 作爱称时与 angel 类似，但 darling 更普通、更口语；angel 作爱称时带有"纯洁美好"的额外意味

advancedExpressions.expression: like an angel / a guardian angel / an angel of mercy / you're an angel
advancedExpressions.example: She sang like an angel; to me she was a guardian angel, an angel of mercy who never asked for thanks. （angel 常见短语群，喻善良/美丽/守护/感谢）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·夸人善良美好
advancedExpressions.expression: an angel ≈ a saint（品德崇高）≈ a benefactor（出钱出力的恩人）
advancedExpressions.example: To us she was an angel; some called her a saint, others a benefactor — all agreed she asked nothing in return. （只枚举可替换的"善人"表达）

advancedExpressions.expression: angel(n.) → angelic(adj. 天使般的) → angelically(adv.)
advancedExpressions.example: Her angelically patient reply melted his anger at once. （名词→形容词→副词词族链）

advancedExpressions.expression: sb. seemed less like ... and more like an angel ...
advancedExpressions.example: In that moment she seemed less like a weary stranger and more like an angel who had wandered, by some miracle, into my hour of greatest need. （"less like...more like an angel"比较结构美化人物 + 定语从句渲染，续写升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: to us, ... were nothing short of angels
advancedExpressions.example: To every child in our village, those volunteer doctors were nothing short of angels. （"nothing short of angels"强调式赞美，感谢信/表彰致辞）

advancedExpressions.expression: the true angels among us are those who ...
advancedExpressions.example: The true angels among us are not those who preach virtue from a distance, but those who practise it quietly, day after unnoticed day. （"the true angels are those who...not...but..."对比下定义，议论文点题）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The kind woman helped me and I was grateful.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The moment that gentle woman knelt to bandage my bleeding knee, I felt as though an angel had descended into the grey city street, and a warmth I had almost forgotten flooded quietly back into my heart. （读后续写·善意·比喻+情感）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 把好心人比作 angel descended + "the moment"引导时间状语聚焦画面 + as though 虚拟增文学感 + "warmth flooded back"具象化感激

sentenceUpgrade.original: Good people help others without wanting anything back.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The truest angels of this world ask for no reward and seek no applause; they simply do good in silence, and in doing so remind us of the quiet nobility of which humanity is capable. （议论文·善良·文体升级）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: angels 隐喻善良之人 + 排比否定(ask for no...seek no...) + 分号并列 + "in doing so"引出升华 + 抽象名词"nobility"拔高立意

classPractice.question: The nurse looked after every patient so gently that to us she was ____ (真正的天使) — nothing short of an angel.
classPractice.note: 考 an angel 冠词与"善人"比喻用法；单数可数名词前需加冠词

classPractice.question: 拼写辨析：Draw a right ____ (angel / angle) of 90 degrees, then colour the little ____ (angel / angle) on the Christmas card. 依次填。
classPractice.note: 熟词易混：angle=角度(几何/方向)，angel=天使；顺序与读音都不同，高考改错爱设坑

classPractice.question: 在我最黑暗的一年里，姐姐就是我的守护天使。 During my darkest year, my elder sister was ____ ____ ____ to me.

original_sentence: My legs are just fine and dandy.
readingExamples: My legs are just fine and dandy.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. (informal, especially American English) very good; excellent; fine
(2) n. a man who is excessively concerned about his clothes and appearance; a fop
(3) adj. (dated) stylish or smart in a showy way

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 过分讲究衣着的男子，花花公子，纨绔子弟
uncommonMeanings.example: He arrived at the village fair dressed like a London dandy, his silk waistcoat and polished cane drawing amused stares from every weather-beaten farmer present. （读后续写·人物出场·反差）

posExamples.sentence: 'Everything's just fine and dandy,' the old man insisted with a brave grin, though the tremor in his hands told a very different story. （读后续写·倔强·言不由衷）
The picnic spot you recommended turned out to be absolutely dandy — sunny, sheltered and blissfully quiet — and the whole class thanks you for the wonderful suggestion. （应用文·感谢信·活动反馈）
To claim that everything in modern life is fine and dandy is to ignore, rather conveniently, the quiet anxieties gnawing beneath our polished surfaces. （议论文·批判·反讽）
Once the town's most celebrated dandy, he now sat alone in a threadbare coat, and I could not help wondering what cruel turn of fate had brought him so low. （读后续写·今昔对比·怜悯）

wordForms.other: dandyish (adj. 纨绔子弟般的)

idioms.translation: 好得很，一切都好（有时含反讽，表示"表面没事"）
idioms.example: 'Everything's fine and dandy,' she said breezily, but her forced smile and restless fingers betrayed a heart in turmoil. （读后续写·强颜欢笑·心口不一）

collocations.translation: 好得很，一切都好（课文原句：My legs are just fine and dandy.）
collocations.example: My legs are just fine and dandy. （课文原句词块，口语·表"没问题、挺好"）

collocations.translation: 好极了（口语，有时反讽表示"糟透了"）
collocations.example: 'Just dandy,' he muttered as the rain soaked his last dry shirt. （口语·常带反讽）

collocations.translation: 一个十足的花花公子；一件极好的东西
collocations.example: The vintage watch his grandfather left him was a real dandy, and he treasured it above every other possession. （读后续写·传家宝·珍视）
Dressed like a dandy from head to toe, the newcomer strutted into the classroom, utterly oblivious to the giggles rippling behind him. （读后续写·出场·喜剧感）

synonyms.example: The teacher praised her essay as excellent, singling out its vivid detail and heartfelt sincerity. （应用文/读后续写·评价·褒扬）
synonyms.usage: 正式、通用的"极好"，适用于书面与口语各种场合；dandy 是非正式、偏口语的美式说法，且带轻松或反讽色彩，正式写作慎用

synonyms.example: What a splendid idea it was to hold the reunion by the lake where we had all grown up! （应用文·感叹·赞美）
synonyms.usage: 比 dandy 更正式、更有感情色彩，常用于赞叹主意、景色、成就；dandy 更随意、口语化

synonyms.translation: （作名词）过分讲究衣着的男人，花花公子
synonyms.example: The vain young fop spent more on cravats and cologne than on books, and it showed in his empty conversation. （读后续写·人物·讽刺）
synonyms.usage: 作名词时与 dandy 同义，都指爱打扮、虚荣的男子，fop 贬义更重、更古旧；dandy 有时可略带欣赏或中性描述

advancedExpressions.expression: fine and dandy / just dandy（口语·好得很，常反讽）
advancedExpressions.example: 'Fine and dandy,' he said with a shrug, but his eyes said otherwise. （dandy 最常用于固定短语，非正式口语色彩浓）

advancedExpressions.expression: dandy(口语,美式) ≈ excellent（通用正式）≈ splendid（更有感情，赞叹）
advancedExpressions.example: The plan turned out dandy — or, more formally, excellent, even splendid. （只枚举可替换的"极好"表达，注意语体差异）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·dandy 的口语反讽
advancedExpressions.expression: '... fine and dandy,' sb. said, but ...（言语与真相相反）
advancedExpressions.example: 'Everything's fine and dandy,' she said breezily, but her forced smile betrayed a heart in turmoil. （fine and dandy + but 反转，续写心理刻画常用）

advancedExpressions.expression: '... fine and dandy,' sb. said, but ...
advancedExpressions.example: 'Everything's fine and dandy,' he said with a shrug, but the way his gaze dropped to the floor gave the lie to every cheerful word. （"fine and dandy"+ but 反转揭示真实内心，续写心理刻画）

advancedExpressions.expression: ... turned out just dandy, and we are grateful for ...
advancedExpressions.example: The venue you arranged turned out just dandy, and we are truly grateful for all the thought you put into it. （轻松口吻的正向反馈，非正式感谢信/便条）

advancedExpressions.expression: to pretend everything is fine and dandy is to ...
advancedExpressions.example: To pretend that everything is fine and dandy while ignoring the cracks beneath the surface is neither honesty nor optimism, but mere self-deception. （"to pretend...is to..."下定义 + 反讽用 fine and dandy 揭示回避问题，议论文批判）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He said he was fine but he was not.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: 'I'm just fine and dandy,' he insisted with a wave of his hand, yet the hollow cheer in his voice and the shadow behind his eyes betrayed a grief he was too proud to name. （读后续写·强撑·心理反差）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 直接引语 fine and dandy 增口语真实感 + with a wave of his hand 动作细节 + yet 转折 + "hollow cheer""shadow behind his eyes"意象揭示真实情绪 + "too proud to name"点明性格

sentenceUpgrade.original: Not everything in life is perfect.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is comforting, no doubt, to tell ourselves that everything is fine and dandy; yet genuine progress begins only when we find the courage to face the flaws we would rather not see. （议论文·直面问题·文体升级）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 反讽引用 fine and dandy + "it is comforting to...yet..."让步转折 + "genuine progress begins only when"强调句式 + "flaws we would rather not see"收尾点题，逻辑递进

classPractice.note: 考课文原句短语 fine and dandy（口语·一切都好）

classPractice.note: 考熟词僻义与语体：dandy 非正式/口语/常反讽，正式写作用 excellent

original_sentence: My momma said my back's crooked like a question mark.
readingExamples: My momma said my back's crooked like a question mark.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. bent or twisted, not straight or level
(2) adj. (of a person's back or limbs) curved out of the normal shape
(3) adj. (informal) dishonest, especially involving illegal or unfair dealings
(4) adj. not properly positioned; hanging or set at an uneven angle

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 不诚实的，不正直的，欺诈的（熟词僻义·高考爱考；常指涉及违法牟利的腐败）
uncommonMeanings.example: The crooked official was pocketing the relief funds, yet no one dared speak. （熟词僻义·由"弯曲"引申为"不正"）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （人的背/肢体）佝偻的，变形弯曲的（课文原句：My momma said my back's crooked like a question mark.）
uncommonMeanings.example: His back was crooked like a question mark. （课文原句义·身体弯曲）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （东西）没摆正的，挂歪了的，歪斜的
uncommonMeanings.example: The framed photograph on the wall hung slightly crooked. （位置不正）

posExamples.sentence: The old fisherman's fingers, crooked and gnarled from decades of hauling nets in the biting wind, trembled as he tied the last knot and pushed the little boat toward the open sea. （读后续写·人物刻画）
As you follow the crooked path winding up the hillside, please stay behind the wooden railings, for the loose stones near the cliff edge can be dangerous after rain. （应用文·参观须知）
A crooked ruler can never draw a straight line; likewise, a society built on dishonest dealings can hardly nurture citizens of integrity. （议论文·诚信主题）
She noticed that the framed photograph on the wall hung slightly crooked, and something about that small imperfection made the abandoned house feel achingly human. （读后续写·环境烘托）

wordForms.other: crook (n. 弯曲部位；<非正式>骗子，无赖) ；【发音提示】形容词 crooked 读双音节 /ˈkrʊkɪd/(-ed 发/ɪd/)，与动词 crook 的过去式 crooked /krʊkt/ 不同

collocations.translation: 弯得像个问号（课文原句：My momma said my back's crooked like a question mark.）
collocations.example: My back's crooked like a question mark. （课文原句词块，形容背弯曲）
Years of bending over the loom had left the weaver with a crooked back. （身体弯曲）

collocations.translation: 不正当的交易，欺诈的生意（熟词僻义·不诚实）
collocations.example: The company's crooked dealings finally came to light. （"不诚实"义搭配）

collocations.translation: 贪官，腐败的官员（熟词僻义）
collocations.example: The crooked official was finally brought to justice. （"不诚实/腐败"义）

collocations.translation: 歪斜的微笑（往往带点玩世不恭或羞涩）
collocations.example: He gave her a crooked smile, half apology and half mischief, and she found her anger melting away despite herself. （读后续写·情感转折）
The crooked path through the misty woods seemed to lead nowhere, yet Grandpa walked it with the calm certainty of a man who had come this way a thousand times. （读后续写·祖孙同行）
As a child she had hidden her crooked teeth behind her hand, but the day she won the debate, she smiled so widely that no one thought to look. （读后续写·自信成长）
The banner they had spent all morning putting up hung crooked in the breeze, and the whole team burst into laughter instead of frustration. （读后续写·集体活动）
With crooked fingers she pointed to a faded photograph on the mantelpiece, and her voice grew soft as the memories came flooding back. （读后续写·老人回忆）
The toddler proudly held up a page of crooked lines and swore it was a picture of the whole family. （读后续写·童真温情）

synonyms.example: The bent nail refused to go into the wood no matter how hard he hammered. （读后续写·劳作细节）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:bent 强调被外力弄弯的具体物体,较口语;crooked 更强调不直、歪斜的整体形态,且可引申为不诚实,bent 无此贬义引申（英式俚语中 bent 亦可指腐败，但正式写作少用）

synonyms.example: The twisted branches of the ancient oak clawed at the grey sky like the fingers of some sleeping giant. （读后续写·环境渲染）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:twisted 强调经过扭转、缠绕而变形,画面更狰狞、有张力;crooked 只是弯、歪,程度较轻、语气较中性

synonyms.example: A dishonest word, once spoken, can undo years of painstakingly earned trust. （议论文·诚信主题）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:dishonest 是描述品行不诚实最直接、最正式的词;crooked 作"不诚实"讲时更口语、更带鄙夷,常指涉及违法牟利的腐败行为

advancedExpressions.expression: a crooked back / path / smile（弯曲）↔ crooked dealings / a crooked official（不诚实·熟词僻义）
advancedExpressions.example: A crooked path is merely bent; a crooked official is morally bent — same word, two worlds. （一词两义对照记忆）

advancedExpressions.expression: crooked ≈ bent（被弄弯的物体）≈ twisted（扭曲缠绕，更狰狞）
advancedExpressions.example: The nail was bent, the branch twisted, the old path crooked. （只枚举可替换的"不直"表达，语气由轻到重）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·不诚实(熟词僻义)
advancedExpressions.expression: crooked(口语,含鄙夷) ≈ dishonest（最直接正式）≈ corrupt（腐败的）
advancedExpressions.example: The crooked, dishonest and corrupt official was at last exposed. （"不正直"三词可替换，语体不同）

advancedExpressions.expression: crook(n. 弯钩/骗子) → crooked(adj.) → crookedly(adv.) → crookedness(n.)
advancedExpressions.example: The picture hung crookedly, and its crookedness annoyed her. （词族全家桶）

advancedExpressions.expression: ..., crooked and worn, told a story of ...
advancedExpressions.example: His hands, crooked and worn, told a story of a lifetime spent giving to others and asking for nothing in return. （后置形容词+拟人化叙事，续写刻画人物过往）

advancedExpressions.expression: as the ... is crooked / uneven, please be sure to ...
advancedExpressions.example: As the mountain trail is crooked and slippery in places, please be sure to wear sturdy shoes and stay close to your guide at all times. （提醒句式，通知/须知类应用文）

advancedExpressions.expression: a crooked ... can never ...; likewise, ...
advancedExpressions.example: A crooked foundation can never bear a towering building; likewise, a career founded on deceit can never withstand the test of time. （类比+分号并列，说理有力）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The old man's back was crooked.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The old man's back was bent crooked as a question mark, bowed by decades of toil, yet when the children ran to greet him, he straightened as though the weight of years had suddenly lifted. （读后续写·人物+情感）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 明喻(crooked as a question mark，呼应课文原句) + 过去分词短语作状语(bowed by...) + yet转折对比(straightened) + 隐喻情感升华(weight of years lifted)

sentenceUpgrade.original: The official was crooked and stole money.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: That the official was crooked came as no surprise to those who had watched public funds quietly vanish into private pockets year after year, but the courage of the whistle-blower who finally exposed him left the whole town in awe. （议论文/记叙·正式）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: That从句作主语 + came as no surprise to sb.地道表达 + 定语从句(who had watched...) + 尾重信息(the courage...left...in awe)突出主旨

classPractice.note: 考课文原句词块 crooked like a question mark（"弯曲"本义）

original_sentence: These are going to make me as straight as an arrow. They're my magic shoes.
readingExamples: These are going to make me as straight as an arrow. They're my magic shoes.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a thin straight weapon with a sharp point at one end, shot from a bow
(2) n. a sign or symbol shaped like an arrow, used to show direction or point to something
(3) n. (as a symbol of speed or straightness) something moving fast and in a straight line

posExamples.sentence: The arrow left the bow with a sharp whistle, cut clean through the frosty air, and buried itself in the very heart of the target, silencing the crowd that had doubted the trembling young archer. （读后续写·竞技高潮）
Once you enter the exhibition hall, simply follow the green arrows on the floor, and they will lead you smoothly from one section to the next without any confusion. （应用文·参观指引）
Time flies like an arrow, and every hour we waste in idleness is an hour we can never call back; this is why a clear plan matters far more than mere good intentions. （议论文·惜时主题）
She dashed across the finish line as straight and swift as an arrow, her ponytail streaming behind her, and only then did the tears she had been holding back finally break free. （读后续写·运动会）

wordForms.other: arrowhead (n. 箭头，箭镞)

idioms.example: Grandfather stood straight as an arrow at the gate every evening, waiting for the school bus, and to me that unbending figure came to mean love itself. （读后续写·亲情，兼取"正直"双关，呼应课文"as straight as an arrow"）

collocations.translation: 笔直的（课文原句：make me as straight as an arrow）
collocations.example: These are going to make me as straight as an arrow. （课文原句词块，明喻·笔直，兼可喻"正直"）
The village elder taught the boy to handle a bow and arrow. （固定搭配·弓箭）
With one final breath she shot the arrow, and time seemed to slow as every eye followed its arc toward the distant target. （读后续写·紧张时刻）
To reach the first-aid room, please follow the red arrows along the corridor and turn right at the end. （应用文·校园指引）
A flashing green arrow on the screen pointed the anxious passengers toward the emergency exit. （读后续写·紧急场景）

collocations.phrase: an arrow points to / at sth
collocations.example: On the map, a bold arrow points to the mountain hut where climbers can shelter from sudden storms. （应用文·活动说明）
The messenger rode swift as an arrow through the night, carrying news that could not wait until dawn. （读后续写·紧迫叙事）
As the legend goes, a hail of arrows darkened the sky, yet the lone general never once turned his horse from the enemy. （读后续写·历史传说）
She drew a small arrow in the margin to remind herself which paragraph needed rewriting. （应用文·学习笔记）

synonyms.example: The child made a sudden dart across the road, and the driver slammed on the brakes just in time. （读后续写·惊险瞬间）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:dart 指较小的投掷利器（飞镖），也常作动词表"猛冲";arrow 特指配弓发射的箭，作名词还广泛指方向"箭头"，dart 无此指示义

synonyms.example: The teacher used a laser pointer to draw the class's attention to the key formula on the board. （应用文·课堂说明）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:pointer 泛指用来指示的工具或指针（钟表指针、教鞭、光标）;arrow 特指"箭头"这一符号形状，二者在"指示"义上有交叉，但形状与来源不同

advancedExpressions.expression: shoot an arrow / a bow and arrow（弓箭）| follow the arrows / an arrow points to（箭头·指示）
advancedExpressions.example: He drew his bow and arrow to shoot an arrow, while on the map an arrow pointed to the target. （arrow 两义：兵器"箭" vs. 符号"箭头"）

advancedExpressions.expression: as straight as an arrow（笔直/正直）| swift as an arrow ≈ like a dart（快如飞镖）
advancedExpressions.example: He stood as straight as an arrow and ran swift as an arrow. （只枚举可替换的比喻表达）

advancedExpressions.expression: arrow(n. 箭/箭头) + head → arrowhead(n. 箭头，箭镞)
advancedExpressions.example: The museum displayed a stone arrowhead thousands of years old. （合成词构词）

advancedExpressions.expression: sb./sth. shot forward like an arrow released from the bow
advancedExpressions.example: At the starting gun she shot forward like an arrow released from the bow, every doubt of the past year burning away in the rush of wind. （明喻+动作特写，续写渲染爆发力）

advancedExpressions.expression: simply follow the arrows and you will find ...
advancedExpressions.example: Simply follow the arrows painted on the ground and you will find the registration desk right at the entrance of the gym. （祈使句+承诺结果，指引类应用文）

advancedExpressions.expression: time / opportunity flies like an arrow — once gone, it never returns
advancedExpressions.example: Opportunity flies like an arrow — once gone, it never returns; the wise, therefore, seize the moment while the foolish wait for a better one. （明喻+对比说理，惜时/机遇主题）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The arrow hit the target.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: With a sharp hiss the arrow tore through the still morning air and struck the bullseye dead centre, and for one breathless heartbeat the entire field fell utterly silent before erupting into cheers. （读后续写·竞技高潮）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 拟声开头(sharp hiss) + 连动(tore through...struck) + 时间凝滞描写(one breathless heartbeat...fell silent) + 先抑后扬(silent→erupting into cheers)

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should not waste time.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Since time flies like an arrow that never returns, it is upon each of us to make every fleeting hour count rather than to squander our youth in idle regret. （议论文·惜时）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Since引导原因状语从句 + 明喻(like an arrow that never returns) + it is upon sb. to do 正式责任表达 + rather than 对比结构强化主旨

original_sentence: From that day on, we was always together. Jenny and me was like peas and carrots.
readingExamples: From that day on, we was always together. Jenny and me was like peas and carrots.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a small round green seed eaten as a vegetable, which grows inside a long pod on a climbing plant
(2) n. the plant on which these seeds grow
(3) n. (as a symbol of smallness or roundness) something very small and round

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （比喻）极小极圆之物；(as) like as two peas in a pod / like two peas in a pod 一模一样，一个模子刻出来的（熟词·高频习语）
uncommonMeanings.example: The twins were like two peas in a pod — even their mother mixed them up. （熟词习语·长相/关系极像）

posExamples.sentence: Grandma sat on the porch shelling peas into a chipped enamel bowl, and the soft rhythmic patter of each pea dropping in seemed to carry away all the worries of the long summer afternoon. （读后续写·田园温情）
In our school garden project, each class will be responsible for a small plot, where students may grow peas, tomatoes and herbs, and learn firsthand where their food truly comes from. （应用文·活动方案）
A single pea, planted and patiently tended, can in time fill a whole basket; in the same way, a small kindness, once sown, may grow into blessings far beyond what we imagine. （议论文·积少成多主题）
From high above, the climbers on the ridge looked no bigger than peas scattered on a vast grey rock, and only then did I grasp how truly enormous the mountain was. （读后续写·景物+震撼）

wordForms.other: pea-sized (adj. 豌豆大小的); pea-green (adj. 豆绿色的)

idioms.idiom: (as) like as two peas in a pod
idioms.example: The twins were as like as two peas in a pod, and even their own mother sometimes paused before calling out a name. （读后续写·人物介绍）

idioms.idiom: like two peas in a pod
idioms.translation: 亲密无间，形影不离（形容关系或长相极像）
idioms.example: From that summer on, the two boys were like two peas in a pod, sharing every secret, every scraped knee and every wild dream. （读后续写·童年友谊，呼应课文"like peas and carrots"）

collocations.translation: 形影不离，天生一对（课文原句：Jenny and me was like peas and carrots.）
collocations.example: Jenny and me was like peas and carrots. （课文原句词块，喻两人亲密无间）

collocations.phrase: like two peas in a pod
collocations.translation: 一模一样；亲密无间（熟词习语·长相或关系极像）
collocations.example: The two boys were like two peas in a pod, sharing every secret. （熟词·相似/亲密）
The steaming bowl of rice, dotted with bright green peas, was the first proper meal the refugees had seen in weeks. （读后续写·温暖救助）
Shelling peas beside my grandmother, I learned that the slowest afternoons often hold the warmest memories. （读后续写·亲情回忆）
The retired teacher grew peas along the fence, and every child in the lane knew they were welcome to a handful on the way home. （读后续写·邻里温情）

collocations.phrase: a pod of peas / peas in a pod
collocations.example: He split open the pod to reveal a neat row of peas, as tidy as buttons on a coat, and the little girl gasped in delight. （读后续写·童真发现）
A bowl of thick pea soup was waiting on the stove when she finally came in from the snow, and the simple warmth of it brought tears to her eyes. （读后续写·归家温暖）
Sweet peas climbed the old trellis in a riot of pink and lavender, filling the whole yard with their delicate scent. （读后续写·花园环境）

collocations.translation: 豌豆和胡萝卜（喻形影不离、天生一对）
collocations.example: Ever since kindergarten the two of us had been peas and carrots — where one went, the other was sure to follow. （读后续写·挚友，直接化用课文表达）

synonyms.example: The farmer soaked the beans overnight so they would soften in the morning's stew. （读后续写·农家生活）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:bean 泛指各类豆子（菜豆、黄豆等），种类范围大;pea 专指豌豆这种小圆绿豆，二者不可混用，pea 常用于"小而圆"的比喻

synonyms.example: She pressed a single seed into the warm soil and whispered a wish, as though the earth itself could hear her. （读后续写·希望象征）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:seed 是"种子"的统称，可作"起源、萌芽"的抽象比喻;pea 是具体食物豌豆，比喻义偏"细小圆形之物"，二者比喻方向不同

advancedExpressions.expression: like two peas in a pod / like peas and carrots（形影不离、一模一样）| no bigger than a pea（比喻渺小）
advancedExpressions.example: They were like two peas in a pod; from the plane the villages looked no bigger than peas. （pea 的两大比喻：相似 & 渺小）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·一模一样/形影不离
advancedExpressions.expression: like two peas in a pod ≈ like peas and carrots ≈ identical / inseparable
advancedExpressions.example: The friends were like two peas in a pod — inseparable, almost identical in their laughter. （只枚举可替换的"极像/不离"表达）

advancedExpressions.expression: pea + sized → pea-sized(adj. 豌豆大小的) | pea + green → pea-green(adj. 豆绿色的)
advancedExpressions.example: A pea-sized drop of pea-green paint fell on the page. （合成形容词构词）

advancedExpressions.expression: no bigger than a pea / peas scattered on ...
advancedExpressions.example: From the plane the villages below were no bigger than peas scattered across a green quilt, and my quarrels of the morning suddenly felt very small. （明喻+以景喻情，续写升华心境）

advancedExpressions.expression: students will learn to grow ... such as peas and ..., gaining hands-on experience of ...
advancedExpressions.example: Through the farming club, students will learn to grow vegetables such as peas and tomatoes, gaining hands-on experience of patience and the joy of harvest. （介绍活动收获，倡议/通知类应用文）

advancedExpressions.expression: just as a single pea can fill a basket, so ...
advancedExpressions.example: Just as a single pea, once sown, can multiply to fill a basket, so a modest daily effort, faithfully repeated, can accumulate into remarkable achievement. （just as...so...类比句式，量变到质变主题）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The two friends were always together.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: From that day on, the two of us were like peas in a pod — inseparable through every triumph and every tumble, our friendship woven so tightly that not even the long years apart could ever unravel it. （读后续写·友谊升华，化用课文"like peas and carrots"）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 习语明喻(like peas in a pod) + 破折号补充(inseparable through...) + 对偶(triumph and tumble) + 比喻延伸(woven...unravel)呼应主题

sentenceUpgrade.original: Small efforts can add up to big results.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Just as a single pea, patiently planted and tended, can in time fill an entire basket, so too can our small, unglamorous daily efforts accumulate, season after season, into achievements we once thought beyond reach. （议论文·积少成多）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Just as...so too can...倒装类比结构 + 过去分词插入语(patiently planted and tended) + 副词短语控制节奏(season after season) + 尾句拔高(beyond reach)
